slang_definition_en: A facial expression that is very neutral and emotionless, giving a sense of distance and revealing little emotional change.
sentence_with_blank: 小李在会议上一直保持<BLANK>，让其他同事看不出他的真实想法。
sentence_with_blank_en: Xiao Li maintained <BLANK> throughout the meeting, making it impossible for other colleagues to discern his true thoughts.
example_sentence: 小李在会议上一直保持扑克脸，让其他同事看不出他的真实想法。
distractor_1_slang_def: 背景音乐是根据动画角色玛卡巴卡创作的魔性BGM。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A catchy background music inspired by the animated character Makka Pakka.
distractor_2_slang_def: 用来形容一个人没有志气、颓废没落、懒惰消极、不努力、没有骨气、没有前途和希望，做事总是一事无成，是一种对人生活状态或性格的负面评价。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Describes a person who is unambitious, lazy, lacking drive and integrity, with no prospects or hope, consistently failing in their endeavors; a negative evaluation of one's life state or character.
distractor_3_slang_def: 感觉难受且无法直视，通常用于评价一些奇葩或充满槽点的事物。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Causing discomfort and unable to look directly, usually used to describe bizarre or cringe-worthy things.

conv_def_en: No flaws
slang_definition: 意思是指某件事情或某个人实际上是有问题、有毛病的，通常用来形容那些让人无言以对、啼笑皆非的情况。
slang_definition_en: Used ironically to describe a situation or person that is clearly problematic or absurd.
sentence_with_blank: 当朋友参加了一场节奏极慢的马拉松比赛后，拿到最后一名，但他却豪言壮语称：“我这是为了享受沿途风景，就是不夺冠又怎样？”旁边的朋友无奈地说：“哦，<BLANK>。”
sentence_with_blank_en: After a friend participated in an extremely slow marathon and finished last, he boldly declared, "I'm here to enjoy the scenery along the way; so what if I don't win?" The friend beside him helplessly said, "Oh, <BLANK>."
example_sentence: 当朋友参加了一场节奏极慢的马拉松比赛后，拿到最后一名，但他却豪言壮语称：“我这是为了享受沿途风景，就是不夺冠又怎样？”旁边的朋友无奈地说：“哦，没毛病。”
distractor_1_slang_def: 指某人使用了精心策划的方法和手段，以达到其目的，这些手段非常巧妙，以至于一般人难以预料。可以表达一种震惊或感叹，具体的褒贬意义要根据具体语境来判断。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Refers to someone using carefully planned and clever methods that are hard to anticipate, often expressing surprise or admiration depending on context.
distractor_2_slang_def: 形象地将时间比喻为无情的“杀猪刀”。这一比喻用来感叹岁月的残酷无情，它不仅在容颜上留下皱纹，也让曾经美好的事物和过去的情感变得物是人非。这句话表达了对光阴飞逝和岁月流逝的感慨，告诫人们要珍惜当下。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A metaphor describing time as a ruthless force that ages appearance and changes cherished things and past emotions, expressing the harshness of passing years and urging people to cherish the present.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指的是同一个圈子或世界，表达对某个话题或文化的共同理解和共鸣。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Refers to sharing the same circle or world, expressing mutual understanding and resonance on a topic or culture.

conv_def_en: Time is like a butcher's knife used to slaughter pigs.
conv_def: 时间像一把用来宰杀猪的刀
slang_definition: 形象地将时间比喻为无情的“杀猪刀”。这一比喻用来感叹岁月的残酷无情，它不仅在容颜上留下皱纹，也让曾经美好的事物和过去的情感变得物是人非。这句话表达了对光阴飞逝和岁月流逝的感慨，告诫人们要珍惜当下。
slang_definition_en: A metaphor describing time as a ruthless force that ages appearance and changes cherished things and past emotions, expressing the harshness of passing years and urging people to cherish the present.
sentence_with_blank: 看着老照片，不得不感叹，时间真的是把杀猪刀啊，我都快认不出曾经的那个自己了。
sentence_with_blank_en: Looking at old photos, I can't help but sigh that time is truly a butcher's knife; I can hardly recognize the person I once was.
example_sentence: 看着老照片，不得不感叹，时间真的是把杀猪刀啊，我都快认不出曾经的那个自己了。
distractor_1_slang_def: 但在网络用语中，通常指一个人展现出多重人格或多种行为方式。在配音领域，指声优为不同角色切换音色和性格。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: In internet slang, refers to a person displaying multiple personalities or behaviors; in voice acting, switching voice tones and personalities for different characters.
distractor_2_slang_def: 在ACG文化中多用于表现对某种目的和欲望的抵抗力，或者指坚持不降低自我底线的能力。也用于形容行为没有下限，被称为“无节操”。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: In ACG culture, refers to the ability to resist certain desires or maintain personal boundaries; also used to describe behavior lacking limits, called "no 节操."
distractor_3_slang_def: 指卖萌过度，显得刻意和不自然，甚至让观者反感。这个词被用于戏谑和调侃中，带有黑色幽默的意味。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Excessive and forced cuteness that appears unnatural and may annoy viewers, often used humorously or sarcastically.

conv_def_en: An entire section completely fails or collapses.
conv_def: 整段内容全部失败或崩溃
slang_definition: 用来形容某段描述或情境非常尴尬无趣，没有任何效果。这句话常用于找台阶、找梗，或对困境的调侃。
slang_definition_en: Used to describe a passage or situation that is extremely awkward and uninteresting, having no impact.
sentence_with_blank: 在朋友们面前讲了一个冷笑话却没人笑，我只好无奈地说：“哎，<BLANK>。”
sentence_with_blank_en: I told a lame joke in front of my friends but no one laughed, so I helplessly said, "Ah, <BLANK>."
example_sentence: 在朋友们面前讲了一个冷笑话却没人笑，我只好无奈地说：“哎，整段垮掉。”
distractor_1_slang_def: 同时具备温柔可爱的“奶”属性和强势有安全感的“狼”属性。这个形容词用来评价既能撒娇卖萌，又能展现男友力的男生。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Describes a boy who is both gentle and cute, yet strong and protective.
distractor_2_slang_def: 是指那些默默干活、不能有怨言、不能出头的人。由“牛马”演变而来，字面上表示出不了头的“牛马”。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Refers to people who work silently without complaints and cannot stand out.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指的是一种调侃用语，形容玩家在射击游戏中的枪法非常糟糕，几乎打不中目标。它形象地将糟糕的反应速度和精准度与老年人相比。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A humorous term describing a player's very poor shooting accuracy in games, likening their slow reaction and inaccuracy to that of an elderly person.

conv_def_en: To kick against an iron plate.
slang_definition: 指以为对方容易对付，结果发现对方很强大，自己反而吃亏。它也作为一种提醒，提示做人要低调，不要随意招惹别人。
slang_definition_en: To encounter unexpected resistance or difficulty when underestimating someone, serving as a reminder to stay humble and avoid provoking others.
sentence_with_blank: 他以为对手是个新人，没想到经验丰富，比赛中彻底踢到了铁板。
sentence_with_blank_en: He thought his opponent was a newcomer, but unexpectedly, with rich experience, he completely hit a wall during the match.
example_sentence: 他以为对手是个新人，没想到经验丰富，比赛中彻底踢到了铁板。
distractor_1_slang_def: 常常伴随着地域歧视的倾向。在某些群体中，这种行为被视为一种娱乐，但在更广泛的人群中，它往往被视为一种不当的地域歧视。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A behavior often involving regional discrimination, seen as entertainment in some groups but generally regarded as inappropriate regional bias.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指的是一种形容在亲密关系中，一个人因非常喜欢另一个人而时常依偎在对方身边的状态。这个人就像是对方的“挂件”，因为“挂件”是人，所以称为“人形挂件”。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A term describing someone who frequently stays close to their partner in an intimate relationship, like a human accessory.
distractor_3_slang_def: 针对那些热爱奶茶的人。它反映了现代人在饮用高糖分饮料后容易出现体重增加的现象。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A term describing the tendency for people who love milk tea to gain weight due to consuming high-sugar drinks.

conv_def_en: Public intellectuals of the Tomb Sect
conv_def: 古墓派的公共知识分子
slang_definition: 形容那些认知水平落后、用过时手段宣扬他国优越的公知，实际上是不切实际的盲目吹捧他国并贬低中国的人。
slang_definition_en: A term describing public intellectuals with outdated views who unrealistically praise foreign countries while belittling China.
sentence_with_blank: 这篇文章说巴黎街头免费发放葡萄酒，感觉像是出自<BLANK>之手。
sentence_with_blank_en: This article says that free wine is being distributed on the streets of Paris, which feels like it was done by <BLANK>.
example_sentence: 这篇文章说巴黎街头免费发放葡萄酒，感觉像是出自古墓派公知之手。
distractor_1_slang_def: 主要用于表达对某人过分行为的愤怒和鄙视、对某些不可能行为的佩服和惊奇，或极度不赞同时的嘲讽。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Used to express anger and contempt toward someone's excessive behavior, admiration or amazement at impossible actions, or sarcastic disapproval.
distractor_2_slang_def: 用来表示因恐惧、惊吓、恶心等负面情绪而产生的强烈反应。其含义实则是反义，通常并不是字面上的真的吓出尿来，而是借此夸大以引起注意或表达不满。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Used to express an intense reaction to fear, shock, or disgust, often exaggerated and not literal.
distractor_3_slang_def: 可以用来形容：1. 有些土气、落伍的女孩子；2. 身材瘦小，如柴火般的女孩子；3. 处于青春期，身体未发育完全的女孩子；4. 脾气大，如柴火般容易点燃的女孩子；5. 也可以指活力四射，自由自在的青春期女孩子。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A girl who is somewhat rustic or old-fashioned, petite and thin, in early adolescence, quick-tempered, or lively and free-spirited.

conv_def_en: A lighter powered by nuclear energy.
conv_def: 利用核能作为能源的打火机
slang_definition: 是用来吐槽恐怖游戏或解谜游戏中道具打火机的不科学设定。在游戏中，打火机常作为唯一的光源，能在长时间的游戏过程中始终保持亮度，燃料似乎用之不竭，像是由核能驱动一样。
slang_definition_en: A term used to criticize the unrealistic design of lighters in horror or puzzle games that serve as a constant, inexhaustible light source, as if powered by nuclear energy.
sentence_with_blank: 玩这款恐怖游戏时，主角一直拿着<BLANK>，走遍整个鬼屋都不必担心光源问题。
sentence_with_blank_en: When playing this horror game, the protagonist always holds <BLANK>, so there is no need to worry about the light source while exploring the entire haunted house.
example_sentence: 玩这款恐怖游戏时，主角一直拿着核能打火机，走遍整个鬼屋都不必担心光源问题。
distractor_1_slang_def: 在动漫中，特指角色对白中用“电脑配件”作为掩饰的物品，实际上指代某些不被允许或者不便公开的补品或物品。渐渐地，这个词开始被用作弹幕，以调侃和幽默的方式来评论此类情境。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: In anime, a euphemism for prohibited or sensitive items, later used humorously in comments to reference such situations.
distractor_2_slang_def: 有两种含义：1. 盘她可以理解为“撩她”；2. 盘她也可以表示“揍她”。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: 1. Flirt with her; 2. Beat her up.
distractor_3_slang_def: 尤其是在赞美某人的表现非常精彩时使用。这个词还可以用来讽刺那些表现不佳的人，类似于表示他们的表演像是在“秀”一样。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Used to praise someone's outstanding performance or sarcastically indicate poor performance as if it were a show.

conv_def_en: Killing while making a cooing sound.
slang_definition: （くっ殺）=咕…杀了我吧！（「くっ…殺せ！」），指代女战士或女骑士在战败后，表达“士可杀不可辱”的精神。这句话表示宁死不屈，意为“杀了我吧”。
slang_definition_en: An expression used by female warriors or knights after defeat, meaning "kill me" to convey a spirit of preferring death over dishonor.
sentence_with_blank: 在这款游戏中，女骑士的经典台词“<BLANK>”让玩家印象深刻。
sentence_with_blank_en: In this game, the female knight's classic line "<BLANK>" leaves a deep impression on players.
example_sentence: 在这款游戏中，女骑士的经典台词“咕杀”让玩家印象深刻。
distractor_1_slang_def: 意指消除一个人身边的所有备胎（恋爱候选人），而成为其唯一的恋爱对象。这个说法源于将备胎比喻为鱼塘里的鱼，而拥有较多备胎的人被称为“海王”。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: To eliminate all a person's romantic alternatives and become their sole romantic partner.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指代一种敢于直言、不畏惧后果的勇士精神。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A spirit of bravery characterized by speaking boldly without fear of consequences.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指在工作或游戏中偷懒、不认真对待、出工不出力的行为。这个词来源于古代划船时一些水手假装用力，但实际上并没有真正用力，全程敷衍的情况。现代语境中接近“打酱油”的意思。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: To slack off or put in minimal effort at work or during a game.

conv_def_en: Large eyes of a Siberian Husky dog
slang_definition: 形容人因愤怒或其他情绪而睁大眼睛，并因此与哈士奇犬的表情相似。
slang_definition_en: Describes a person widening their eyes due to anger or other emotions, resembling the expression of a husky dog.

distractor_1_slang_def_en: Refers to treating everyone or everything equally without favoritism, often used humorously online to mock extreme partiality.
distractor_2_slang_def: 用来调侃人们在遇到不顺利的事情时，自我安慰需要“沉淀”一下，以降级目标的方式面对困境。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A humorous term for self-comfort by "settling down" and lowering expectations when facing difficulties.
distractor_3_slang_def: 是一个用来批评和讽刺那些通过无理取闹、扰乱公共秩序来获取利益的社会现象的网络用语。这种行为通常被形容为“会哭的孩子有糖吃”，意指通过不当手段达到目的。此外，这一说法也用来形容部分情况下，由于某些机构的不作为，人们不得不通过“闹”来争取本应得到的合法权益。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A slang term criticizing the social phenomenon where people gain benefits by causing disturbances or unreasonable complaints, often due to institutional inaction forcing them to protest for their rightful interests.

distractor_3_slang_def: 指上班或表演时严重偷懒的人。

distractor_3_slang_def: 特征是翻白眼、张嘴、吐舌，表现出一种陶醉和迷离失神的状态，常与性高潮的情景相关。

slang_definition: 指的是人们在使用英语时，语法和句子结构混乱、不完整，给人一种不成句、不成文的感觉，通常显得滑稽可笑。这通常用于形容那些不太会说英语的人在尝试用英语交流时的表现。

conv_def_en: An essay that receives a full score.
slang_definition: 指的是文学气息浓厚、真情实感显露、内容丰富的文字或语言表达，形容某人的表达能力非常优秀，值得满分。
slang_definition_en: A highly expressive and richly detailed piece of writing or speech demonstrating excellent communication skills.
sentence_with_blank: 他的演讲非常感人，大家纷纷称赞那是<BLANK>。
sentence_with_blank_en: His speech was very touching, and everyone praised it as <BLANK>.
example_sentence: 他的演讲非常感人，大家纷纷称赞那是满分作文。
distractor_1_slang_def: 用来形容那些试图撩很多人但始终成功不了，既像“海王”又像“舔狗”的人。通俗地说，海狗就是同时巴结讨好很多人的人，尽管多方撩拨，却仍显得卑微。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A person who tries to flirt with many people but never succeeds, resembling both a "player" and a "simp," often flattering multiple people yet appearing humble and unsuccessful.
distractor_2_slang_def: 看似传递信息，实则没有实质内容，给人一种“说了但好像又什么都没说”的感觉。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Language that appears informative but lacks substantive content, giving the impression of saying something without actually conveying anything.
distractor_3_slang_def: 用来形容即将失败、面临困境或事情的结果即将糟糕的状况。最初在游戏对战中用于表示"这局要输了"，后来被引申为遇到大事或糟糕结果。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Used to describe an impending failure, difficult situation, or an outcome that is about to turn bad.

conv_def_en: Hand-rubbing a nuclear bomb model.
slang_definition: 指用手完成一件非常厉害或极具影响力的事情。原意是动漫中角色仅凭手就能发出威力巨大的招式，象征该角色的强大实力。现在用于形容某人用手完成了出色的作品或任务。
slang_definition_en: Refers to accomplishing an impressive or highly impactful task using only one's hands, symbolizing great skill or power.
sentence_with_blank: 他只用了15分钟就写完了一篇精彩的文章，简直像是<BLANK>。
sentence_with_blank_en: He finished writing an excellent article in just 15 minutes, it was simply like <BLANK>.
example_sentence: 他只用了15分钟就写完了一篇精彩的文章，简直像是手搓核弹。
distractor_1_slang_def: 通常用于描述一对情侣角色之间秀恩爱的情景，类似于现实中在婚礼上发喜糖的习俗。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Typically used to describe a couple showing affection publicly, similar to the tradition of distributing wedding candies.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指的是那些在聚会时不聊八卦，而是专注于讨论如何赚钱的女生。总体上泛指专注于赚钱的女性。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A woman who focuses on discussing ways to make money rather than gossiping, generally referring to women dedicated to earning income.
distractor_3_slang_def: 形容一个人感到非常尴尬、羞愧，尴尬到极点，甚至夸张到像用脚趾抠出一个大房子一样。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Describes someone feeling extremely embarrassed or ashamed to an exaggerated degree.

conv_def_en: A peach of the human world.
slang_definition: 形容长相甜美、气质如水蜜桃般的人，通常指外貌甜美、皮肤白皙泛粉红、具少女感的人。
slang_definition_en: A person with a sweet appearance and peach-like complexion, typically referring to someone with fair, slightly pink skin and a youthful, girlish charm.
sentence_with_blank: 她笑起来特别甜，有一种<BLANK>的感觉。
sentence_with_blank_en: Her smile is especially sweet, giving a feeling of <BLANK>.
example_sentence: 她笑起来特别甜，有一种人间水蜜桃的感觉。
distractor_1_slang_def: 指那些让人感到不解、很奇怪或耐人寻味的行为。在网络语境中，这个词语通常用来形容那些看似无厘头、让人感到困惑甚至有些搞笑的举动，但随着时间推移，逐渐也带有一些批判意味。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Actions that are confusing, strange, or puzzling, often seemingly nonsensical and sometimes humorous, but increasingly carrying a critical tone.
distractor_2_slang_def: 跟“傻乐”形成对比，用于形容在困难未到来之前就感到悲观的人。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A person who feels pessimistic before difficulties actually occur.
distractor_3_slang_def: 用来表示在一个令人心痛或虐心的情境中试图找到一些甜蜜或欢乐的时刻。这种心态常见于观看或阅读那些情感起伏较大的影视剧或小说时，观众会在整体虐心的情节中寻求甜蜜的小瞬间。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Trying to find sweet or joyful moments within a painful or emotionally intense situation.

conv_def_en: Mute the microphone
slang_definition: 指的是歌手决定不再在公开场合演唱歌曲，隐退歌坛，告别舞台的行为。
slang_definition_en: The act of a singer deciding to retire from performing publicly and leaving the music scene.
sentence_with_blank: 费玉清在他的最终告别演唱会后宣布<BLANK>，这标志着他47年歌唱生涯的结束。
sentence_with_blank_en: Fei Yuqing announced <BLANK> after his final farewell concert, marking the end of his 47-year singing career.
example_sentence: 费玉清在他的最终告别演唱会后宣布封麦，这标志着他47年歌唱生涯的结束。
distractor_1_slang_def: 表达惊讶、不满或作为口头禅的一句广东俚语。在广东话中，也可作为骂人的话。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A Cantonese slang phrase expressing surprise, dissatisfaction, or used as a verbal filler, sometimes also as an insult.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指的是YM战队，尽管成绩不理想，但培养出多位知名选手。类似于黄埔军校在军事领域的影响力，YM在电竞圈为多支冠军队伍输送人才。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A team known for producing many famous players despite mediocre results, similar to the influential Huangpu Military Academy in the esports field.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指沉迷于截图，把信息或瞬间记录下来，以备日后查看或分享给他人。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: An obsession with taking screenshots to record information or moments for future reference or sharing.

conv_def_en: Second-in-command
slang_definition: 通常指在某个领域或团体中地位仅次于最高领导者的人。在网络梗中，特别是指那些冒充淘宝卖家的人，因为商家是第一位，而冒充者排在第二位，因而被戏称为"二当家"。该词也常用于形容内心戏丰富、喜欢在评论区"演戏"的网友。
slang_definition_en: A person second in command in a group or field; online, a term for fake sellers or users who theatrically act out in comment sections.
sentence_with_blank: 在抖音评论区，常有一些人自称"<BLANK>"，表演自己的内心戏。
sentence_with_blank_en: In the Douyin comment section, there are often people who call themselves "<BLANK>" and act out their inner dramas.
example_sentence: 在抖音评论区，常有一些人自称"二当家"，表演自己的内心戏。
distractor_1_slang_def: 原本是指在游戏中提升角色防御力的动作，现如今在网络语言中被用来指代在表达观点时加入免责声明，以避免被批评或争论。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Originally referring to increasing a character's defense in games, now used online to mean adding disclaimers when expressing opinions to avoid criticism or arguments.
distractor_2_slang_def: 用于形容一个人特别有钱，花钱非常大方，也可以用来吐槽某件事情非常烧钱或价格过高。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Used to describe someone who is very wealthy and spends money generously, or to criticize something as very expensive or costly.
distractor_3_slang_def: 用于表示评论内容为反讽，提醒读者与所说之话相反，常常用来避免误会或误伤友军，表示“我是友军/忠装反，别打我”。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Used to indicate that a comment is ironic, signaling the opposite meaning to avoid misunderstandings or offending allies.

conv_def_en: A young man in good spirits or good mental state.
conv_def: 精神状态良好的年轻男子
slang_definition: 原本是指精神气质好的年轻人，现在通常指打扮和行为很有特色，喜欢跳社会摇的土嗨小伙子。
slang_definition_en: A young man with distinctive style and behavior, often fond of dancing to social shake music.
sentence_with_blank: 他穿着豆豆鞋和紧身裤，骑着电动车，就像一个标准的<BLANK>。
sentence_with_blank_en: He was wearing loafers and tight pants, riding an electric bike, just like a typical <BLANK>.
example_sentence: 他穿着豆豆鞋和紧身裤，骑着电动车，就像一个标准的精神小伙。
distractor_1_slang_def: 但在网络用语中，通常指一个人展现出多重人格或多种行为方式。在配音领域，指声优为不同角色切换音色和性格。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: In internet slang, refers to a person displaying multiple personalities or behaviors; in voice acting, switching voice tones and personalities for different characters.
distractor_2_slang_def: 用来表达一种强烈的认同感、激动或感慨，尤其是在遇到志同道合的人时。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Used to express strong agreement, excitement, or emotion, especially when meeting like-minded people.
distractor_3_slang_def: 用于形容不知轻重、不顾危险的行为，相当于"自寻死路"。多用于吐槽某人做出了可能引发危险的行为，常带有喜剧效果。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Engaging in reckless behavior that invites trouble or danger.

conv_def_en: Save money by not buying.
slang_definition: 面对各种促销优惠活动，如“满减”“立减”等，尽管这些优惠方式标榜能够省钱，真正最省钱的方法其实是不购买任何商品。这是一种调侃和自嘲，因为大部分消费者最终还是会忍不住消费。
slang_definition_en: A humorous way to say the best way to save money during promotions is to not buy anything at all.
sentence_with_blank: 每到双十一前夕，我就在心里默念“今年一定要<BLANK>”，然而总是被各种优惠击败。
sentence_with_blank_en: Every year on the eve of Double Eleven, I silently repeat to myself, "This year I must <BLANK>," yet I am always defeated by various discounts.
example_sentence: 每到双十一前夕，我就在心里默念“今年一定要不买立省”，然而总是被各种优惠击败。
distractor_1_slang_def: 用以表达对这种表面关心的调侃和不满。通常由女生用来讽刺那些认为自己在关心女生，但实际上只是在说空话的男生。也可以被用作男生对被称为“直男”这种评价的不满反驳。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A sarcastic expression used to mock insincere or superficial concern, often by women toward men who pretend to care but only speak empty words, and sometimes by men to rebut being labeled as unimaginative or insensitive.
distractor_2_slang_def: 表示一个人对生活失去热情，不再积极进取，同时心态也崩溃了。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Describes a person who has lost enthusiasm for life, no longer strives actively, and whose mindset has collapsed.
distractor_3_slang_def: “淡人”和“浓人”是一种网络用语，分别用来描述两种不同性格的人。淡人是指那些个性较为平稳、情绪不常剧烈波动的人，通常表现为淡泊名利、宁静致远。浓人则是指情绪丰富、表现外向的人，他们的言行举止充满表达情绪的词汇。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: "Dàn rén" refers to calm, steady individuals with mild emotions, while "nóng rén" describes expressive, outgoing people with rich emotions.

conv_def_en: Expressing patriotism flexibly.
slang_definition: 指的是一种表面上爱国但在利益受到威胁时表现出灵活和摇摆立场的行为。这一词语用于讽刺那些在爱国与自身利益发生冲突时选择优先维护个人利益的行为。
slang_definition_en: A behavior that superficially shows patriotism but flexibly shifts stance when personal interests are threatened.
sentence_with_blank: 某明星代言品牌发表了不当政治言论，但该明星没有立即解约，被网友讽刺为 "<BLANK>"。
sentence_with_blank_en: A certain celebrity endorsing a brand made inappropriate political remarks, but the celebrity did not immediately terminate the contract and was mocked by netizens as "<BLANK>".
example_sentence: 某明星代言品牌发表了不当政治言论，但该明星没有立即解约，被网友讽刺为 "弹性爱国"。
distractor_1_slang_def: 指那些无法控制自己购物欲望的人，尤其是在网购时往往沉迷于疯狂购物，最后购买了许多不需要的东西，造成金钱和时间的浪费。即便意识到了问题，仍然无法克制购物冲动。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Refers to people who cannot control their shopping urges, especially online, often buying many unnecessary items and wasting money and time despite realizing the problem.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指的是女娲造人时最完美的作品，用来形容一个人在各方面（如长相、身材、性格、智商、情商等）都非常完美的人。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A person who is perfect in all aspects such as appearance, figure, personality, intelligence, and emotional intelligence.
distractor_3_slang_def: 用来形容一个人好对付、单纯、没有乱七八糟的心思，是“不是省油的灯”这一俗语的反义词。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Used to describe a person who is easygoing, simple, and free of complicated intentions.

conv_def_en: Esports military school in Huangpu District
conv_def: 黄浦区的电竞军事学校
slang_definition: 指的是YM战队，尽管成绩不理想，但培养出多位知名选手。类似于黄埔军校在军事领域的影响力，YM在电竞圈为多支冠军队伍输送人才。
slang_definition_en: A team known for producing many famous players despite mediocre results, similar to the influential Huangpu Military Academy in the esports field.
sentence_with_blank: YM真是<BLANK>，培养出了这么多顶尖选手。
sentence_with_blank_en: YM is really <BLANK>, having cultivated so many top players.
example_sentence: YM真是电竞黄浦军校，培养出了这么多顶尖选手。
distractor_1_slang_def: 意在说明某种事情荒谬或违背常理到令人无法忍受，以至于“死去的人都被气得活过来”。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Used to describe something so absurd or unreasonable that it is unbearable, as if even the dead would be angered back to life.
distractor_2_slang_def: 具有多重意义。它可以指头发竖起来，暗示不顺滑；也可以用来形容一个人处于低谷但重燃希望并取得成果的状态；在对峙场景中，表示挑衅或找麻烦。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Having multiple meanings: hair standing up indicating roughness; a person recovering from a low point to achieve success; or provoking confrontation.
distractor_3_slang_def: 用来形容团队中那些几乎没有上场机会、被边缘化的正式成员，他们只能在团队中打杂或做后勤工作。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A formal team member who is marginalized and rarely participates, only handling miscellaneous or logistical tasks.

conv_def_en: Ugly but cute in appearance.
slang_definition: 但意外地让人觉得可爱、有趣的反差属性。尽管第一印象可能因为长相而不突出，但随着时间推移，其幽默和可爱之处逐渐显露出来。这种特质常延伸至小孩子、小动物、小物件或新奇风格的表情包，带有正面和积极的意味。
slang_definition_en: An unexpectedly endearing and amusing quality that contrasts with an initially unattractive appearance, often found in children, animals, objects, or quirky emojis, conveying a positive and charming impression.
sentence_with_blank: "这只猫虽然脸上整天皱巴巴的，但是它的动作真的很<BLANK>，忍不住就觉得可爱极了！"
sentence_with_blank_en: Although this cat's face is wrinkled all day, its movements are really <BLANK>, making it irresistibly adorable!
example_sentence: "这只猫虽然脸上整天皱巴巴的，但是它的动作真的很丑萌，忍不住就觉得可爱极了！"
distractor_1_slang_def: 但因某事情而成为其粉丝。这个词可以用在各种场合，不仅限于对明星的喜爱，也可能是对某产品或事件的兴趣增加。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Becoming a fan of someone or something due to a specific event or reason.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指的是那些不愿意自己做详细旅行计划的人，出发前匆忙在网上搜索或购买别人已经做好的旅行攻略，就像考试时抄别人的作业一样。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A type of travel where one hastily copies others' itineraries or guides instead of making detailed plans independently.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指用说英语的方式来说中文，使得普通话带上一种英语发音的独特效果。这是一种娱乐性的语言游戏，不具备实际的语言功能。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A playful way of speaking Chinese with an English accent, used for entertainment without practical language function.

conv_def_en: Jumping left and right
slang_definition: 有何贵干》的搞笑动作，指的是来回跳动的幽默表现。这个动作在网络上被用作各种搞笑表情包，因为其魔性和幽默感。
slang_definition_en: A humorous back-and-forth jumping motion used in comedic expressions and memes.
sentence_with_blank: 每次老板提出新要求时，我感觉就像在<BLANK>，不知道该先做哪个。
sentence_with_blank_en: Every time the boss comes up with new demands, I feel like I'm at <BLANK>, not knowing which to do first.
example_sentence: 每次老板提出新要求时，我感觉就像在左右横跳，不知道该先做哪个。
distractor_1_slang_def: 在这个梗中指的是精子。因为在生物学中，DNA是由脱氧核糖构成的一部分，而精子是携带DNA的重要载体，因此用脱氧核糖来暗指精子。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A slang term for sperm, referencing deoxyribose as a component of DNA carried by sperm.
distractor_2_slang_def: 源自她在《乘风破浪的姐姐》第三季中的初舞台表现。尽管她已经40岁，但仍旧用一首《爱你》等表演让90后粉丝感到怀旧和激动。这个称呼体现了粉丝对她甜美形象和活力的喜爱。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A term expressing fans' affection for a 40-year-old performer's sweet image and energetic stage presence that evokes nostalgia among post-90s fans.
distractor_3_slang_def: 从其粉丝群体中退出。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: To quit or withdraw from a fan group.

conv_def_en: Washing, cutting, and blow-drying hair services.
slang_definition: 原指理发店提供的洗头、剪头、吹风等服务，但作为网络梗，它用来调侃那些造型奇特、风格独特，类似杀马特风格的人。这个梗也衍生出形容词的用法，专门描述另类和夸张的时尚风格。
slang_definition_en: Originally referring to hair salon services of washing, cutting, and blow-drying, it is used online to mock distinctive, unconventional hairstyles, especially those resembling the "shamate" style.
sentence_with_blank: 你今天的造型真是太<BLANK>了，让人一眼就能注意到。
sentence_with_blank_en: Your look today is really <BLANK>, making it impossible for anyone to miss at first glance.
example_sentence: 你今天的造型真是太洗剪吹了，让人一眼就能注意到。
distractor_1_slang_def: 因为他以创作黑暗、悲剧性故事而闻名。他的作品常常涉及角色死亡和沉重的情感，所以他的名字被用来形容任何在动画或影视作品中触发死亡flag的剧情。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A term used to describe plotlines in animation or film that trigger character death flags, inspired by a creator known for dark, tragic stories.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指心态积极，有目标，但行动力不足，总是立下目标却无法实现的人。他们心态上积极向上，但实际行动上显得懒散和无力。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A person who is mentally positive and goal-oriented but lacks the motivation or ability to take effective action.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指的是超出了极限或标准的测量范围，无法计量。通常表示某种程度极高、非常厉害或强大的意思。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Exceeding the limit or measurement range, indicating an extremely high level or great strength.

conv_def_en: Opening lightning strike
slang_definition: 指的是在刚打开视频时，就立即看到令人震惊或出乎意料的内容，类似于被雷击般的强烈冲击。
slang_definition_en: Refers to encountering shocking or unexpected content immediately upon opening a video, like a sudden lightning strike.
sentence_with_blank: “这部影片真是<BLANK>，我完全没准备好迎接如此刺激的开场。”
sentence_with_blank_en: This film is truly <BLANK>, I was completely unprepared for such an exciting opening.
example_sentence: “这部影片真是开幕雷击，我完全没准备好迎接如此刺激的开场。”
distractor_1_slang_def: 通常在关键时刻伴随主角翻转局势或施放强大技能出现，表现出激昂和振奋的氛围，是胜利和力量的象征。它分为两种类型：一是在主角反攻或胜利时使用的音乐；二是字面意义上的处刑音乐。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Music that plays during a protagonist's decisive comeback or powerful skill use, symbolizing victory and strength, or literally execution music.
distractor_2_slang_def: 表达惊讶、不满或作为口头禅的一句广东俚语。在广东话中，也可作为骂人的话。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A Cantonese slang phrase expressing surprise, dissatisfaction, or used as a verbal filler, sometimes also as an insult.
distractor_3_slang_def: 作为网络流行语，形容一种莫名兴奋、激动、期待且略显猥琐的状态，常用于自黑和自嘲。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: An internet slang term describing a strangely excited, eager, and slightly creepy state, often used for self-mockery or self-deprecation.

conv_def_en: Welcome back home.
slang_definition: 用于调侃游戏玩家在高难度游戏中失败并回到起点时，表达观众对玩家处境的戏谑和“鼓励”。
slang_definition_en: Used to mockingly "welcome" a player back to the start after failing a difficult game level, expressing playful teasing and encouragement from spectators.
sentence_with_blank: 主播刚要到达顶峰，却一个失误掉了下来，弹幕瞬间刷满“<BLANK>”。
sentence_with_blank_en: The streamer was just about to reach the peak but fell down due to a mistake, and the live chat instantly filled with "<BLANK>".
example_sentence: 主播刚要到达顶峰，却一个失误掉了下来，弹幕瞬间刷满“欢迎回家”。
distractor_1_slang_def: 形容一个人的笑声粗犷、豪爽、自然不做作，也用来表示事情非常好笑，令人笑得夸张和不可自持。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A loud, hearty, and natural laugh that is unrestrained and expresses great amusement.
distractor_2_slang_def: 通常指因某种刺激或影响而产生的亢奋状态，或是在冲动下不理智地行动。可以是因酒精或其他物理刺激引发的头晕状态，也可以是被某个想法、音乐、视频等内容吸引并重复在脑海中引起兴奋或模仿的状态。目前多指第二种。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A state of excitement or impulsive behavior caused by stimulation, often from alcohol or captivating ideas, music, or videos.
distractor_3_slang_def: 用来形容由于接触某人而可能遇到霉运。最初与作家马伯庸有关，传说他总是能在事故中幸免于难，而他身边的人却常遭厄运。因此出现了这个梗意味避开霉运或召唤厄运。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Used to describe the possibility of encountering bad luck after contact with a certain person, originally referring to writer Ma Boyong who was often unharmed in accidents while those around him suffered misfortune.

conv_def_en: Hook is straight, bait is salty.
slang_definition: 用来形容那些企图耍别人的人技巧拙劣，构思不周，被轻易识破。主要用于讽刺智商不够的人在尝试诱导或操纵他人时，被一眼看穿的情况。
slang_definition_en: Used to describe someone whose clumsy and poorly planned attempts to deceive others are easily seen through, often mocking those with insufficient intelligence trying to manipulate or mislead.
sentence_with_blank: 那个帖子一看就是钓鱼贴，内容编得太假，真是<BLANK>。
sentence_with_blank_en: That post is obviously a baiting post; the content is fabricated so badly, it really is <BLANK>.
example_sentence: 那个帖子一看就是钓鱼贴，内容编得太假，真是钩直饵咸。
distractor_1: 糟了是心肌梗塞的感觉
distractor_1_slang_def: 源于“糟了，是心动的感觉”，用于形容某事物或某人非常令人心动，甚至用心肌梗塞来形容心动程度之大。也可以用于表达一种反向幽默感，当某事物或行为夸张或搞笑到让人“窒息”时，也可以用这种说法表示。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Used to describe something or someone extremely heart-fluttering, or humorously to express being overwhelmed or stunned by exaggeration or absurdity.
distractor_2_slang_def: 通常一方寿命短暂，另一方寿命长久，最终导致一方注视着另一方先死去。这种情节引发对角色未来命运的思考，表达出岁月无情对深厚感情的冲击。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A scenario where one character outlives another, prompting reflection on the impact of time and mortality on deep relationships.
distractor_3_slang_def: 在并不需要吃苦的情况下，主动去承受不必要的艰难，从而导致适得其反的行为。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Unnecessarily enduring hardship when it is not required, resulting in counterproductive outcomes.

conv_def_en: Baby cow, roll over!
slang_definition: 意在让人离远点。它在网络上流行起来作为一种不带脏字的方式来说脏话。
slang_definition_en: A playful phrase used online to tell someone to go away without using profanity.
sentence_with_blank: 在游戏中队友频频失误，小王忍不住想说脏话，但最后憋出了一句：“<BLANK>！”
sentence_with_blank_en: In the game, teammates kept making mistakes, and Xiao Wang couldn't help but want to swear, but in the end, he held back and said: "<BLANK>!"
example_sentence: 在游戏中队友频频失误，小王忍不住想说脏话，但最后憋出了一句：“翻滚吧牛宝宝！”
distractor_1_slang_def: 指的是将两件或多件看似不相关或不协调的事物放在一起时产生的不舒适感或不适应感。相反的说法是"毫无违和感"，意指这些事物放在一起看上去自然协调，仿佛原本就应该在一起。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A feeling of discomfort or incongruity when two or more seemingly unrelated or mismatched things are placed together.
distractor_2_slang_def: 原本是指在游戏中提升角色防御力的动作，现如今在网络语言中被用来指代在表达观点时加入免责声明，以避免被批评或争论。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Originally referring to increasing a character's defense in games, now used online to mean adding disclaimers when expressing opinions to avoid criticism or arguments.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指的是在多人在线游戏中，尤其是MOBA、MMORPG、FPS类型游戏中，某个玩家在别人快要击杀敌人时，抢先攻击并获得最后击杀，从而获得更多的奖励和成就感。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: In multiplayer online games, especially MOBA, MMORPG, and FPS, the act of attacking an enemy just before another player kills them to secure the final hit and gain extra rewards and satisfaction.

conv_def_en: Having mineral resources at home
slang_definition: 用于形容一个人特别有钱，花钱非常大方，也可以用来吐槽某件事情非常烧钱或价格过高。
slang_definition_en: Used to describe someone who is very wealthy and spends money generously, or to criticize something as very expensive or costly.
sentence_with_blank: 看到他换了一辆新车，又买了一堆奢侈品，果然是<BLANK>的人。
sentence_with_blank_en: Seeing that he bought a new car and a bunch of luxury goods, he really is a <BLANK> person.
example_sentence: 看到他换了一辆新车，又买了一堆奢侈品，果然是家里有矿的人。
distractor_1_slang_def: 指人骄傲自满，获得一点成绩后洋洋得意。如今多用于自黑和自我调侃，不再是贬义，而是一种开玩笑的方式。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: To feel proud and complacent after a small achievement, often used humorously for self-mockery rather than as a criticism.
distractor_2_slang_def: 用以表达对这种表面关心的调侃和不满。通常由女生用来讽刺那些认为自己在关心女生，但实际上只是在说空话的男生。也可以被用作男生对被称为“直男”这种评价的不满反驳。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A sarcastic expression used to mock insincere or superficial concern, often by women toward men who pretend to care but only speak empty words, and sometimes by men to rebut being labeled as unimaginative or insensitive.
distractor_3_slang_def: 用来形容一个人对另一个人产生了强烈的爱慕或者喜欢，心被对方“偷走”，因而将对方称作“偷心盗贼”。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A term describing someone who has strongly captivated another person's affection, as if "stealing" their heart.

conv_def_en: A type of crustacean seafood with a broad body and a shell patterned like flowers.
conv_def: 一种甲壳类海鲜，体形宽大，壳呈花纹状的蟹。
slang_definition: 指代那些无故妨碍他人，损人不利己，不懂团队合作的人。
slang_definition_en: Someone who obstructs others without reason, harms others without benefiting themselves, and lacks teamwork skills.
sentence_with_blank: 他总是喜欢在团队项目中扯后腿，真是个<BLANK>。
sentence_with_blank_en: He always likes to hold the team back in group projects; he is really a <BLANK>.
example_sentence: 他总是喜欢在团队项目中扯后腿，真是个花蟹。
distractor_1_slang_def: 用来夸大和赞美某些场景或事物，表示其具有显著的优势或与竞争者之间存在较大差距。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Used to exaggerate and praise a situation or thing, indicating a significant advantage or a large gap compared to competitors.
distractor_2_slang_def: 用来形容一个人没有志气、颓废没落、懒惰消极、不努力、没有骨气、没有前途和希望，做事总是一事无成，是一种对人生活状态或性格的负面评价。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Describes a person who is unambitious, lazy, lacking drive and integrity, with no prospects or hope, consistently failing in their endeavors; a negative evaluation of one's life state or character.
distractor_3_slang_def: 用来调侃他与凤姐（罗玉凤）在吹牛炒作方面的相似之处。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Used to mock his similarity to Luo Yufeng (Feng Jie) in bragging and self-promotion.

conv_def_en: Tree hollow
slang_definition: 尤其是在无法对身边人直接表达时，常通过网络匿名平台诉说。
slang_definition_en: An anonymous online platform used especially to share feelings when unable to express them directly to people nearby.
sentence_with_blank: 我今天心情不好，找个<BLANK>倾诉一下。
sentence_with_blank_en: I am in a bad mood today and want to find a <BLANK> to talk to.
example_sentence: 我今天心情不好，找个树洞倾诉一下。
distractor_1_slang_def: 用于表达对他人精彩和有趣发言的欣赏和赞美。它建议将这些发言整理成书，并表示如果缺乏资金，可以通过众筹的方式筹集资金。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A phrase expressing admiration for someone's brilliant and interesting remarks, suggesting compiling them into a book and funding it through crowdfunding if necessary.
distractor_2_slang_def: 具有一种无奈妥协的意味，表示在不情愿的情况下勉强同意或妥协。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Expressing reluctant agreement or compromise with a sense of helpless resignation.
distractor_3_slang_def: 非常懒惰的人被称为“得了懒癌”，形容这种懒散的状态如同不治之症。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: An extremely lazy person, described as having a laziness so severe it is like an incurable disease.

conv_def_en: Hold a wedding ceremony on the spot.
slang_definition: 指对一对情侣或CP（情侣配对）非常看好，并希望他们能够立刻在一起。并不意味着真的要在原地结婚，而是表达对他们关系的祝福和期待。
slang_definition_en: A phrase expressing strong support and hope for a couple to be together immediately, symbolizing blessings and anticipation for their relationship.
sentence_with_blank: 看完这部剧后，所有观众都希望男女主演能<BLANK>，因为他们的互动实在是太甜了。
sentence_with_blank_en: After watching this drama, all the viewers hope the male and female leads can <BLANK> because their interactions are just too sweet.
example_sentence: 看完这部剧后，所有观众都希望男女主演能原地结婚，因为他们的互动实在是太甜了。
distractor_1_slang_def: 用来形容团队中那些几乎没有上场机会、被边缘化的正式成员，他们只能在团队中打杂或做后勤工作。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A formal team member who is marginalized and rarely participates, only handling miscellaneous or logistical tasks.
distractor_2_slang_def: 用于赞美某些视频剪辑质量非常高，内容流畅，观赏体验如同德芙巧克力般顺滑。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Used to praise video edits that are high-quality, smooth, and enjoyable like Dove chocolate.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指人或事物表面光鲜亮丽，但实际上没有内涵，徒有其表，常用来形容虚伪或注重外表但忽略内在的情况。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Describes someone or something that appears shiny and attractive on the surface but lacks substance, often used to denote superficiality or hypocrisy.

conv_def_en: Confusing behavior that causes bewilderment.
slang_definition: 指那些让人感到不解、很奇怪或耐人寻味的行为。在网络语境中，这个词语通常用来形容那些看似无厘头、让人感到困惑甚至有些搞笑的举动，但随着时间推移，逐渐也带有一些批判意味。
slang_definition_en: Actions that are confusing, strange, or puzzling, often seemingly nonsensical and sometimes humorous, but increasingly carrying a critical tone.
sentence_with_blank: 他竟然在图书馆大声地背诵课文，真是让人佩服的<BLANK>。
sentence_with_blank_en: He actually loudly recited the text in the library, which is truly admirable <BLANK>.
example_sentence: 他竟然在图书馆大声地背诵课文，真是让人佩服的迷惑行为。
distractor_1_slang_def: 形象地描述了不切实际且夸张的战斗场景。起源于网友的调侃，讲述了一种通过滑铲动作抵挡并击败老虎的不可思议操作，常用来讽刺或幽默地描述虚构或夸大其词的情况。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A humorous or sarcastic term describing an unrealistic and exaggerated combat scenario where sliding tackles are used to fend off and defeat a tiger.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指的是学生在完成作业时，依赖搜题软件而不是自己思考，是一种利用科技手段快速完成任务的行为。这种说法常用于对依赖技术进行学习的调侃。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Refers to students relying on question-solving apps instead of thinking independently to quickly complete assignments, often used humorously to describe dependence on technology for learning.
distractor_3_slang_def: 表现出的目瞪口呆、茫然不知所措的表情。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: An expression showing stunned confusion and helplessness.

slang: 钓鱼穷三年玩鸟毁一生
conv_def_en: Fishing causes three years of poverty; birdwatching ruins a lifetime.
conv_def: 钓鱼导致三年贫穷，玩鸟毁掉一生
slang_definition: "钓鱼穷三年，玩鸟毁一生" 是一句警示语，意在告诫年轻人不要玩物丧志，要把精力集中在学习和奋斗上。强调在年轻时过多沉迷于钓鱼和玩鸟等消遣活动，会影响自我成长和发展。
slang_definition_en: A warning advising young people not to waste time on hobbies like fishing and birdwatching, as it can hinder personal growth and development.
sentence_with_blank: 他总是沉迷于钓鱼，我只好提醒他一句：“钓鱼穷三年，玩鸟毁一生。”
sentence_with_blank_en: He is always obsessed with fishing, so I have to remind him: "Fishing ruins three years, playing with birds destroys a lifetime."
example_sentence: 他总是沉迷于钓鱼，我只好提醒他一句：“钓鱼穷三年，玩鸟毁一生。”
distractor_1_slang_def: 指的是歌手决定不再在公开场合演唱歌曲，隐退歌坛，告别舞台的行为。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: The act of a singer deciding to retire from performing publicly and leaving the music scene.
distractor_2_slang_def: 原指心态崩溃或遭受重大打击，现在也可以用来形容情绪失控或受到极大冲击。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Originally meaning a mental breakdown or severe blow, now also used to describe losing emotional control or being greatly shocked.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指网络游戏中玩家刚开始游戏时的起始地点。它通常是为了帮助新手玩家熟悉游戏而设立的区域，提供各类功能NPC、任务以及游戏教学。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: The starting area in online games designed to help new players learn the game with NPCs, quests, and tutorials.

conv_def_en: An ominous star that foretells death.
slang_definition: 代表即将面临死亡或悲惨结局的预兆。在现代网络语境中，当人们调侃或预感到某种灾难即将降临时，常引用这个梗。
slang_definition_en: A sign or omen indicating imminent death or a tragic outcome.
sentence_with_blank: 面对即将到来的考试周，小明感叹道：“感觉这门课就是我的<BLANK>，看完这周的复习计划，我都快要透不过气来了。”
sentence_with_blank_en: Facing the upcoming exam week, Xiaoming sighed, "It feels like this course is my <BLANK>; after looking at this week's review plan, I can hardly breathe."
example_sentence: 面对即将到来的考试周，小明感叹道：“感觉这门课就是我的死兆星，看完这周的复习计划，我都快要透不过气来了。”
distractor_1_slang_def: 指的是将两件或多件看似不相关或不协调的事物放在一起时产生的不舒适感或不适应感。相反的说法是"毫无违和感"，意指这些事物放在一起看上去自然协调，仿佛原本就应该在一起。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A feeling of discomfort or incongruity when two or more seemingly unrelated or mismatched things are placed together.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指那些表面上体贴，但实际心机重，喜欢贬低别人男友以显得自己更好的男生。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A guy who appears considerate but is actually scheming and belittles others' boyfriends to make himself look better.
distractor_3_slang_def: 用于形容不知轻重、不顾危险的行为，相当于"自寻死路"。多用于吐槽某人做出了可能引发危险的行为，常带有喜剧效果。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Engaging in reckless behavior that invites trouble or danger.

conv_def_en: To possess or owe something to "Ge Ge" and then leave.
slang_definition: 用于形容热血、燃系BGM或歌曲响起所带来的激动氛围，常出现在剧情高潮或战斗场景。
slang_definition_en: Used to describe the exciting atmosphere created by intense, energetic background music or songs, often during climactic or battle scenes.
sentence_with_blank: 在《进击的巨人》激战开始时，弹幕上满是“<BLANK>”，观众都被燃得热血沸腾。
sentence_with_blank_en: At the start of the fierce battle in "Attack on Titan," the barrage was filled with "<BLANK>," and the audience was all fired up with passion.
example_sentence: 在《进击的巨人》激战开始时，弹幕上满是“占戈哥欠走已”，观众都被燃得热血沸腾。
distractor_1_slang_def: 用来表达一种强烈的认同感、激动或感慨，尤其是在遇到志同道合的人时。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Used to express strong agreement, excitement, or emotion, especially when meeting like-minded people.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指玩家通过语音等便利方式，组队进行对战类游戏的行为，通常能提升团队协作效率。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: The act of teaming up via voice communication to play competitive games, usually enhancing team coordination.
distractor_3_slang_def: 是指小时候因为观看某些恐怖的动画、影视作品或经历某些恐怖事件而留下的心理阴影。这些作品或事件之所以令人产生阴影，是因为它们包含了令人不安、恐怖或不适宜儿童观看的内容，而通常是在孩子心智尚未成熟时观看的，因而影响较深。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Psychological trauma from childhood exposure to frightening media or events.

conv_def_en: Security guard's diary
slang_definition: 它的内容通常是一些普通但搞笑的小事。因其诙谐逗趣的文字风格而受到大众喜爱，并在网络上迅速走红。
slang_definition_en: A popular online diary featuring humorous and ordinary daily anecdotes.
sentence_with_blank: “昨天又刷了一整天的<BLANK>，每篇都笑到肚子疼，这些编故事的网友真有才！”
sentence_with_blank_en: Yesterday I spent the whole day scrolling through <BLANK> again, laughing until my stomach hurt at every post; these creative story-telling netizens are really talented!
example_sentence: “昨天又刷了一整天的保安日记，每篇都笑到肚子疼，这些编故事的网友真有才！”
distractor_1_slang_def: 伴随劲爆电子音乐，风靡网络。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A popular dance style accompanied by energetic electronic music.
distractor_2_slang_def: 表示敷衍和摆烂，用来应对无理取闹、尖酸刻薄的人或无端指责，表达不屑与对方计较或合作的情绪。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: An expression used to dismissively respond to unreasonable complaints or criticisms, indicating indifference and refusal to engage.
distractor_3_slang_def: 用来形容那些爱吹牛的人，他们说到做不到，只会空谈。在ACGN文化中，“打嘴炮”也指主角通过口若悬河的言论或声嘶力竭的喊叫对敌人施加心理或精神上的影响，作为一种语言武器。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: To boast or talk big without taking action; in ACGN culture, to use persuasive or loud speech as a psychological weapon against opponents.

conv_def_en: Acting style like dishwashing detergent.
slang_definition: 对演员演技的肯定，特指黄晓明在电视剧《鬓边不是海棠红》中的演技突破了以往的油腻感，被形容为像洗洁精一样去油。
slang_definition_en: A compliment for an actor's performance, specifically praising Huang Xiaoming's breakthrough in the TV drama "The Sleuth of Ming Dynasty" for removing his usual greasy acting style, likened to how dishwashing liquid removes oil.
sentence_with_blank: 黄晓明这次在《鬓边不是海棠红》里的表现真的不油腻，被网友称为<BLANK>。
sentence_with_blank_en: Huang Xiaoming's performance in "Winter Begonia" this time is really not greasy, and he was praised by netizens as <BLANK>.
example_sentence: 黄晓明这次在《鬓边不是海棠红》里的表现真的不油腻，被网友称为洗洁精式演技。
distractor_1_slang_def: 指的是一种看似强颜欢笑的表情，表达面对艰辛生活时的无奈和尴尬。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A facial expression showing a forced smile that conveys helplessness and awkwardness in the face of a difficult life.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指的是不愿意或无法在现实中生养小孩的人，通过网络观看萌娃视频和图片来暂时满足对养娃的渴望。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Refers to people who, unwilling or unable to have children in real life, satisfy their desire for parenting by watching cute baby videos and pictures online.
distractor_3_slang_def: 通常用于描述一种人们规避尴尬或打脸时的反应。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Typically used to describe a person's reaction of staying silent to avoid embarrassment or contradiction.

conv_def_en: A sport or game played by multiple people together.
conv_def: 多人一起进行的体育运动或游戏
slang_definition: 指的是一种隐晦的调侃，起源于指责明星私生活不检点，后来被网友用于形容一些多人参与的活动，以幽默方式避开原本的敏感话题。
slang_definition_en: A euphemistic slang originally criticizing celebrities' promiscuity, later humorously used to describe activities involving multiple participants.
sentence_with_blank: 最近和朋友打牌到半夜，结果被调侃说我们在进行“<BLANK>”。
sentence_with_blank_en: Recently, I played cards with friends until midnight and ended up being teased that we were having a "<BLANK>".
example_sentence: 最近和朋友打牌到半夜，结果被调侃说我们在进行“多人运动”。
distractor_1_slang_def: 用来形容当单身人士看到情侣秀恩爱时感受到的羡慕、嫉妒、甚至是自嘲的心理状态。这里的“狗”指的是“单身狗”，是网络流行的自嘲称呼，而非真实的狗。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A term describing the feelings of envy, jealousy, or self-mockery experienced by single people when seeing couples display affection.
distractor_2_slang_def: 放手去做的态度。无论遇到什么事情，不必多想，直接行动。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: An attitude of boldly taking action without overthinking.
distractor_3_slang_def: 通常通过故事传递道理，具有激励性和正能量，但有时被批评为缺乏实际意义。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Inspirational and motivational stories or messages that convey positive values but are sometimes criticized for lacking practical significance.

conv_def_en: Tool used to increase scores
slang_definition: 指的是在游戏中帮助别人提高分数的一方，通常带有被利用的意味，特别指一些男性为了追求女性而帮助她们提升游戏排名，而这些女性仅仅是为了游戏成绩，并不对他们产生其他感情。
slang_definition_en: A player who helps others improve their game ranking, often exploited, especially when men assist women seeking higher scores without mutual romantic interest.
sentence_with_blank: 小明每天都带她打排位，结果才知道自己只是个<BLANK>。
sentence_with_blank_en: Xiaoming plays ranked matches with her every day, only to find out that he is just a <BLANK>.
example_sentence: 小明每天都带她打排位，结果才知道自己只是个上分工具。
distractor_1_slang_def: 经常用于动漫和鬼畜二创作品，使得人物的眼睛看起来像能发出犀利的红光。这种特效通常用于展现人物的酷炫、专注或带有危险的气息，常伴随夸张的表情或文本，具有强烈反差的喜剧效果，也用于营造装逼时刻。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A visual effect commonly used in anime and remix works that makes characters' eyes appear to emit sharp red light, conveying coolness, focus, danger, or exaggerated comedic contrast.
distractor_2_slang_def: 用来形容一个人在某一领域拥有令人难以企及的天赋或与生俱来的条件。这些条件是后天努力无法改变的，使得他们在该领域中能够轻松取得成功。如果拥有这些天赋的人还特别努力，就更让人望尘莫及。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Describes someone with innate, exceptional talent in a field that cannot be matched by effort alone, enabling effortless success.
distractor_3_slang_def: 因其魔性感觉而在网络上走红。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Popular online for its magical and sexy vibe.

conv_def_en: Makka Pakka (animated character name)
slang_definition: 背景音乐是根据动画角色玛卡巴卡创作的魔性BGM。
slang_definition_en: A catchy background music inspired by the animated character Makka Pakka.
sentence_with_blank: 最近抖音上很多人在玩<BLANK>挑战，舞蹈真是又可爱又有趣。
sentence_with_blank_en: Recently, many people on Douyin are playing the <BLANK> challenge, and the dance is really cute and fun.
example_sentence: 最近抖音上很多人在玩玛卡巴卡挑战，舞蹈真是又可爱又有趣。
distractor_1_slang_def: 用于调侃那些频繁出现在某个社交平台或社区的人或事，形象地比喻他们如同在此“定居”一般。这个表达可以变形用于其他社交平台，意指某人总是出现在你的视野中。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A humorous expression used to tease people or topics that frequently appear on a social platform, metaphorically suggesting they have "settled" there.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指人在没有实际经历过的情况下，对某个场景产生强烈曾经见过或经历过的感觉。该词来自法语"Déjà vu"，意为"已经看过"，也指一种似曾相识的感觉。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A strong feeling of having already seen or experienced a scene despite no actual prior experience.
distractor_3_slang_def: 形象地形容挨打受处罚。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Vividly describes being beaten or punished.

conv_def_en: Knock the baby bottle away from you.
slang_definition: 用来回怼对方奶声奶气、不够成熟的话语，风趣地讽刺对方幼稚。
slang_definition_en: A humorous retort mocking someone's immature or childish remarks.
sentence_with_blank: 你这样说话太奶里奶气了，小心我<BLANK>。
sentence_with_blank_en: You talk so effeminately, be careful or I will <BLANK>.
example_sentence: 你这样说话太奶里奶气了，小心我奶瓶给你打掉。
distractor_1_slang_def: 原指经验丰富、行事稳健的人，特别是在某些领域内具备丰富经验和资源的人，尤其是在ACGN文化等特定领域，并常用于指那些收藏或分享R-18资源（如成人向作品）的人。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A person experienced and knowledgeable, especially in specific fields like ACGN culture, often referring to someone who collects or shares adult-oriented (R-18) content.
distractor_2_slang_def: 形容一个人行为大胆、放肆，很"浪"或很敢于冒险。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Describes someone who acts boldly, recklessly, or takes daring risks.
distractor_3_slang_def: 用来吐槽或调侃男生的行为，表示男生不解风情、善变或不可靠。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A term used to mock or tease men for being insensitive, fickle, or unreliable.

conv_def_en: To run away carrying a bucket.
slang_definition: 指因为不满工作环境或其他原因，选择离职的一种自嘲方式，形象地体现了外出务工者离职时的状态和心情。
slang_definition_en: A self-deprecating term for quitting a job due to dissatisfaction with the work environment or other reasons.
sentence_with_blank: 这家工厂太黑了，我决定明天<BLANK>。
sentence_with_blank_en: This factory is too shady, so I have decided to <BLANK> tomorrow.
example_sentence: 这家工厂太黑了，我决定明天提桶跑路。
distractor_1_slang_def: “淡人”和“浓人”是一种网络用语，分别用来描述两种不同性格的人。淡人是指那些个性较为平稳、情绪不常剧烈波动的人，通常表现为淡泊名利、宁静致远。浓人则是指情绪丰富、表现外向的人，他们的言行举止充满表达情绪的词汇。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: "Dàn rén" refers to calm, steady individuals with mild emotions, while "nóng rén" describes expressive, outgoing people with rich emotions.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指一时糊涂的傻子，通俗叫法是二愣子、愣头青。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A momentarily confused fool; a simpleton.
distractor_3_slang_def: 同时具备温柔可爱的“奶”属性和强势有安全感的“狼”属性。这个形容词用来评价既能撒娇卖萌，又能展现男友力的男生。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Describes a boy who is both gentle and cute, yet strong and protective.

conv_def_en: Already turned black in color
slang_definition: 原意指角色变得邪恶，立场改变。如今在网络上常作为一种时尚标签，表示一种态度，比如受到打击后情绪变化，并不是真正的邪恶。
slang_definition_en: Originally meaning a character turning evil or changing stance, now used online as a trendy label indicating an attitude shift after setbacks, not true evil.
sentence_with_blank: 妹妹感觉最近总是对谁都不耐烦，真像个“（<BLANK>）”的角色。
sentence_with_blank_en: My younger sister feels like she has been impatient with everyone lately, truly like a “(<BLANK>)” character.
example_sentence: 妹妹感觉最近总是对谁都不耐烦，真像个“（已黑化）”的角色。
distractor_1_slang_def: 是用来吐槽恐怖游戏或解谜游戏中道具打火机的不科学设定。在游戏中，打火机常作为唯一的光源，能在长时间的游戏过程中始终保持亮度，燃料似乎用之不竭，像是由核能驱动一样。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A term used to criticize the unrealistic design of lighters in horror or puzzle games that serve as a constant, inexhaustible light source, as if powered by nuclear energy.
distractor_2_slang_def: 形容某人想要快速逃跑，比火车还快，表达急切和夸张的逃跑方式。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Describes someone trying to escape quickly, faster than a train, expressing urgency and exaggeration.
distractor_3_slang_def: 从而暂时逃避责任或避免面对棘手的情况的人，或者用来缓解尴尬局面。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A temporary escape from responsibility or avoidance of a difficult situation, often used to ease an awkward moment.

conv_def_en: Electric vehicle challenges
slang_definition: 考察在危急情况下的道德决策问题。通常为两难选择：牺牲少数人以拯救多数人，还是保持不作为，看似客观将在情感和理性之间求取平衡。它揭示了各种道德哲学立场之间的冲突，特别是对功利主义的挑战。
slang_definition_en: A moral dilemma involving a choice between sacrificing a few to save many or taking no action, highlighting conflicts between emotional and rational ethics and challenging utilitarianism.
sentence_with_blank: 在这场讨论会上，大家争论不休，仿佛把公司面临的选择与<BLANK>相提并论，我们究竟该如何妥善解决问题呢？
sentence_with_blank_en: At this discussion meeting, everyone argued endlessly, as if equating the choices the company faces with <BLANK>; how exactly should we properly resolve the issues?
example_sentence: 在这场讨论会上，大家争论不休，仿佛把公司面临的选择与电车难题相提并论，我们究竟该如何妥善解决问题呢？
distractor_1_slang_def: 用来形容那些既有大哥般霸气，又有大姐般温柔的性格特征的人，或者性别不易辨别但充满个人魅力的人。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A person who combines the boldness of a big brother with the gentleness of a big sister, or whose gender is ambiguous but exudes personal charm.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指极度愤怒，愤怒到极致，甚至超越了愤怒的感觉，达到一种无法再愤怒的状态。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Extreme anger beyond the usual feeling of anger, reaching a state where one cannot be angrier.
distractor_3_slang_def: 意在让人离远点。它在网络上流行起来作为一种不带脏字的方式来说脏话。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A playful phrase used online to tell someone to go away without using profanity.

conv_def_en: A Dove chocolate in human form.
slang_definition: 用于赞美某些视频剪辑质量非常高，内容流畅，观赏体验如同德芙巧克力般顺滑。
slang_definition_en: Used to praise video edits that are high-quality, smooth, and enjoyable like Dove chocolate.
sentence_with_blank: 这个MV编辑得简直太好了，画面和音乐配合得无懈可击，真是<BLANK>啊！
sentence_with_blank_en: This MV is edited so perfectly, with the visuals and music matching flawlessly, it’s truly <BLANK>!
example_sentence: 这个MV编辑得简直太好了，画面和音乐配合得无懈可击，真是人间德芙啊！
distractor_1_slang_def: 因其在剧中将自己的名字误说成“谢飞机”，且具有搞怪的演技和夸张的舞技，逐渐走红网络。这个角色的有趣特质以及尴尬时刻被广泛制作成表情包，受到网友热捧。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A humorous nickname originating from a character who mistakenly says their name as "Xie Feiji," known for quirky acting and exaggerated dance moves, widely popularized online through memes.
distractor_2_slang_def: 是用来形容某人能力不足、资历浅或者没有地位的表达方式。通常带有轻蔑和调侃的意味。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A derogatory and teasing expression used to describe someone as inexperienced, lacking ability, or having low status.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指在表演中通过铺垫，在关键时刻揭示出令人意想不到的幽默或主题，使作品更具吸引力和感染力。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: In performance, revealing an unexpected humorous or thematic element at a key moment to enhance appeal and impact.

conv_def_en: Plum blossoms bloom a second time.
slang_definition: 意思是指同一件事成功地做到两次。在不同语境中，它有不同的用法：在足球中，指同一球员在一场比赛中进了两球；在视频中，指同一个镜头或情节出现两次。
slang_definition_en: Achieving the same success twice in the same context, such as scoring two goals in one soccer match or a scene appearing twice in a video.
sentence_with_blank: 在昨天的比赛中，梅西<BLANK>，帮助球队取得胜利。
sentence_with_blank_en: In yesterday's match, Messi <BLANK>, helping the team secure victory.
example_sentence: 在昨天的比赛中，梅西梅开二度，帮助球队取得胜利。
distractor_1_slang_def: 指人在没有实际经历过的情况下，对某个场景产生强烈曾经见过或经历过的感觉。该词来自法语"Déjà vu"，意为"已经看过"，也指一种似曾相识的感觉。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A strong feeling of having already seen or experienced a scene despite no actual prior experience.
distractor_2_slang_def: 通常用于反问或讽刺，表示某个情况不应该怪罪到自己头上。它可以用于轻松地化解尴尬或结束讨论。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Used rhetorically or sarcastically to deny responsibility and deflect blame.
distractor_3_slang_def: 实则讽刺、调侃某人或某事的技巧，相比直接抨击更优雅且不易引起反感。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A subtle and elegant way to mock or criticize someone or something without causing offense.

conv_def_en: Two chefs extremely delighted
slang_definition: 是指同时喜欢两个作品的粉丝看到两个作品在同一场合、视频或作品中出现时感到特别高兴或兴奋的情绪。
slang_definition_en: The excitement felt by fans who like two works simultaneously when both appear together in the same event, video, or work.
sentence_with_blank: 当我最爱的动漫角色和我喜欢的游戏角色在这个联动活动中相遇，我立刻就<BLANK>了。
sentence_with_blank_en: When my favorite anime character and the game character I like met in this crossover event, I immediately <BLANK>.
example_sentence: 当我最爱的动漫角色和我喜欢的游戏角色在这个联动活动中相遇，我立刻就双厨狂喜了。
distractor_1_slang_def: 指的是胸部的上半部分露出。它常用于二次元文化中，与“南半球”相对。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: The upper half of the chest exposed, commonly used in anime and manga culture, opposite of "southern hemisphere."
distractor_2_slang_def: 指那些在恋爱关系中坚持纯真、无私、高尚的爱情观的人。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A person who upholds pure, selfless, and noble views on love in romantic relationships.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指人中，与“下巴”相对应。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: The philtrum, corresponding to the chin.

conv_def_en: Green arrow
slang_definition: 指那些表面上体贴，但实际心机重，喜欢贬低别人男友以显得自己更好的男生。
slang_definition_en: A guy who appears considerate but is actually scheming and belittles others' boyfriends to make himself look better.
sentence_with_blank: 他总是当着别人的面赞美我的女友，真是个典型的<BLANK>。
sentence_with_blank_en: He always praises my girlfriend in front of others; he is truly a typical <BLANK>.
example_sentence: 他总是当着别人的面赞美我的女友，真是个典型的绿箭。
distractor_1_slang_def: 通常用于短视频评论中，意指视频内容是演绎的，而非真实发生的事件。这一评论有时是为了讽刺视频的不真实，也可能是单纯的玩梗。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Used in short video comments to indicate the content is acted out rather than real, often sarcastically or as a joke.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指的是女主角在怀孕的情况下，选择离开男主角，独自抚养孩子。这里的“球”指的是怀孕的大肚子。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Refers to a pregnant woman leaving the man to raise the child alone.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指的是超出了极限或标准的测量范围，无法计量。通常表示某种程度极高、非常厉害或强大的意思。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Exceeding the limit or measurement range, indicating an extremely high level or great strength.

conv_def_en: Directly address someone as an expert.
slang_definition: 用来调侃一些看似专业、实则不太聪明甚至搞笑的行为或者选择。虽然表面上给予了高度评价，但实际上是一种反讽和自嘲。
slang_definition_en: Used sarcastically to mock actions or choices that appear professional but are actually unwise or amusing.
sentence_with_blank: 小伙去高档餐厅用优惠券只点泡面，老板看了<BLANK>。
sentence_with_blank_en: The young man went to a high-end restaurant and used a coupon to order only instant noodles, and the owner looked <BLANK>.
example_sentence: 小伙去高档餐厅用优惠券只点泡面，老板看了直呼内行。
distractor_1_slang_def: 指的是在言语上吹牛、说得好听但做不到的人。多用于吐槽那些光说不练、承诺无法兑现的行为，含有吹牛、撩骚的意思。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Boasting or talking big without following through, often used to criticize empty promises or flirtatious talk.
distractor_2_slang_def: 意指在关键时刻掉链子或表现不佳。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: To fail or perform poorly at a critical moment.
distractor_3_slang_def: 意指消除一个人身边的所有备胎（恋爱候选人），而成为其唯一的恋爱对象。这个说法源于将备胎比喻为鱼塘里的鱼，而拥有较多备胎的人被称为“海王”。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: To eliminate all a person's romantic alternatives and become their sole romantic partner.

slang: 请问哪里能买到您的著作
conv_def_en: May I ask where I can buy your book?
conv_def: 请问在哪里可以买到您的书籍
slang_definition: 用于形容某人的观点或评论非常经典或深刻，以至于值得被“撰写成书”。
slang_definition_en: Used to describe someone's opinion or comment as so classic or profound that it deserves to be "written into a book."
sentence_with_blank: 在知乎上看到一个用户详细分析了某事件的前因后果，评论区有人回复：“<BLANK>？”
sentence_with_blank_en: On Zhihu, I saw a user thoroughly analyze the causes and effects of a certain event, and someone replied in the comments: "<BLANK>?"
example_sentence: 在知乎上看到一个用户详细分析了某事件的前因后果，评论区有人回复：“请问哪里能买到您的著作？”
distractor_1_slang_def: 用来调侃或讽刺一个人的智商水平较低。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A term used to mock or sarcastically refer to someone’s low intelligence level.
distractor_2_slang_def: 源自外网博主Cyranek分享的一个魔性斗舞视频，视频中两个火柴人鬼畜地摇摆身体，动作像是被电击一样，整个过程持续了三分钟左右，十分搞笑夸张。随着视频在网络上的传播，国内的网友们对其进行了二次创作，将这些滑稽的动作变成了嘲讽他人的素材。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A mocking gesture mimicking exaggerated, electric-like dance moves from a viral stick figure video used to ridicule others.
distractor_3_slang_def: 通过快速眨眼跳过不流畅画面，使视觉上感觉顺畅的调侃方式。这只是一种玩笑，没有实际作用于改善性能。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A humorous way of saying that quickly blinking skips choppy frames to make visuals appear smoother, without actually improving performance.

conv_def_en: Wiggins' health-preserving lifestyle combined with basketball.
conv_def: 维金斯的养生方式与篮球运动
slang_definition: 这个梗用来形容NBA球员安德鲁·维金斯在比赛中轻松稳重的打法风格，注重节省体力，不做高强度动作。
slang_definition_en: A term describing NBA player Andrew Wiggins' relaxed and steady playing style that conserves energy without intense physical exertion.
sentence_with_blank: 维金斯这场比赛得分虽高，但他依旧展示了“<BLANK>”的风采，轻松驾驭比赛。
sentence_with_blank_en: Although Wiggins scored high in this game, he still demonstrated the style of "<BLANK>" and easily controlled the match.
example_sentence: 维金斯这场比赛得分虽高，但他依旧展示了“维金斯养生篮球”的风采，轻松驾驭比赛。
distractor_1_slang_def: 指因为不满工作环境或其他原因，选择离职的一种自嘲方式，形象地体现了外出务工者离职时的状态和心情。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A self-deprecating term for quitting a job due to dissatisfaction with the work environment or other reasons.
distractor_2_slang_def: 通常由制作方特意添加，供玩家或观众发现。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: An intentional hidden feature or message added by creators for players or viewers to discover.
distractor_3_slang_def: 形容那些长相平平或不太好看，但身材出色的男人。比喻如同虾这种食物一样，去掉头部后，身体部分令人喜爱。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A term describing men with average or unattractive faces but attractive bodies, likened to shrimp whose body is appealing after removing the head.

conv_def_en: Falling flat on a level surface.
slang_definition: 指在没有任何障碍的平地上自己摔倒，通常用于形容一个人可爱、冒失或有点天然呆。
slang_definition_en: Falling flat on a level surface, often describing someone as cute, clumsy, or a bit airheaded.
sentence_with_blank: 她在走路的时候突然来了个<BLANK>，大家都觉得她很可爱。
sentence_with_blank_en: She suddenly did a <BLANK> while walking, and everyone thought she was very cute.
example_sentence: 她在走路的时候突然来了个平地摔，大家都觉得她很可爱。
distractor_1_slang_def: 表示玩家或队伍的操作非常烂，让观众觉得是在看一个顶级的菜鸟表演。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Refers to a player or team's extremely poor performance, making viewers feel like they are watching a top-level novice.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指用武力告诫他人，让其警惕并承担责任。可用于警告他人下一次会采取更激烈措施。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A warning using physical force to alert someone to be cautious and take responsibility, implying more severe measures may follow.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指作曲精湛、影响广泛的音乐作品。这些作品通常因其卓越的艺术水准和广泛的受众认可而被称为“神曲”。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A music piece renowned for its excellent composition and widespread influence.

conv_def_en: Meat of a penguin
slang_definition: 用来形容两个人沟通不在一个频道上，一方认真说话，另一方随意回应甚至故意气人，打断谈话。
slang_definition_en: Describes a situation where two people fail to communicate effectively, with one speaking seriously and the other responding casually or provocatively, interrupting the conversation.
sentence_with_blank: 她抱怨了一大堆，他却回了句“笑死<BLANK>”，气得她说不出话。
sentence_with_blank_en: She complained a lot, but he just replied with "laughing to death <BLANK>", which made her so angry that she was speechless.
example_sentence: 她抱怨了一大堆，他却回了句“笑死企鹅肉”，气得她说不出话。
distractor_1_slang_def: 跟“傻乐”形成对比，用于形容在困难未到来之前就感到悲观的人。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A person who feels pessimistic before difficulties actually occur.
distractor_2_slang_def: 尤其是指从网络恋爱到现实恋爱的转变。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: The transition from an online romantic relationship to an in-person romantic relationship.
distractor_3_slang_def: 是用来表示不再闲聊或吹牛，要回去工作了。这里的“搬砖”是一种自嘲的说法，形容工作辛苦且工资不高的状态，也带有一种无奈的调侃，是对自己生活现状的一种幽默的反应。当用于评论“炫富”的内容时，还带有一种略微嫉妒或羡慕的语气。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A humorous, self-deprecating way to say one is stopping idle talk to return to hard, low-paid work, sometimes expressing mild envy when commenting on displays of wealth.

conv_def_en: Expert at serving water (metaphorically, someone who stays neutral).
slang_definition: 不偏袒任何一方的人。这个梗用来形容那些努力做到“一碗水端平”的人，特别是在复杂或容易引发争议的环境中。
slang_definition_en: A person who remains impartial and treats all sides fairly, especially in complex or contentious situations.
sentence_with_blank: 在公司中，她是个真正的<BLANK>，每个团队的意见她都认真倾听，确保大家都有发言的机会。
sentence_with_blank_en: In the company, she is a true <BLANK>, carefully listening to every team's opinions and ensuring everyone has a chance to speak.
example_sentence: 在公司中，她是个真正的端水大师，每个团队的意见她都认真倾听，确保大家都有发言的机会。
distractor_1_slang_def: 面对各种促销优惠活动，如“满减”“立减”等，尽管这些优惠方式标榜能够省钱，真正最省钱的方法其实是不购买任何商品。这是一种调侃和自嘲，因为大部分消费者最终还是会忍不住消费。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A humorous way to say the best way to save money during promotions is to not buy anything at all.
distractor_2_slang_def: 在网络文化中，“群青”成为一种鬼畜视频梗，通常当视频中某个角色发出长音时，制作者会将这一长音与YOASOBI的歌曲《群青》中的高音部分“啊”进行结合，同时将画面调成一种类似群青色的效果，形成一种戏谑和幽默的效果。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: In online culture, "群青" refers to a meme where a character's sustained note in a video is combined with the high-pitched "ah" from YOASOBI's song "群青," accompanied by a blue-toned visual effect for humorous impact.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指对一对情侣或CP（情侣配对）非常看好，并希望他们能够立刻在一起。并不意味着真的要在原地结婚，而是表达对他们关系的祝福和期待。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A phrase expressing strong support and hope for a couple to be together immediately, symbolizing blessings and anticipation for their relationship.

conv_def_en: So awkward that my toes grip the ground tightly.
conv_def: 尴尬到脚趾用力抓住地面
slang_definition: 用夸张的方式形容一种极度尴尬或羞耻的情绪。它描述人在感到尴尬时，脚趾会不自觉地蜷缩，就像在抓地一样。为了形容尴尬程度之高，网友们进一步扩展这种比喻，称脚趾抓地能抠出极大程度的东西，例如三室两厅或一个宇宙等。
slang_definition_en: An exaggerated expression describing an intense feeling of embarrassment or shame, likening involuntary curling of the toes to gripping the ground.
sentence_with_blank: 他在公司年会上表演了个魔术，结果道具失灵了，真是<BLANK>，一个大坑都被抠出来了。
sentence_with_blank_en: He performed a magic trick at the company annual meeting, but the props malfunctioned; it was really <BLANK>, and a big pit was even dug out.
example_sentence: 他在公司年会上表演了个魔术，结果道具失灵了，真是尬到我脚趾抓地，一个大坑都被抠出来了。
distractor_1_slang_def: 指的是那些在聚会时不聊八卦，而是专注于讨论如何赚钱的女生。总体上泛指专注于赚钱的女性。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A woman who focuses on discussing ways to make money rather than gossiping, generally referring to women dedicated to earning income.
distractor_2_slang_def: 是一个用来批评和讽刺那些通过无理取闹、扰乱公共秩序来获取利益的社会现象的网络用语。这种行为通常被形容为“会哭的孩子有糖吃”，意指通过不当手段达到目的。此外，这一说法也用来形容部分情况下，由于某些机构的不作为，人们不得不通过“闹”来争取本应得到的合法权益。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A slang term criticizing the social phenomenon where people gain benefits by causing disturbances or unreasonable complaints, often due to institutional inaction forcing them to protest for their rightful interests.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指一个人行为或言语过于骚，形容这种人像“骚鸡”，调侃他们小心被“关进鸡笼”。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A warning directed at someone whose behavior or speech is overly provocative, jokingly suggesting they might be "locked in a chicken coop."

conv_def_en: A top lane player of Mongolian ethnicity.
slang_definition: 指代一种敢于直言、不畏惧后果的勇士精神。
slang_definition_en: A spirit of bravery characterized by speaking boldly without fear of consequences.
sentence_with_blank: 他在直播间公开批评不合理的规则，真是个“<BLANK>”。
sentence_with_blank_en: He openly criticized the unreasonable rules in the live broadcast room, truly a "<BLANK>".
example_sentence: 他在直播间公开批评不合理的规则，真是个“蒙古上单”。
distractor_1_slang_def: 原本用于希望他人不经历自己经历过的悲伤。然而，这句话在网络上渐渐演变为一种具有矫情和自我感伤色彩的表达，甚至被网友用来调侃，故意在一些明显的常识后面加入这句话，增加戏剧效果。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Originally used to wish others never experience one's own sadness, it has evolved online into a melodramatic, self-pitying phrase often used humorously after obvious statements for dramatic effect.
distractor_2_slang_def: 是指为了完成某项任务或作品（如绘画、动画、作业等）而熬夜耗费大量时间和精力的行为。"肝"作为动词，意味着投入大量时间和精力。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Working intensively and staying up late to complete a task or project.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指的是游戏《Dota 2》中半人猛犸-马格纳斯的技能“獠牙冲刺”，技能动画像在颠勺一样。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Refers to the skill "Skewer" of the hero Magnus in the game Dota 2, whose animation resembles flipping a wok.

conv_def_en: A small white boat.
slang_definition: 这个梗来源于童谣《小白船》在电视剧《隐秘的角落》中的出现，成为了恐怖事件的预兆和象征。在剧中，每次这首童谣响起时都会发生命案，因此被赋予了阴森、恐怖的意味。
slang_definition_en: A reference to a children's song symbolizing ominous or terrifying events, popularized by its use as a murder premonition in the TV series "The Bad Kids."
sentence_with_blank: 看完《隐秘的角落》，再听到《<BLANK>》，心里一阵发毛，总感觉要发生什么不好的事情。
sentence_with_blank_en: After watching "The Bad Kids," hearing "<BLANK>" again gives me chills, as if something bad is about to happen.
example_sentence: 看完《隐秘的角落》，再听到《小白船》，心里一阵发毛，总感觉要发生什么不好的事情。
distractor_1_slang_def: 通常表示完了、死了、惨了，表达绝望或毫无希望的状态，也能指失望或反应冷淡。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Usually indicates failure, defeat, or despair; expresses hopelessness, disappointment, or a cold reaction.
distractor_2_slang_def: 由“亲爱的老师，期末了，你可爱的学生菜菜的，能不能捞捞我，呜呜呜”这句话缩写而成，是一种撒娇式的请求，表达大学生希望在期末考试时老师能宽容打分，帮助他们不挂科。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A playful, pleading phrase used by college students to ask teachers for leniency in grading during final exams.
distractor_3_slang_def: 最初是指一种特色小吃，但在网络上成为通过特殊的吆喝声来表达食物麻辣程度的搞笑梗。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Originally a type of spicy snack, it became an online humorous meme expressing the level of spiciness through a distinctive chant.

conv_def_en: Carrying a bucket into the factory.
slang_definition: 通常是因为不满意工作环境或生活条件。这个说法突出了工人们在工厂中不稳定的就业状态，也带有一定的调侃意味。
slang_definition_en: Leaving a factory job due to dissatisfaction with work or living conditions, highlighting workers' unstable employment status with a humorous tone.
sentence_with_blank: 最近这家工厂加班太多，待遇也不理想，我准备<BLANK>，看看别的地方有没有更好的机会。
sentence_with_blank_en: Recently, this factory has had too much overtime and the treatment is not ideal, so I am planning to <BLANK> and see if there are better opportunities elsewhere.
example_sentence: 最近这家工厂加班太多，待遇也不理想，我准备提桶进厂，看看别的地方有没有更好的机会。
distractor_1_slang_def: 用来形容那些试图撩很多人但始终成功不了，既像“海王”又像“舔狗”的人。通俗地说，海狗就是同时巴结讨好很多人的人，尽管多方撩拨，却仍显得卑微。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A person who tries to flirt with many people but never succeeds, resembling both a "player" and a "simp," often flattering multiple people yet appearing humble and unsuccessful.
distractor_2_slang_def: 用来警告某人注意言行，否则可能导致其账号被封。这句话带有一种俏皮的威胁意味，常用于提醒或调侃在网络上发表不当言论的人。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A playful warning that someone's account may be banned if they do not watch their behavior online.
distractor_3_slang_def: 主要用于讽刺利己主义者。它起源于一个网络投票事件，当时大多数人选择了免费的小布丁而不是科比复活。后来，这个词被用来攻击科比的粉丝和揭别人的伤疤，也可以用作无明确含义的底线梗。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A term used to mock selfish individuals, originating from an online poll where most chose a free pudding over Kobe Bryant's resurrection, later used to criticize Kobe fans, highlight others' vulnerabilities, or as a nonspecific punchline.

conv_def_en: A man surnamed Luo named Yulong.
slang_definition: 用来调侃他与凤姐（罗玉凤）在吹牛炒作方面的相似之处。
slang_definition_en: Used to mock his similarity to Luo Yufeng (Feng Jie) in bragging and self-promotion.
sentence_with_blank: 大家都知道龙哥言辞犀利，"<BLANK>"的称号果然名不虚传。
sentence_with_blank_en: Everyone knows that Brother Long is sharp-tongued; the title "<BLANK>" is truly well-deserved.
example_sentence: 大家都知道龙哥言辞犀利，"罗玉龙"的称号果然名不虚传。
distractor_1_slang_def: 指的是能够证明某事件真实发生的可靠证据，通常具备较强的说服力。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Reliable evidence that conclusively proves an event actually occurred.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指的是在网络上，尤其是论坛中，网民之间进行的激烈争吵或骂战，常涉及谩骂和揭露隐私。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: An intense online argument or verbal fight between netizens, often involving insults and personal attacks.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指两个作品之间产生关联，并且各自的角色可能同时出现在同一场景中。联动通常用于作品的宣传推广，与“乱入”不同（乱入可能出于致敬或恶搞等目的）。联动可能发生在相同或不同世界观的作品之间，发生在ACGN（动画、漫画、游戏、小说）各种载体之间。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A collaboration between two works where characters from each appear together, often for promotional purposes, distinct from random cameo appearances.

conv_def_en: A wizard with powerful magical abilities.
conv_def: 拥有强大魔法能力的魔法师
slang_definition: 这个梗指代年龄较大仍然保持处男身份的人。根据传说，保持处男之身到某个年龄就可成为魔法师，意味着处男时间越长，魔法能力越强。这是一种自嘲和调侃。
slang_definition_en: A humorous term for an older man who remains a virgin, implying that the longer one stays a virgin, the stronger their "magical" powers become.
sentence_with_blank: 他自嘲说自己30岁还是个<BLANK>，大家都笑了。
sentence_with_blank_en: He joked that he was still a <BLANK> at 30, and everyone laughed.
example_sentence: 他自嘲说自己30岁还是个大魔法师，大家都笑了。
distractor_1_slang_def: 指用说英语的方式来说中文，使得普通话带上一种英语发音的独特效果。这是一种娱乐性的语言游戏，不具备实际的语言功能。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A playful way of speaking Chinese with an English accent, used for entertainment without practical language function.
distractor_2_slang_def: 因其可爱迷人而得名。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Named for being cute and charming.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指在发表敏感言论后，可能面临惩罚或调查的风险，因此需要赶紧收拾贵重物品逃跑的幽默说法。是提醒和调侃某人因发表敏感言论而可能需要迅速“跑路”。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A humorous term referring to quickly packing valuables and fleeing after making sensitive remarks to avoid potential punishment or investigation.

conv_def_en: To kill a tiger using a sliding tackle motion.
slang_definition: 形象地描述了不切实际且夸张的战斗场景。起源于网友的调侃，讲述了一种通过滑铲动作抵挡并击败老虎的不可思议操作，常用来讽刺或幽默地描述虚构或夸大其词的情况。
slang_definition_en: A humorous or sarcastic term describing an unrealistic and exaggerated combat scenario where sliding tackles are used to fend off and defeat a tiger.
sentence_with_blank: 在游戏讨论中，他总喜欢说一些“<BLANK>”般的战术，听起来实在太不现实了。
sentence_with_blank_en: In game discussions, he always likes to talk about tactics like "<BLANK>", which sound completely unrealistic.
example_sentence: 在游戏讨论中，他总喜欢说一些“滑铲杀虎”般的战术，听起来实在太不现实了。
distractor_1_slang_def: 指赚取不道德或有损良心的钱，通常描述为了利益而进行不诚实的行为。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Earning money through unethical or dishonest means.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指那些说话嗲嗲的、恶意卖萌且习惯用“嘤嘤嘤”作为口癖的人。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A person who speaks in a cutesy, affected manner, maliciously acts cute, and habitually uses "ying ying ying" as a catchphrase.
distractor_3_slang_def: 用“鼠鼠”指代处于社会底层、卑微且微不足道的小人物，表达一种自我调侃的丧文化情绪。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Using "鼠鼠" to refer to insignificant, humble individuals at the bottom of society, expressing a self-mocking, defeatist attitude.

conv_def_en: Is older brother entering the fish pond?
slang_definition: 表示邀请对方成为自己的备胎之一。它暗指对方可能不是进入一个专一的爱情关系，而是成为其中许多个暧昧关系中的一个。
slang_definition_en: An invitation for someone to become one of multiple backup romantic interests rather than an exclusive partner.
sentence_with_blank: 小王对小丽表白时，小丽笑着说：“<BLANK>？可别太认真哦！”
sentence_with_blank_en: When Xiao Wang confessed to Xiao Li, Xiao Li smiled and said, "<BLANK>? Don't take it too seriously!"
example_sentence: 小王对小丽表白时，小丽笑着说：“哥哥进鱼塘吗？可别太认真哦！”
distractor_1_slang_def: 指在创作或表演中通过加入独特的行为或元素，使作品或表现更加出色和生动，起到画龙点睛的作用。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: To enhance a creation or performance by adding unique elements that make it more vivid and outstanding.
distractor_2_slang_def: 形容人因愤怒或其他情绪而睁大眼睛，并因此与哈士奇犬的表情相似。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Describes a person widening their eyes due to anger or other emotions, resembling the expression of a husky dog.
distractor_3_slang_def: （缩写为lsp）指的是有老色狼或好色倾向的人。这个词常用来调侃那些对性感或吸引人的内容表现出浓厚兴趣的人。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A person, often older, who shows a strong sexual interest or lecherous tendencies.

conv_def_en: A person skilled in the art of tea.
slang_definition: 用来讽刺那些能把“绿茶”行为表现得特别到位的人。“绿茶”这里指的是表现得清纯无辜，但实际上具有心机的人。该梗常用于形容那些在拍照和日常互动中显得做作或刻意的人。
slang_definition_en: A sarcastic term for someone who skillfully pretends to be innocent and pure but is actually calculating, often used to describe people who act deliberately or affectedly in photos and daily interactions.
sentence_with_blank: 她在朋友圈发了一张脸上沾满奶油的照片，评论里都叫她“<BLANK>”。
sentence_with_blank_en: She posted a photo with her face covered in cream on her Moments, and everyone in the comments called her "<BLANK>".
example_sentence: 她在朋友圈发了一张脸上沾满奶油的照片，评论里都叫她“茶艺大师”。
distractor_1_slang_def: 这个梗指代年龄较大仍然保持处男身份的人。根据传说，保持处男之身到某个年龄就可成为魔法师，意味着处男时间越长，魔法能力越强。这是一种自嘲和调侃。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A humorous term for an older man who remains a virgin, implying that the longer one stays a virgin, the stronger their "magical" powers become.
distractor_2_slang_def: 用来问别人是哪种“妖怪”，即形容对方长相奇特或行为怪异，借用《山海经》中对各种怪物、妖兽的记载进行调侃。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A humorous way to ask what kind of "monster" someone is, implying they look or behave strangely by referencing the mythical creatures in the Classic of Mountains and Seas.
distractor_3_slang_def: 用于吐槽、讽刺、嘲笑男人，多为女性表达对男人的不满或鄙视。这一用语是在表示对男性的不屑时常用。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A term used mainly by women to criticize, mock, or express disdain toward men.

conv_def_en: A heavy machine used for pushing and leveling soil.
conv_def: 一种用于推土和平整土地的重型机械设备
slang_definition: 是在ACGN次文化中形容对各种女性角色进行“推倒”的男性角色。这一术语也可以指向在正常向游戏中形容皮糙肉厚的重甲敌人。
slang_definition_en: In ACGN subculture, a male character who aggressively pursues various female characters; also refers to heavily armored tough enemies in mainstream games.
sentence_with_blank: “这部动漫的男主简直就是个<BLANK>，所有女角色都无法抵挡他的魅力。”
sentence_with_blank_en: The male lead of this anime is simply a <BLANK>, and all the female characters cannot resist his charm.
example_sentence: “这部动漫的男主简直就是个推土机，所有女角色都无法抵挡他的魅力。”
distractor_1_slang_def: 源于麻将中指庄家开局即凑成和牌，这种情况被称为“天胡”。因为这种情况需要极高的运气，难度极高。在卡牌对战类游戏中，“天胡”同样用来指开局即拥有非常理想的牌型，能够快速建立优势，甚至直接获胜。然而，如果后续的运气不好导致输掉比赛，这种情况被称为“诈和”。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A rare event where a player starts with an exceptionally strong hand, leading to an immediate advantage or win, often requiring great luck.
distractor_2_slang_def: 凭借一部作品突然爆红的明星，或在体育圈中指成绩卓越、改变圈子现状的运动员。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A celebrity who suddenly becomes famous due to a single work, or an athlete who achieves outstanding results and changes the status quo in their sport.
distractor_3_slang_def: 在网络论坛中，“洛阳铲”指的是将较后位置的帖子顶到首页或其他用户容易看到的位置。这个表达源于一种考古盗墓用具，也是一句具有侮辱性的方言表达，意为“挖你祖坟”。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: On online forums, the act of bumping older posts to the front page or a visible position.

conv_def_en: On which page of the Classic of Mountains and Seas
slang_definition: 用来问别人是哪种“妖怪”，即形容对方长相奇特或行为怪异，借用《山海经》中对各种怪物、妖兽的记载进行调侃。
slang_definition_en: A humorous way to ask what kind of "monster" someone is, implying they look or behave strangely by referencing the mythical creatures in the Classic of Mountains and Seas.
sentence_with_blank: 看你今天的发型，真该问问你<BLANK>。
sentence_with_blank_en: Looking at your hairstyle today, I really should ask you <BLANK>.
example_sentence: 看你今天的发型，真该问问你在山海经第几页。
distractor_1_slang_def: 在动漫中，特指角色对白中用“电脑配件”作为掩饰的物品，实际上指代某些不被允许或者不便公开的补品或物品。渐渐地，这个词开始被用作弹幕，以调侃和幽默的方式来评论此类情境。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: In anime, a euphemism for prohibited or sensitive items, later used humorously in comments to reference such situations.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指那些说话嗲嗲的、恶意卖萌且习惯用“嘤嘤嘤”作为口癖的人。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A person who speaks in a cutesy, affected manner, maliciously acts cute, and habitually uses "ying ying ying" as a catchphrase.
distractor_3_slang_def: 通常指在某个领域或团体中地位仅次于最高领导者的人。在网络梗中，特别是指那些冒充淘宝卖家的人，因为商家是第一位，而冒充者排在第二位，因而被戏称为"二当家"。该词也常用于形容内心戏丰富、喜欢在评论区"演戏"的网友。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A person second in command in a group or field; online, a term for fake sellers or users who theatrically act out in comment sections.

conv_def_en: Official version jungler player
slang_definition: 这个梗最初来自于游戏英雄联盟的职业选手Xx对IG队员的嘲讽，意指原本战队的正式队员。但随着Xx在比赛中表现不佳，网友反倒用这个词来调侃他，使得“正版打野”带有讽刺和自嘲的意味。
slang_definition_en: Originally a term mocking official team members in League of Legends, later used sarcastically to tease a player for poor performance.
sentence_with_blank: Xx在比赛中的失误引发了网友们的一片调侃，纷纷表示“这就是大家期盼的<BLANK>吗？”
sentence_with_blank_en: Xx's mistake in the competition sparked a wave of teasing from netizens, who all said, "Is this the <BLANK> everyone has been looking forward to?"
example_sentence: Xx在比赛中的失误引发了网友们的一片调侃，纷纷表示“这就是大家期盼的正版打野吗？”
distractor_1_slang_def: 指的是游戏《Dota 2》中半人猛犸-马格纳斯的技能“獠牙冲刺”，技能动画像在颠勺一样。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Refers to the skill "Skewer" of the hero Magnus in the game Dota 2, whose animation resembles flipping a wok.
distractor_2_slang_def: 因其可爱迷人而得名。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Named for being cute and charming.
distractor_3_slang_def: 有何贵干》的搞笑动作，指的是来回跳动的幽默表现。这个动作在网络上被用作各种搞笑表情包，因为其魔性和幽默感。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A humorous back-and-forth jumping motion used in comedic expressions and memes.

conv_def_en: Those who understand, understand.
slang_definition: 用于表达某种信息的隐晦或复杂性，只有特定的人会明白，而不了解的人很难进入这个圈子。常常用于玩梗，或表示信息只能意会。
slang_definition_en: Used to indicate that only certain people understand a subtle or complex message, while outsiders find it difficult to grasp.
sentence_with_blank: 昨天的电影情节真是细思极恐，<BLANK>，不多说了。
sentence_with_blank_en: Yesterday's movie plot was truly terrifying upon careful thought, <BLANK>, no more to say.
example_sentence: 昨天的电影情节真是细思极恐，懂的都懂，不多说了。
distractor_1_slang_def: 原本是指精神气质好的年轻人，现在通常指打扮和行为很有特色，喜欢跳社会摇的土嗨小伙子。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A young man with distinctive style and behavior, often fond of dancing to social shake music.
distractor_2_slang_def: 用于嘲讽他人力气不足，类似于询问对方是否没有吃饭。这个梗借用了古文中的句式结构，常用于调侃力气小的人。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A phrase used to mock someone's lack of strength, implying they haven't eaten enough.
distractor_3_slang_def: 用来调侃射击类游戏中玩家的糟糕枪法，通常指射击时弹道完美避开目标，就像在目标周围画了个轮廓线。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A term mocking poor shooting skills in shooting games, describing bullets that perfectly miss the target as if tracing its outline.

conv_def_en: Crooked-Mouth War God
slang_definition: 这表情伴随着剧情的反转。当男主受到他人嘲讽或打击时，他会露出一种歪嘴、邪魅的微笑，象征他的隐藏身份即将揭示，他马上要展现出强大能力和地位。
slang_definition_en: A crooked smile expressing a hidden identity and imminent display of power during a plot twist.
sentence_with_blank: 看到他被老板怒斥后嘴巴一歪，我心想：这又是“<BLANK>”要上线了。
sentence_with_blank_en: Seeing his mouth twist after being scolded by the boss, I thought to myself: here comes another "<BLANK>" about to go online.
example_sentence: 看到他被老板怒斥后嘴巴一歪，我心想：这又是“歪嘴战神”要上线了。
distractor_1_slang_def: 意指在关键时刻掉链子或表现不佳。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: To fail or perform poorly at a critical moment.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指在工作或游戏中偷懒、不认真对待、出工不出力的行为。这个词来源于古代划船时一些水手假装用力，但实际上并没有真正用力，全程敷衍的情况。现代语境中接近“打酱油”的意思。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: To slack off or put in minimal effort at work or during a game.
distractor_3_slang_def: 通常用于描述一对情侣角色之间秀恩爱的情景，类似于现实中在婚礼上发喜糖的习俗。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Typically used to describe a couple showing affection publicly, similar to the tradition of distributing wedding candies.

conv_def_en: Digging out a three-bedroom, two-living-room house with toes.
conv_def: 用脚趾挖出一个三室两厅的房子
slang_definition: 形容一个人感到非常尴尬、羞愧，尴尬到极点，甚至夸张到像用脚趾抠出一个大房子一样。
slang_definition_en: Describes someone feeling extremely embarrassed or ashamed to an exaggerated degree.
sentence_with_blank: 听到自己童年录音被播放出来，我当时<BLANK>了。
sentence_with_blank_en: Hearing my childhood recording being played back, I <BLANK> at that moment.
example_sentence: 听到自己童年录音被播放出来，我当时脚趾抠出三室两厅了。
distractor_1_slang_def: 原指泄愤或感叹。在网络上，它被引申为“胡说”或“随意说说”的意思。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Originally expressing venting or exclamation; online, it means to talk nonsense or speak casually.
distractor_2_slang_def: 用来回怼对方奶声奶气、不够成熟的话语，风趣地讽刺对方幼稚。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A humorous retort mocking someone's immature or childish remarks.
distractor_3_slang_def: 尤其是指从网络恋爱到现实恋爱的转变。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: The transition from an online romantic relationship to an in-person romantic relationship.
