conv_def_en: Supplementing video frames by blinking.
conv_def: 通过眨眼动作补充视频帧数
slang_definition: 通过快速眨眼跳过不流畅画面，使视觉上感觉顺畅的调侃方式。这只是一种玩笑，没有实际作用于改善性能。
slang_definition_en: A humorous way of saying that quickly blinking skips choppy frames to make visuals appear smoother, without actually improving performance.
sentence_with_blank: 玩《绝地求生》时我电脑突然卡了，弹幕全刷“<BLANK>”，笑得我都忘了操作。
sentence_with_blank_en: While playing PUBG, my computer suddenly lagged, and the chat was flooded with "<BLANK>", making me laugh so hard I forgot to play.
example_sentence: 玩《绝地求生》时我电脑突然卡了，弹幕全刷“眨眼补帧”，笑得我都忘了操作。
distractor_1_slang_def: 指责一些玩家技术不好却经常质疑他人的行为，但从作弊玩家口中说出显得荒诞。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Criticizing unskilled players who often question others, especially absurd when said by cheaters.
distractor_2_slang_def: 用以表达对这种表面关心的调侃和不满。通常由女生用来讽刺那些认为自己在关心女生，但实际上只是在说空话的男生。也可以被用作男生对被称为“直男”这种评价的不满反驳。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A sarcastic expression used to mock insincere or superficial concern, often by women toward men who pretend to care but only speak empty words, and sometimes by men to rebut being labeled as unimaginative or insensitive.
distractor_3_slang_def: 用来调侃或反讽他人说话声音小。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Used to mock or sarcastically comment on someone speaking quietly.

conv_def_en: Transform into Gaia (an Ultraman character).
conv_def: 变身成盖亚（奥特曼角色）
slang_definition: 用来调侃一个人在情绪失控或愤怒时发出的吼声，形容这个瞬间像是奥特曼盖亚变身时喊叫的声音。这种吼声可能源于对复杂任务的挫败感，比如在玩难度很高的游戏时沮丧到极点的反应。
slang_definition_en: A term mocking the loud shout someone makes when losing control or anger, resembling the transformation cry of Ultraman Gaia, often triggered by frustration with difficult tasks.
sentence_with_blank: 小明在考试成绩出来后看到分数低得可怜，气得原地“<BLANK>”。
sentence_with_blank_en: After seeing his exam score was pitifully low, Xiaoming was so angry that he "<BLANK>" on the spot.
example_sentence: 小明在考试成绩出来后看到分数低得可怜，气得原地“变身盖亚”。
distractor_1_slang_def: 讲得很不地道，容易让人听不懂。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Mandarin spoken with poor pronunciation that is difficult to understand.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指的是一种观影方式，即观众在观看影视作品时，不介意提前被剧透，甚至主动去了解剧情走向，以便在观影过程中对剧情发展有充分的掌控，不喜欢意外因素。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A viewing style where the audience prefers to know or seek out plot spoilers in advance to fully anticipate and control the storyline during watching.
distractor_3_slang_def: 用夸张的方式形容一种极度尴尬或羞耻的情绪。它描述人在感到尴尬时，脚趾会不自觉地蜷缩，就像在抓地一样。为了形容尴尬程度之高，网友们进一步扩展这种比喻，称脚趾抓地能抠出极大程度的东西，例如三室两厅或一个宇宙等。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: An exaggerated expression describing an intense feeling of embarrassment or shame, likening involuntary curling of the toes to gripping the ground.

conv_def_en: Started eating.
slang_definition: 意思是准备开始吃饭，一种热情豪爽的说法。
slang_definition_en: Ready to start eating; an enthusiastic and hearty expression.
sentence_with_blank: 时间不早了，大家快来，<BLANK>！
sentence_with_blank_en: It's getting late, everyone hurry up, <BLANK>!
example_sentence: 时间不早了，大家快来，干饭了！
distractor_1_slang_def: 是用来调侃那些在网上发表低级或无聊内容的人。这个说法讽刺他们因为生活条件优越、吃饱没事干，所以在网上胡闹。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Used to mock people who post low-quality or boring content online, implying they have nothing better to do due to a comfortable life.
distractor_2_slang_def: 是“爷满意的离开了”的缩写。它的意思是表达看到了能满足自己期待的事物后，心满意足地离开。通常用来表示对某个内容的强烈满足与欣赏。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: An abbreviation meaning to leave feeling fully satisfied after seeing something that meets one's expectations.
distractor_3_slang_def: 通常在观看到第三集时做出决定。如果在第三集出现剧情突变或引起强烈兴趣，则通常会继续观看；否则可能选择放弃。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A rule of deciding whether to continue watching a series based on interest or plot twists by the third episode.

conv_def_en: Person who cultivates Chinese chives.
slang_definition: 特指那些想要以小成本获取大收益，但最终因缺乏识别能力而被欺骗，交了“智商税”的人群。他们自以为能占便宜或获利，结果却被他人利用，反而遭受损失。
slang_definition_en: People who try to gain high returns with low investment but end up being deceived due to lack of discernment, effectively paying an "intelligence tax."
sentence_with_blank: 看到这个不切实际的投资回报，许多人心动加入，结果却成了<BLANK>，被平台卷走了钱。
sentence_with_blank_en: Seeing this unrealistic return on investment, many people were tempted to join, but it ended up as <BLANK>, with their money taken away by the platform.
example_sentence: 看到这个不切实际的投资回报，许多人心动加入，结果却成了韭菜人，被平台卷走了钱。
distractor_1_slang_def: 指代一种敢于直言、不畏惧后果的勇士精神。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A spirit of bravery characterized by speaking boldly without fear of consequences.
distractor_2_slang_def: 原用于夸奖人说话好听，但现在多用于反讽，形容某人嘴上跑火车、满嘴脏话或行为低素质，是一种贬义词。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Originally used to praise someone for speaking sweetly, now often used sarcastically to describe someone who talks nonsense, uses foul language, or behaves poorly.
distractor_3_slang_def: 这个梗用来调侃自己处于消极、失落或者失去信心的状态。这个说法源于“自闭症”，在这个语境中，它比喻一个人被外界打击后陷入了自我封闭、不愿交流的情绪中。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A humorous expression used to describe feeling down, discouraged, or withdrawn after a setback.

conv_def_en: A child who shows filial piety to their parents through online means.
conv_def: 在云端孝顺父母的子女
slang_definition: 指那些在微信朋友圈里通过转发祈福图片为父母祈福保平安的年轻人，暗示这些人可能在现实中并未真正尽孝。
slang_definition_en: Young people who publicly express filial piety online by sharing blessing images but may not genuinely care for their parents in real life.
sentence_with_blank: 他每天转发那么多祝福图片，俨然成了个<BLANK>。
sentence_with_blank_en: He forwards so many blessing pictures every day that he has practically become a <BLANK>.
example_sentence: 他每天转发那么多祝福图片，俨然成了个云端孝子。
distractor_1_slang_def: 是一种形容坐姿的网络用语。最初是指北京人坐姿随意、不拘小节的状态，身体与椅背呈120度角，给人一种放松却略显懒散的印象。现在，这一词语已经引申为一种放松和毫无拘束的表现方式。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A relaxed, casual sitting posture originally describing Beijing residents leaning back at a 120-degree angle, now extended to signify a carefree and unrestrained manner.
distractor_2_slang_def: 在网络语境中，“泥头车”是一个用来形容某人行为莽撞、横冲直撞的梗，通常用来形容人做事不顾后果或技术不佳（如在电竞中表现不够理想）。此外，它也被用来表达对某些令人不快或愤怒情况的强烈反应。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A slang term describing someone acting recklessly or clumsily, often ignoring consequences or performing poorly, especially in gaming contexts.
distractor_3_slang_def: 在游戏圈中指玩家通过非官方渠道尝试影响游戏中随机现象（如掉落概率、装备品质等）的行为。这类行为基于玩家总结的经验，而非游戏的公开机制。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: In gaming, the practice of attempting to influence random in-game events through unofficial methods based on player experience rather than official game mechanics.

conv_def_en: Having honey smeared on the lips.
slang_definition: 原用于夸奖人说话好听，但现在多用于反讽，形容某人嘴上跑火车、满嘴脏话或行为低素质，是一种贬义词。
slang_definition_en: Originally used to praise someone for speaking sweetly, now often used sarcastically to describe someone who talks nonsense, uses foul language, or behaves poorly.
sentence_with_blank: 在观看某主播直播时，他突然开始爆粗口，弹幕上纷纷刷起：“XX<BLANK>，果然不负所望。”
sentence_with_blank_en: While watching a certain streamer’s live broadcast, he suddenly started cursing, and the comments quickly filled with: “XX<BLANK>, truly lived up to expectations.”
example_sentence: 在观看某主播直播时，他突然开始爆粗口，弹幕上纷纷刷起：“XX小嘴抹了蜜，果然不负所望。”
distractor_1_slang_def: 具有一种无奈妥协的意味，表示在不情愿的情况下勉强同意或妥协。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Expressing reluctant agreement or compromise with a sense of helpless resignation.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指代比“狠人”更厉害、更狠的人，通常用于表达对某人或某事的惊讶、赞叹和佩服。这个网络流行语通过字面的字数比较，“狼人”的“狼”比“狠人”的“狠”多一点，形象地表示了程度更高的厉害。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Refers to someone tougher or more formidable than a "tough person," expressing surprise, admiration, or respect.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指一种表情非常痛苦且夸张，常用于形容人因失落或尴尬而扭曲的面部表情，也常引发观众的幽默感。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: An exaggerated facial expression showing intense pain, often used to depict someone's distorted face due to loss or embarrassment, typically evoking humor.

conv_def_en: The battle song begins to play.
slang_definition: 指代热血、激昂的背景音乐（BGM）的开始，特别是在动漫或影视作品中。当剧情达到高潮或即将开始战斗时，这类音乐会播放，迅速提高观众的情绪，增添紧张感。
slang_definition_en: Refers to the start of intense, energetic background music, especially in anime or films, signaling a climax or impending battle to heighten excitement and tension.
sentence_with_blank: 《进击的巨人》片头曲一响，弹幕瞬间刷满“<BLANK>”。
sentence_with_blank_en: As soon as the opening theme of "Attack on Titan" starts, the bullet screen instantly fills with "<BLANK>".
example_sentence: 《进击的巨人》片头曲一响，弹幕瞬间刷满“战歌起”。
distractor_1_slang_def: 原指一种真实存在的医学状况，即面部识别能力缺乏症，也叫prosopagnosia或face blindness。患者视觉正常但无法分辨或记住他人的脸。在流行文化中，这个术语被用来形容那些由于对虚拟角色面部辨识过于依赖，导致在现实生活中分辨不了不同面孔的人。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A condition characterized by difficulty recognizing or remembering faces, originally a medical term for prosopagnosia, also used to describe people who struggle to distinguish real-life faces due to overreliance on virtual character recognition.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指的是一个团体或团队的全部成员被消灭，通常用于描述游戏中团队的全员阵亡。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: The complete elimination of all members of a group or team, often used to describe a team's total defeat in a game.
distractor_3_slang_def: 形容上班族身上常见的疲惫气质，表现出一种无法掩饰的疲劳和改变。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A visible aura of fatigue commonly seen in office workers.

conv_def_en: Just sprinting will get the job done.
conv_def: 只要冲刺就能完成事情
slang_definition: 放手去做的态度。无论遇到什么事情，不必多想，直接行动。
slang_definition_en: An attitude of boldly taking action without overthinking.
sentence_with_blank: 在游戏对战中，小明说道：“别犹豫了，咱们<BLANK>，赢下这一局！”
sentence_with_blank_en: In the game battle, Xiaoming said, "Don't hesitate, let's <BLANK> and win this round!"
example_sentence: 在游戏对战中，小明说道：“别犹豫了，咱们冲就完事了，赢下这一局！”
distractor_1_slang_def: 通常在观看到第三集时做出决定。如果在第三集出现剧情突变或引起强烈兴趣，则通常会继续观看；否则可能选择放弃。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A rule of deciding whether to continue watching a series based on interest or plot twists by the third episode.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指在工作或游戏中偷懒、不认真对待、出工不出力的行为。这个词来源于古代划船时一些水手假装用力，但实际上并没有真正用力，全程敷衍的情况。现代语境中接近“打酱油”的意思。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: To slack off or put in minimal effort at work or during a game.
distractor_3_slang_def: 共同“坑”观众的现象，形容不假思索地购买商品。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: The phenomenon of impulsively purchasing products without careful consideration.

conv_def_en: Noon horse
slang_definition: 是指那些默默干活、不能有怨言、不能出头的人。由“牛马”演变而来，字面上表示出不了头的“牛马”。
slang_definition_en: Refers to people who work silently without complaints and cannot stand out.
sentence_with_blank: 他在公司里就是个<BLANK>，做了很多事却从不被表扬。
sentence_with_blank_en: He is a <BLANK> in the company, doing many things but never being praised.
example_sentence: 他在公司里就是个午马，做了很多事却从不被表扬。
distractor_1_slang_def: 感觉难受且无法直视，通常用于评价一些奇葩或充满槽点的事物。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Causing discomfort and unable to look directly, usually used to describe bizarre or cringe-worthy things.
distractor_2_slang_def: 类似于“今晚月色真美”，表达对对方的喜欢或爱慕之情。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A phrase expressing affection or admiration for someone.
distractor_3_slang_def: 原为电子竞技中的礼貌用语，代表Goodgame的缩写。最初用来表示对一局游戏的满意和结束，表示技不如人的甘拜下风。而在网络文化中，常用于形容“完蛋了”或处于劣势、一种摆烂的心态。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Originally a polite term in e-sports meaning "Good game," now commonly used online to indicate defeat, disadvantage, or a resigned attitude.

conv_def_en: To place rotten things.
slang_definition: 指在事情无力好转时，不再采取措施而任由事态变坏，类似于破罐子破摔。
slang_definition_en: To deliberately give up improving a situation and let it deteriorate.
sentence_with_blank: 他觉得这次考试太难，准备彻底<BLANK>，不再复习了。
sentence_with_blank_en: He felt this exam was too difficult and was ready to completely <BLANK>, no longer reviewing.
example_sentence: 他觉得这次考试太难，准备彻底摆烂，不再复习了。
distractor_1_slang_def: 是一句调侃的话，用来表达对不想看到内容的自我逃避和无所谓的态度，最初用于面对秀恩爱。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A humorous phrase expressing self-avoidance and indifference toward unwanted content, originally used when witnessing public displays of affection.
distractor_2_slang_def: 是一种用来吐槽或讽刺女性的网络用语。它利用“呵”所带有的嘲笑或不屑的语气，表达对某些女性特点的批评或揶揄。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A derogatory internet term used to mock or criticize certain female traits with a tone of ridicule or disdain.
distractor_3_slang_def: 用来形容那些爱吹牛的人，他们说到做不到，只会空谈。在ACGN文化中，“打嘴炮”也指主角通过口若悬河的言论或声嘶力竭的喊叫对敌人施加心理或精神上的影响，作为一种语言武器。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: To boast or talk big without taking action; in ACGN culture, to use persuasive or loud speech as a psychological weapon against opponents.

conv_def_en: Acting, right?
slang_definition: 通常用于短视频评论中，意指视频内容是演绎的，而非真实发生的事件。这一评论有时是为了讽刺视频的不真实，也可能是单纯的玩梗。
slang_definition_en: Used in short video comments to indicate the content is acted out rather than real, often sarcastically or as a joke.
sentence_with_blank: 看着这对情侣的争吵视频，评论里一片“<BLANK>”，真是让人哭笑不得。
sentence_with_blank_en: Watching the video of this couple's argument, the comments are full of "<BLANK>", which is really both amusing and frustrating.
example_sentence: 看着这对情侣的争吵视频，评论里一片“演的吧”，真是让人哭笑不得。
distractor_1_slang_def: 指的是在游戏中，角色贴着掩体反复移动，以躲避敌人攻击的走位技巧。尤其用于形容角色残血时通过绕柱子等障碍物来阻挡敌人视线，等待支援或逃出险境。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A gaming movement technique where a character repeatedly moves close to cover to evade enemy attacks, especially by circling obstacles to block enemy sight when low on health.
distractor_2_slang_def: 它的内容通常是一些普通但搞笑的小事。因其诙谐逗趣的文字风格而受到大众喜爱，并在网络上迅速走红。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A popular online diary featuring humorous and ordinary daily anecdotes.
distractor_3_slang_def: 通常由制作方特意添加，供玩家或观众发现。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: An intentional hidden feature or message added by creators for players or viewers to discover.

conv_def_en: Achieving the feat of consecutively killing five enemies.
conv_def: 抢夺连续击杀五个敌人的成就
slang_definition: 一个玩家即将连续击杀五个敌人获得“五杀”成就时，却被队友抢走了最后一个击杀，导致未能达成。此行为在游戏中较为让人恼火，因为“五杀”是难得的成就。
slang_definition_en: When a player is about to achieve a rare "pentakill" by consecutively killing five enemies but is denied the final kill by a teammate, causing them to miss the achievement.
sentence_with_blank: 张三本想在团战中拿下五杀，没想到最后一个人头被李四抢掉，惹得他非常不满。
sentence_with_blank_en: Zhang San originally wanted to get a pentakill in the team fight, but unexpectedly the last kill was stolen by Li Si, which made him very unhappy.
example_sentence: 张三本想在团战中拿下五杀，没想到最后一个人头被李四抢掉，惹得他非常不满。
distractor_1_slang_def: 这个梗用来讽刺那些在网络上站在道德制高点指责他人、却缺乏实际同情心和理解的网络喷子。形象比喻这些人看似高高在上、庄严神圣，实际上是自以为是。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A sarcastic term for online critics who moralize from a high ground but lack genuine empathy and understanding.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指的是在接吻时，由于口腔分泌物造成两人分开时出现的黏连拔丝现象。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A kissing phenomenon where saliva causes a sticky, stringy connection when partners part.
distractor_3_slang_def: 表示一个人对生活失去热情，不再积极进取，同时心态也崩溃了。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Describes a person who has lost enthusiasm for life, no longer strives actively, and whose mindset has collapsed.

conv_def_en: Stacking armor
slang_definition: 原本是指在游戏中提升角色防御力的动作，现如今在网络语言中被用来指代在表达观点时加入免责声明，以避免被批评或争论。
slang_definition_en: Originally referring to increasing a character's defense in games, now used online to mean adding disclaimers when expressing opinions to avoid criticism or arguments.
sentence_with_blank: 这部电影真的不太好看（仅个人观感，不代表大家意见哦）。
sentence_with_blank_en: This movie is really not very good (just my personal opinion, does not represent everyone's views).
example_sentence: 这部电影真的不太好看（仅个人观感，不代表大家意见哦）。
distractor_1_slang_def: 形容那些认知水平落后、用过时手段宣扬他国优越的公知，实际上是不切实际的盲目吹捧他国并贬低中国的人。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A term describing public intellectuals with outdated views who unrealistically praise foreign countries while belittling China.
distractor_2_slang_def: 针对那些热爱奶茶的人。它反映了现代人在饮用高糖分饮料后容易出现体重增加的现象。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A term describing the tendency for people who love milk tea to gain weight due to consuming high-sugar drinks.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指作曲精湛、影响广泛的音乐作品。这些作品通常因其卓越的艺术水准和广泛的受众认可而被称为“神曲”。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A music piece renowned for its excellent composition and widespread influence.

conv_def_en: Completed and celebrated with flower scattering.
slang_definition: 是一个用于吐槽或纪念作品完结时的流行用语。它通常在动画、影视剧等作品的最后一集或重要剧情节点之后使用。这个词用于表达作品完结后的庆祝或调侃，并且随着情节的发展，有时用来反讽或恶搞。
slang_definition_en: A popular phrase used to celebrate, mock, or commemorate the conclusion of a work, often employed after the final episode or key plot points in animations or dramas.
sentence_with_blank: 当我看到《进击的巨人》第五集艾伦被巨人吃掉的那一刻，我情不自禁地在弹幕中刷了“<BLANK>”。
sentence_with_blank_en: The moment I saw Eren being eaten by a Titan in episode five of Attack on Titan, I couldn't help but spam "<BLANK>" in the comments.
example_sentence: 当我看到《进击的巨人》第五集艾伦被巨人吃掉的那一刻，我情不自禁地在弹幕中刷了“完结撒花”。
distractor_1_slang_def: 带有喜感和反差萌，通常用于称呼自己的女朋友或女生自称，体现出一种接地气和可爱的感觉。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A playful and endearing term used by someone to refer to their girlfriend or by a girl herself, conveying a down-to-earth and cute vibe.
distractor_2_slang_def: 用于调侃或讽刺。当主播取得优势时，反而说“坏起来了”，表现一种幽默的反向。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Used humorously or sarcastically to indicate someone is getting mischievous or aggressive, especially when they have the upper hand.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指的是一个新作品沿用了一部知名作品的部分核心内容或玩法，但不涉及其知识产权。新作品通常被认为是对原作品精神或风格的延续，尤其是在原作品可能不再推出续作的情况下。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A new work that adopts core elements or gameplay of a well-known original without involving its intellectual property, seen as a continuation of the original's spirit or style.

conv_def_en: High-level meeting on Flower-Fruit Mountain
slang_definition: 指局内交流混乱，像花果山一群猴子在开会。
slang_definition_en: A chaotic internal meeting resembling a group of monkeys gathering on Flower-Fruit Mountain.
sentence_with_blank: 看完这场比赛的语音，我只想说，这简直是<BLANK>。
sentence_with_blank_en: After listening to the commentary of this match, I just want to say, this is simply <BLANK>.
example_sentence: 看完这场比赛的语音，我只想说，这简直是花果山高级会议。
distractor_1_slang_def: 后半句是“一套又一套”，用来形容某人有很多套路、说话或做事的方法特别多。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Used to describe someone who has many tricks or methods in speaking or doing things.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指在表演中通过铺垫，在关键时刻揭示出令人意想不到的幽默或主题，使作品更具吸引力和感染力。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: In performance, revealing an unexpected humorous or thematic element at a key moment to enhance appeal and impact.
distractor_3_slang_def: 是提醒观众接下来可能会看到某个蠢蠢的行为。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A warning that a foolish action may be seen ahead.

conv_def_en: Newton's spirit has come alive.
slang_definition: 指某些场景过于夸张和离谱，以至于违反了物理规律，牛顿看见了会“气得活过来”。
slang_definition_en: Refers to situations so exaggerated and absurd that they defy physical laws, as if Newton would be angered enough to come back to life.
sentence_with_blank: 那个电影里主角能在空中随意行走，<BLANK>也得质疑一下。
sentence_with_blank_en: The protagonist in that movie can walk freely in the air, so <BLANK> also has to be questioned.
example_sentence: 那个电影里主角能在空中随意行走，牛顿气活了也得质疑一下。
distractor_1_slang_def: 指在表演中通过铺垫，在关键时刻揭示出令人意想不到的幽默或主题，使作品更具吸引力和感染力。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: In performance, revealing an unexpected humorous or thematic element at a key moment to enhance appeal and impact.
distractor_2_slang_def: 是用来形容特别忙碌或被过度使用的状态。这个短语来源于一句俗语“生产队的驴都没有你忙”，用来对比一个人或物处于高强度的使用状态。虽然用“驴”来形容听上去可能不那么高尚，但在这个语境下并不是用来骂人的，而是一种轻松幽默的表达。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Used to describe someone or something that is extremely busy or overworked.
distractor_3_slang_def: 具有一种无奈妥协的意味，表示在不情愿的情况下勉强同意或妥协。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Expressing reluctant agreement or compromise with a sense of helpless resignation.

conv_def_en: Leeuwenhoek (a person's name)
slang_definition: 在网络中用于形容那些观察力极为敏锐、能察觉细微细节的人。这种人通常能够注意到别人容易忽略的小细节，就像使用显微镜一样观察事物。
slang_definition_en: Used online to describe someone with extremely keen observation skills who notices subtle details others often overlook, like examining things with a microscope.
sentence_with_blank: “你真是个<BLANK>，居然连背景墙上那小小的字母都能看到！”
sentence_with_blank_en: You really are a <BLANK>, you can even see the tiny letters on the background wall!
example_sentence: “你真是个列文虎克，居然连背景墙上那小小的字母都能看到！”
distractor_1_slang_def: 形容人在某些情境下感到拘谨、畏缩，显得偷偷摸摸或不自然。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Describes someone who feels awkward or timid in certain situations, appearing furtive or unnatural.
distractor_2_slang_def: 其实是“我服了”的谐音变体，用法主要用于调侃和玩梗。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A phonetic variation of "I give up," used mainly for joking and memes.
distractor_3_slang_def: 这个梗用来形容“蘑菇头”和“眼瞎”，指的是动画角色朵拉的标志性蘑菇头发型和她在观察物品时的“战略性”视而不见。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A slang term referring to a mushroom-shaped hairstyle and willful blindness, inspired by the animated character Dora's signature look and her strategic overlooking of objects.

conv_def_en: Happy and excited
slang_definition: 因其魔性感觉而在网络上走红。
slang_definition_en: Popular online for its magical and sexy vibe.
sentence_with_blank: 每次看到老8的视频，我都期待他经典的“<BLANK>”开场白。
sentence_with_blank_en: Every time I watch Old 8's videos, I look forward to his classic "<BLANK>" opening line.
example_sentence: 每次看到老8的视频，我都期待他经典的“嗨害嗨”开场白。
distractor_1_slang_def: 是提醒观众接下来可能会看到某个蠢蠢的行为。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A warning that a foolish action may be seen ahead.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指那些在恋爱关系中坚持纯真、无私、高尚的爱情观的人。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A person who upholds pure, selfless, and noble views on love in romantic relationships.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指的是你和世界上任何一个人之间最多只相隔六个中间人，通过这些中间人即可建立联系。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: The concept that any two people in the world are connected by at most six intermediaries.

conv_def_en: State-level banquet
slang_definition: 表示玩家或队伍的操作非常烂，让观众觉得是在看一个顶级的菜鸟表演。
slang_definition_en: Refers to a player or team's extremely poor performance, making viewers feel like they are watching a top-level novice.
sentence_with_blank: 今天队友团战操作简直是“<BLANK>”级别，连对面都在帮我们。
sentence_with_blank_en: Today my teammates' team fight operations were simply at the "<BLANK>" level, even the opponents were helping us.
example_sentence: 今天队友团战操作简直是“国宴”级别，连对面都在帮我们。
distractor_1_slang_def: 指那些让人感到不解、很奇怪或耐人寻味的行为。在网络语境中，这个词语通常用来形容那些看似无厘头、让人感到困惑甚至有些搞笑的举动，但随着时间推移，逐渐也带有一些批判意味。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Actions that are confusing, strange, or puzzling, often seemingly nonsensical and sometimes humorous, but increasingly carrying a critical tone.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指的是粉丝在看待自己喜欢的偶像时，会无意识地忽略或美化偶像的缺点和不足，认为偶像是最优秀和完美的。类似于"情人眼里出西施"，即使面对客观的不完美，粉丝也会有一层美化的偏见。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A bias where fans unconsciously overlook or idealize their favorite idol's flaws, perceiving them as perfect despite objective imperfections.
distractor_3_slang_def: 原指武术中的招式组合。后衍生为各种含义，例如社交网络中，指精心策划的计划或阴谋；游戏中，指某种特定的玩法；媒体内容中，指被用过太多次的设定或剧情；程序设计中，指语法糖、设计模式等。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A set of tactics or patterns repeatedly used in various contexts such as social networking, gaming, media, or programming.

conv_def_en: A person who suffers a great injustice.
slang_definition: 或者做了傻事被称为“大冤种”。也可以指因蒙受冤屈而感到不快的人。它常被用来自嘲或形容他人不走运、不机灵的状况。
slang_definition_en: A person who has done something foolish or feels wronged, often used to self-mock or describe someone unlucky or not clever.
sentence_with_blank: 小李加班到深夜，结果第二天发现其实根本没必要，直呼自己是个职场“<BLANK>”。
sentence_with_blank_en: Xiao Li worked overtime until late at night, only to find out the next day that it was completely unnecessary, exclaiming that he was a workplace "<BLANK>".
example_sentence: 小李加班到深夜，结果第二天发现其实根本没必要，直呼自己是个职场“大冤种”。
distractor_1_slang_def: 在疫情背景下，通过调侃牛郎织女因为没有打疫苗和没有做核酸检测而无法相会，因此“七夕取消”作为一种幽默表达，用以调侃现实中因疫情而遇到的封锁措施和出行限制。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A humorous expression referencing the cancellation of the Qixi Festival due to pandemic-related restrictions, likening it to the legendary lovers being unable to meet without vaccination or testing.
distractor_2_slang_def: 用来形容一个角色或人物非常能说会道并且很搞笑，像是一个喜剧演员。这个梗来源于游客对北京环球影城威震天的调侃，他在与游客互动中表现得极其幽默和健谈。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A term describing someone who is very talkative and humorous, like a comedian.
distractor_3_slang_def: 在网络文化中指的是一个人通过发布虚假或夸张的信息吸引他人注意，并引导他们进行讨论或分享。在网络交流中，钓鱼的目的是让人上当，进而引起群体围观与批评，实现影响舆论的目的。钓鱼者通常以“渔民”身份出现，故意发布挑衅性言论或信息来激怒或误导他人。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: In online culture, deliberately posting false or exaggerated information to attract attention, provoke discussion, and manipulate public opinion.

conv_def_en: Ah, yes, yes, yes.
slang_definition: 表示敷衍和摆烂，用来应对无理取闹、尖酸刻薄的人或无端指责，表达不屑与对方计较或合作的情绪。
slang_definition_en: An expression used to dismissively respond to unreasonable complaints or criticisms, indicating indifference and refusal to engage.
sentence_with_blank: 面对同事无理的批评，我心里想着“<BLANK>”，不再与他争论。
sentence_with_blank_en: Faced with my colleague's unreasonable criticism, I thought "<BLANK>" in my heart and no longer argued with him.
example_sentence: 面对同事无理的批评，我心里想着“啊对对对”，不再与他争论。
distractor_1_slang_def: 是在ACGN次文化中形容对各种女性角色进行“推倒”的男性角色。这一术语也可以指向在正常向游戏中形容皮糙肉厚的重甲敌人。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: In ACGN subculture, a male character who aggressively pursues various female characters; also refers to heavily armored tough enemies in mainstream games.
distractor_2_slang_def: 用颜色表示对特定角色或偶像的支持和喜爱。源于应援文化，粉丝用特定颜色的物品表达对偶像的支持。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Expressing support and affection for a specific character or idol using colors.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指那些过去做过的、现在回想起来会觉得羞耻或者不愿意提及的事情，类似“污点”。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Past actions or events that are embarrassing or shameful to recall.

conv_def_en: Hero of McNuggets
slang_definition: 多给顾客一块麦乐鸡的员工，被视为默默支持消费者的无名英雄，帮助顾客"割资本主义韭菜"。
slang_definition_en: An employee who secretly supports customers by giving an extra chicken nugget, seen as an unsung hero helping consumers benefit from capitalism.
sentence_with_blank: "每次去麦当劳买麦乐鸡，我都会心里默默期待遇到<BLANK>，为我多给一块。"
sentence_with_blank_en: Every time I go to McDonald's to buy McNuggets, I silently hope to encounter <BLANK> who will give me an extra piece.
example_sentence: "每次去麦当劳买麦乐鸡，我都会心里默默期待遇到麦乐鸡侠，为我多给一块。"
distractor_1_slang_def: 指的是那些看似普通但价格高昂的雪糕，购买时让人感到意外和“被刺”的疼痛感。这个表达反映了雪糕价格上涨和意外负担感。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A term for seemingly ordinary ice creams with unexpectedly high prices that cause a surprising sense of financial pain.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指游戏中的最高难度等级，需要极高水平才能完成，也用于形容在生活中遭遇极大阻力或恶劣环境。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: The highest difficulty level in a game requiring exceptional skill, also used to describe facing extreme challenges or harsh conditions in life.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指水平极高或拥有特殊设定、剧情的作品。可能表现出思想深度、艺术结合完美。其使用已泛化，出现了贬义倾向，甚至恶搞用法。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A work of exceptional quality or unique concept, often showing deep thought and artistic excellence, sometimes used sarcastically.

conv_def_en: A large leopard with golden-yellow fur and spots.
conv_def: 一种体型较大的豹，毛色金黄带斑点。
slang_definition: 这个梗寓意着对新一年暴富的期盼和对富贵生活的向往。换上金钱豹的头像象征着希望能够带来金钱和好运。
slang_definition_en: A slang term symbolizing the hope for sudden wealth and a prosperous life in the new year, often represented by using a golden leopard avatar to attract money and good luck.
sentence_with_blank: 看了那么多人换上<BLANK>头像，我也赶紧换上，万一新的一年真能暴富呢！
sentence_with_blank_en: Seeing so many people change to <BLANK> avatars, I quickly changed mine too, just in case I really get rich in the new year!
example_sentence: 看了那么多人换上金钱豹头像，我也赶紧换上，万一新的一年真能暴富呢！
distractor_1_slang_def: 源于赌场术语"Winner winner, chicken dinner"，意指大获全胜。经英国电影《决胜21点》和游戏《绝地求生》而流行，现在广泛用于指在任何比赛中取得好成绩。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Originally from the casino phrase "Winner winner, chicken dinner," it means achieving a big victory and is now widely used to indicate winning or performing well in any competition.
distractor_2_slang_def: 表示“道理我都懂”/“我理解你说的道理”，通常用来表达一种无奈、吐槽或讽刺的情感。意思是虽然道理大家都明白，但现实中往往行不通或无法解决问题。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Used to express reluctant acknowledgment of an obvious truth that is impractical or ineffective in reality.
distractor_3_slang_def: 通过仿造上巴（上唇的意思）来幽默地指代心脏。此词调侃性地将身体各部位以“x巴”的格式重新命名，以增加趣味性。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A humorous slang term for the heart, modeled after the word for upper lip, used to playfully rename body parts in the format "x-ba."

conv_def_en: Teacher's vegetables and mixed dishes.
slang_definition: 由“亲爱的老师，期末了，你可爱的学生菜菜的，能不能捞捞我，呜呜呜”这句话缩写而成，是一种撒娇式的请求，表达大学生希望在期末考试时老师能宽容打分，帮助他们不挂科。
slang_definition_en: A playful, pleading phrase used by college students to ask teachers for leniency in grading during final exams.
sentence_with_blank: 老师，期末考试我真的努力了，求您菜菜捞捞，让我过吧。
sentence_with_blank_en: Teacher, I really worked hard for the final exam, please <BLANK> and let me pass.
example_sentence: 老师，期末考试我真的努力了，求您菜菜捞捞，让我过吧。
distractor_1_slang_def: 形容对本质上很糟糕的事物进行不必要的修饰和包装，这种行为虽然耗费精力，但并不会改变其糟糕的本质。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Unnecessarily embellishing something fundamentally bad without improving its poor nature.
distractor_2_slang_def: 在网络用语中，“闪光弹”引申为一种炫耀行为，特别是在感情或物质生活中表现得令人羡慕或炫目的行为。单身网友常用这个词来形容那些在公开场合亲昵互动的情侣或展示奢华生活的人，感到这是一种刺激、炫目到让人“致盲”的行为。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: In online slang, a flashy display intended to evoke envy, especially through public affection or showcasing a luxurious lifestyle.
distractor_3_slang_def: “凯哥我点了”是表示投降的意思，通常用于在游戏中认为胜利无望时。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Used to indicate surrender, typically when victory seems impossible in a game.

conv_def_en: Canon-style warning
slang_definition: 类似于死亡警告。这种警告会让人感到恐惧和紧张。
slang_definition_en: A warning that induces fear and tension, similar to a death warning.
sentence_with_blank: 在玩恐怖游戏时突然播放卡农，真是<BLANK>，把我吓得差点退出游戏。
sentence_with_blank_en: Playing Canon suddenly in a horror game is really <BLANK>, it scared me so much I almost quit the game.
example_sentence: 在玩恐怖游戏时突然播放卡农，真是卡农警告，把我吓得差点退出游戏。
distractor_1_slang_def: 弹幕中的常见吐槽语，通常用于当观众觉得某角色对事情的分析或推测过于复杂、敏感时进行调侃。观众作为上帝视角，拥有完整的情报，因此，当看到作品中的角色基于有限的信息做出错误判断或过于细致的推测时，观众会用“想多了”来吐槽角色的“过度解读”。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A common comment used to mock characters for overanalyzing or making overly complex or sensitive assumptions beyond available information.
distractor_2_slang_def: 共同“坑”观众的现象，形容不假思索地购买商品。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: The phenomenon of impulsively purchasing products without careful consideration.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指那些在微信朋友圈里通过转发祈福图片为父母祈福保平安的年轻人，暗示这些人可能在现实中并未真正尽孝。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Young people who publicly express filial piety online by sharing blessing images but may not genuinely care for their parents in real life.

conv_def_en: My mute bride refers to my bride who cannot speak.
conv_def: 我的哑巴新娘指我的不会说话的新娘
slang_definition: 用来形容一个人外貌美丽，但说话时与外貌不符，特别是说话方式过于“糙汉子”风格。这表明，如果这个人不说话，他们会显得极为完美。
slang_definition_en: Describes someone who looks beautiful but speaks in a rough, unrefined manner, contrasting with their appearance.
sentence_with_blank: 周淑怡最近又发了个舞蹈视频，评论区清一色的“这是<BLANK>”。
sentence_with_blank_en: Zhou Shuyi recently posted another dance video, and the comment section is filled with "This is <BLANK>".
example_sentence: 周淑怡最近又发了个舞蹈视频，评论区清一色的“这是我的哑巴新娘”。
distractor_1_slang_def: 认为掉在地上的食物在三秒内捡起来还能吃，这种观念常见于ACG作品中，作为吃货的一种萌属性或者是表现角色珍惜食物的方法。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: The belief that food dropped on the ground is still safe to eat if picked up within three seconds, often depicted in ACG works as a cute trait of food lovers or to show a character's appreciation for food.
distractor_2_slang_def: 包含酸涩与清新的双重感觉。形容某种体验虽然有些刺激或不适，但同时又有一种愉悦或满足的感觉。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A mixed sensation of slight discomfort and refreshing pleasure.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指代那些无故妨碍他人，损人不利己，不懂团队合作的人。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Someone who obstructs others without reason, harms others without benefiting themselves, and lacks teamwork skills.

conv_def_en: Germany and Chinese people
slang_definition: 这个梗指的是在家中假期间，帮助亲戚朋友照顾孩子的大学生。
slang_definition_en: A college student who helps relatives and friends take care of children during home holidays.
sentence_with_blank: 放寒假回家，本来想好好休息，结果变成了<BLANK>，每天都要带侄女上兴趣班。
sentence_with_blank_en: Going home for winter vacation, I originally planned to rest well, but it turned into <BLANK>, having to take my niece to extracurricular classes every day.
example_sentence: 放寒假回家，本来想好好休息，结果变成了德华，每天都要带侄女上兴趣班。
distractor_1_slang_def: 最初用于形容违反唯物主义常识的现象，表达对某事的难以置信。虽然不具有严肃性，但多用于轻松的吐槽场合。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Originally used to describe phenomena that defy materialist logic, expressing disbelief in a lighthearted, informal way.
distractor_2_slang_def: 通常与主流审美或思想不符，展现发明人的独特性。这一说法常用于自嘲或自吹。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Unconventional skills showcasing the inventor's uniqueness, often used humorously or boastfully.
distractor_3_slang_def: 是指赶赴山东淄博这个地方去吃烧烤。这个短语反映了淄博烧烤因网络走红而吸引了大量外地游客前来品尝的现象。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Refers to traveling to Zibo, Shandong, to eat barbecue, reflecting the surge of visitors attracted by its online popularity.

conv_def_en: Chicken dish served in a bowl.
slang_definition: 指四川特色小吃钵钵鸡，因其魔性洗脑的叫卖声而走红。
slang_definition_en: A Sichuan specialty snack known for its catchy and addictive street vendor calls.
sentence_with_blank: 最近在家总是忍不住学那句“<BLANK>，钵啊<BLANK>，一元一串的<BLANK>”。
sentence_with_blank_en: Lately at home, I can't help but keep practicing that phrase "<BLANK>, bowl ah <BLANK>, one yuan per skewer <BLANK>".
example_sentence: 最近在家总是忍不住学那句“钵钵鸡，钵啊钵钵鸡，一元一串的钵钵鸡”。
distractor_1_slang_def: 原本是指精神气质好的年轻人，现在通常指打扮和行为很有特色，喜欢跳社会摇的土嗨小伙子。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A young man with distinctive style and behavior, often fond of dancing to social shake music.
distractor_2_slang_def: 用来警告某人注意言行，否则可能导致其账号被封。这句话带有一种俏皮的威胁意味，常用于提醒或调侃在网络上发表不当言论的人。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A playful warning that someone's account may be banned if they do not watch their behavior online.
distractor_3_slang_def: 形容对本质上很糟糕的事物进行不必要的修饰和包装，这种行为虽然耗费精力，但并不会改变其糟糕的本质。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Unnecessarily embellishing something fundamentally bad without improving its poor nature.

conv_def_en: Married women in the Chinese entertainment industry.
conv_def: 中国娱乐圈的已婚女性
slang_definition: 粉丝通常称她们为“嫂子”，这是因为粉丝常称他们喜欢的男明星为“哥哥”，因此自然称呼他女友或妻子为“嫂子”。
slang_definition_en: Fans often call female partners of their favorite male celebrities "sister-in-law" because they refer to the male celebrities as "brother."
sentence_with_blank: 当小王子爆出恋情后，粉丝们纷纷称他的女友为<BLANK>。
sentence_with_blank_en: After the Little Prince's relationship was revealed, fans all called his girlfriend <BLANK>.
example_sentence: 当小王子爆出恋情后，粉丝们纷纷称他的女友为内娱嫂子。
distractor_1_slang_def: 是指一些女生在网上分享的自以为是被宠爱的经历。这些文字常常带有矫情的语气和文笔，展示一种自己是被霸道总裁般宠爱的“小娇妻”状态。然而，外人看起来这些表达实际上常常显得可笑，与现实脱节，她们不幸而不自知。这种风格逐渐在网络上成为一种受网友调侃的文学体裁。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A style of online writing where women share self-indulgent, exaggerated accounts of being doted on like a "spoiled wife," often perceived as pretentious and disconnected from reality.
distractor_2_slang_def: 具有一种无奈妥协的意味，表示在不情愿的情况下勉强同意或妥协。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Expressing reluctant agreement or compromise with a sense of helpless resignation.
distractor_3_slang_def: 源于他意外在推特上传私处照后引发全球网民关注，被认为是在疫情时期以意外方式带来欢乐。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A person who unintentionally brought joy worldwide during the pandemic by accidentally posting private photos on Twitter.

conv_def_en: Small potatoes from the southern region
slang_definition: 是一个对南方游客在东北冰雪旅游期间的亲切称呼。这个昵称带有一种幽默和温馨的色彩，形象地描述了南方游客因穿着厚重的羽绒服而显得圆乎乎的样子。
slang_definition_en: A humorous and affectionate nickname for southern tourists in Northeast China during winter, referring to their round appearance caused by wearing bulky down jackets.
sentence_with_blank: 每到冬天，东北的冰雪城镇就开始热闹起来，到处都是兴奋的<BLANK>。
sentence_with_blank_en: Every winter, the icy and snowy towns in Northeast China come alive, filled everywhere with excited <BLANK>.
example_sentence: 每到冬天，东北的冰雪城镇就开始热闹起来，到处都是兴奋的南方小土豆。
distractor_1_slang_def: 在并不需要吃苦的情况下，主动去承受不必要的艰难，从而导致适得其反的行为。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Unnecessarily enduring hardship when it is not required, resulting in counterproductive outcomes.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指的是以观看和享受事件演变为目的的人，他们主要是在网络上围观各类事件，寻找娱乐和话题。他们有时会参与讨论，但主要是以旁观者的态度，不对事件结果或影响负责。乐子人可以分为不同类型，从单纯的“吃瓜群众”到主动制造话题的角色。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A person who primarily observes and enjoys events online for entertainment without taking responsibility for the outcomes.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指那些在恋爱关系中坚持纯真、无私、高尚的爱情观的人。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A person who upholds pure, selfless, and noble views on love in romantic relationships.

conv_def_en: Using technological methods or techniques

sentence_with_blank_en: I have no other plans for the upcoming weekend, so I’m planning to <BLANK> with friends and try the wildly popular Zibo barbecue.
example_sentence: 最近周末没别的计划，就准备和朋友进淄赶烤，尝尝那火出圈的淄博烧烤。
distractor_1_slang_def: 通常用于反问或讽刺，表示某个情况不应该怪罪到自己头上。它可以用于轻松地化解尴尬或结束讨论。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Used rhetorically or sarcastically to deny responsibility and deflect blame.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指的是女主角在怀孕的情况下，选择离开男主角，独自抚养孩子。这里的“球”指的是怀孕的大肚子。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Refers to a pregnant woman leaving the man to raise the child alone.
distractor_3_slang_def: 具有多重意义。它可以指头发竖起来，暗示不顺滑；也可以用来形容一个人处于低谷但重燃希望并取得成果的状态；在对峙场景中，表示挑衅或找麻烦。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Having multiple meanings: hair standing up indicating roughness; a person recovering from a low point to achieve success; or provoking confrontation.

conv_def_en: Wealthy woman from a small town
slang_definition: 指的是生活在小镇，有车、有房且工作稳定的人。这些人虽然不生活在大城市，但生活更加轻松和惬意。他们具备让长辈满意的条件，在家庭和事业上看似都很成功。
slang_definition_en: A person living in a small town with a stable job, car, and house, leading a comfortable life that appears successful both in family and career.
sentence_with_blank: 每次过年回家看到那些<BLANK>，我都在想是不是我的生活方式该调整一下。
sentence_with_blank_en: Every time I go home for the New Year and see those <BLANK>, I wonder if I should adjust my lifestyle.
example_sentence: 每次过年回家看到那些小镇贵妇，我都在想是不是我的生活方式该调整一下。
distractor_1_slang_def: 这个梗表示一种对少见或意外画面的惊叹或戏谑。在特定情景下，其戏剧性和稀有性让人联想到真正的世界名画的珍贵。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A slang term expressing amazement or playful admiration for rare or unexpected scenes, likening their drama and rarity to that of famous world paintings.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指某人使用了精心策划的方法和手段，以达到其目的，这些手段非常巧妙，以至于一般人难以预料。可以表达一种震惊或感叹，具体的褒贬意义要根据具体语境来判断。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Refers to someone using carefully planned and clever methods that are hard to anticipate, often expressing surprise or admiration depending on context.
distractor_3_slang_def: 大热天的全身冷汗手脚冰凉”的缩写，是一种讽刺和调侃的用语，主要用于模仿和批评对一些事件反应过于激烈或夸张的表达方式。它源自一段评论中对社会不满的夸张语言，被用来嘲笑那些在微小事情上过度反应的人。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: An ironic term mocking exaggerated or overly intense reactions to minor events, originating from a sarcastic expression of social discontent.

conv_def_en: A partner who slacks off together.
slang_definition: 指的是工作时不专心工作，而是与同事一起闲聊、打发时间的伙伴。这种伙伴关系在工作时可以互相聊天，从八卦到时事，降低工作的枯燥性，但在下班后就不再联系。
slang_definition_en: A coworker with whom one chats and passes time during work to reduce boredom but does not socialize after hours.
sentence_with_blank: 每天上班时间长又单调，幸好有我的<BLANK>陪我聊八卦，不然都熬不下去了。
sentence_with_blank_en: Long and monotonous work hours every day, luckily my <BLANK> keeps me company chatting about gossip, otherwise I wouldn't be able to endure it.
example_sentence: 每天上班时间长又单调，幸好有我的摸鱼搭子陪我聊八卦，不然都熬不下去了。
distractor_1_slang_def: 具有一种无奈妥协的意味，表示在不情愿的情况下勉强同意或妥协。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Expressing reluctant agreement or compromise with a sense of helpless resignation.
distractor_2_slang_def: 这个梗用来嘲讽那些对某事物理解不够全面却自认为非常了解的人，带有贬义和讽刺。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A derogatory term mocking someone who overestimates their understanding of a subject despite lacking comprehensive knowledge.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指那些表面上体贴，但实际心机重，喜欢贬低别人男友以显得自己更好的男生。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A guy who appears considerate but is actually scheming and belittles others' boyfriends to make himself look better.

conv_def_en: Cao Cao's rice with toppings.
slang_definition: 指的是情绪转变或反转的过程，起初对某件事感到愤怒或不满，随后逐渐冷静并接受现实。
slang_definition_en: The process of shifting from anger or dissatisfaction to calm acceptance of a situation.
sentence_with_blank: 面试结果出来，我没被录用，心里气得想摔桌子，后来一想还是去另外的公司尝试一下，真是一个“<BLANK>”的心态变化。
sentence_with_blank_en: The interview results came out, I wasn't hired, and I was so angry I wanted to slam the table, but then I thought I should try another company, which was truly a "<BLANK>" change in mindset.
example_sentence: 面试结果出来，我没被录用，心里气得想摔桌子，后来一想还是去另外的公司尝试一下，真是一个“曹操盖饭”的心态变化。
distractor_1_slang_def: 在动漫中，特指角色对白中用“电脑配件”作为掩饰的物品，实际上指代某些不被允许或者不便公开的补品或物品。渐渐地，这个词开始被用作弹幕，以调侃和幽默的方式来评论此类情境。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: In anime, a euphemism for prohibited or sensitive items, later used humorously in comments to reference such situations.
distractor_2_slang_def: 形容那些认知水平落后、用过时手段宣扬他国优越的公知，实际上是不切实际的盲目吹捧他国并贬低中国的人。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A term describing public intellectuals with outdated views who unrealistically praise foreign countries while belittling China.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指的是由于暴雨天气导致某地出现严重积水，形容城市被雨水淹没的状态，类似于在看海景。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A state where heavy rain causes severe flooding in a city, resembling viewing a sea scene.

conv_def_en: Nüwa's graduation project
slang_definition: 指的是女娲造人时最完美的作品，用来形容一个人在各方面（如长相、身材、性格、智商、情商等）都非常完美的人。
slang_definition_en: A person who is perfect in all aspects such as appearance, figure, personality, intelligence, and emotional intelligence.
sentence_with_blank: 她不仅颜值爆表，性格也特别好，简直是女娲的毕设作品。
sentence_with_blank_en: Not only is she stunningly beautiful, but her personality is also exceptionally good; she is practically Nuwa's graduation project.
example_sentence: 她不仅颜值爆表，性格也特别好，简直是女娲的毕设作品。
distractor_1_slang_def: 原指关闭麦克风停止发言，现指在某话题上保持全面沉默，不发表公开意见。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Originally meaning to mute the microphone and stop speaking, now refers to maintaining complete silence on a topic without expressing any public opinion.
distractor_2_slang_def: 原本是游戏术语，指在非常近的距离使用大招。网络中常用于比喻在社交或工作场合表现得过于热情、亲近甚至冒失的行为，常让他人感到尴尬或不适。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Originally a gaming term meaning to use an ultimate ability at very close range; metaphorically, it refers to behaving overly enthusiastic, intimate, or forward in social or work settings, often causing discomfort or embarrassment.
distractor_3_slang_def: 通常用于短视频评论中，意指视频内容是演绎的，而非真实发生的事件。这一评论有时是为了讽刺视频的不真实，也可能是单纯的玩梗。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Used in short video comments to indicate the content is acted out rather than real, often sarcastically or as a joke.

conv_def_en: Someone who is very unskilled but has great ambition.
slang_definition: 指虽然技术不好，但特别热衷于玩游戏的玩家。
slang_definition_en: A player who is not skilled but is very enthusiastic about gaming.
sentence_with_blank: 小明每次玩游戏都输，但他总是第一个上线，真是<BLANK>。
sentence_with_blank_en: Xiaoming loses every time he plays games, but he is always the first to go online, truly <BLANK>.
example_sentence: 小明每次玩游戏都输，但他总是第一个上线，真是人菜瘾大。
distractor_1: 人间的青草地需要浇水
distractor_1_slang_def: 用来委婉地表达某人被背叛或欺骗的情况。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A euphemistic expression for someone being betrayed or deceived.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指那些通过拼凑、剪辑其他音乐作品的元素来创作新作品的人。这种行为类似于抄袭，但有些人声称这只是一种“相似”不是完全的复制。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Someone who creates new music by piecing together and editing elements from other works, resembling plagiarism but sometimes claimed to be mere similarity.
distractor_3_slang_def: 这个梗用“丧尸啃人”生动形象地讽刺那些在公共场合进行亲热行为的情侣，尤其是热吻，表达了单身人士对这种现象的调侃或无奈。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A humorous or resigned expression by singles mocking couples publicly displaying affection, especially kissing, likened to zombies biting people.

conv_def_en: A warrior of pure love.
slang_definition: 指那些在恋爱关系中坚持纯真、无私、高尚的爱情观的人。
slang_definition_en: A person who upholds pure, selfless, and noble views on love in romantic relationships.
sentence_with_blank: 他是个典型的<BLANK>，一看到复杂的感情戏就会直接跳过。
sentence_with_blank_en: He is a typical <BLANK>; whenever he sees a complicated romantic plot, he will skip it directly.
example_sentence: 他是个典型的纯爱战士，一看到复杂的感情戏就会直接跳过。
distractor_1_slang_def: 用来形容某人或某事表现得非常出格或者令人意外，具有挑逗性或不可思议的性质。常用于调侃他人做出大胆或出格的行为。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Used to describe someone or something as bold, provocative, or surprisingly outrageous, often teasingly.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指的是那些在恋爱中总是容易被渣男或渣女吸引的人，这些人通常是感情受到玩弄的爱情傻瓜。尽管不断遭遇不认真对待感情的人，他们还是会一再陷入这种关系。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A person who repeatedly attracts and falls for unfaithful or insincere romantic partners despite being hurt.
distractor_3_slang_def: 又称“老鼠人”，通常用于自嘲，指代社会底层的人群，带有黑色幽默的色彩。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A self-deprecating term for people at the bottom of society, often used with dark humor.

conv_def_en: Winning the genetic lottery (literal meaning).
conv_def: 中了基因的彩票（字面义）
slang_definition: 指在外貌上遗传了父母的优秀基因，长相特别出众。
slang_definition_en: Having inherited excellent genes from parents, resulting in an outstanding appearance.
sentence_with_blank: 她的五官如此精致，真的是<BLANK>。
sentence_with_blank_en: Her facial features are so delicate, she really is <BLANK>.
example_sentence: 她的五官如此精致，真的是中了基因彩票。
distractor_1_slang_def: 指游戏中的最高难度等级，需要极高水平才能完成，也用于形容在生活中遭遇极大阻力或恶劣环境。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: The highest difficulty level in a game requiring exceptional skill, also used to describe facing extreme challenges or harsh conditions in life.
distractor_2_slang_def: 是一句调侃的话，用来表达对不想看到内容的自我逃避和无所谓的态度，最初用于面对秀恩爱。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A humorous phrase expressing self-avoidance and indifference toward unwanted content, originally used when witnessing public displays of affection.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指的是在言语上吹牛、说得好听但做不到的人。多用于吐槽那些光说不练、承诺无法兑现的行为，含有吹牛、撩骚的意思。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Boasting or talking big without following through, often used to criticize empty promises or flirtatious talk.

conv_def_en: A habit or tendency to frequently take screenshots.
conv_def: 喜欢截图的习惯或癖好
slang_definition: 指沉迷于截图，把信息或瞬间记录下来，以备日后查看或分享给他人。
slang_definition_en: An obsession with taking screenshots to record information or moments for future reference or sharing.
sentence_with_blank: 手机相册里有几千张截图，都是<BLANK>的“杰作”。
sentence_with_blank_en: There are thousands of screenshots in the phone album, all <BLANK>'s "masterpieces."
example_sentence: 手机相册里有几千张截图，都是截图癖的“杰作”。
distractor_1_slang_def: 指通过百度搜索自己的身体症状后，得到的结果常常让人感到情况严重甚至致命，形容网上自诊后的心理负担和恐慌。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: The anxiety and fear caused by self-diagnosing serious or fatal conditions through online searches.
distractor_2_slang_def: 在网络文化中指的是一个人通过发布虚假或夸张的信息吸引他人注意，并引导他们进行讨论或分享。在网络交流中，钓鱼的目的是让人上当，进而引起群体围观与批评，实现影响舆论的目的。钓鱼者通常以“渔民”身份出现，故意发布挑衅性言论或信息来激怒或误导他人。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: In online culture, deliberately posting false or exaggerated information to attract attention, provoke discussion, and manipulate public opinion.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指的是对于某些具有强感染力或魔性的音频、视频、动态图像等产生上瘾的状态，使人反复观看或收听，并且欲罢不能。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: An addictive state caused by highly captivating or viral audio, video, or animated content that compels repeated viewing or listening.

conv_def_en: Lying down and splitting open.
slang_definition: 表示一个人对生活失去热情，不再积极进取，同时心态也崩溃了。
slang_definition_en: Describes a person who has lost enthusiasm for life, no longer strives actively, and whose mindset has collapsed.
sentence_with_blank: 最近工作压力太大，他整个人已经<BLANK>了，每天都失去动力。
sentence_with_blank_en: Recently, the work pressure has been too great, and he has completely <BLANK>, losing motivation every day.
example_sentence: 最近工作压力太大，他整个人已经躺裂了，每天都失去动力。
distractor_1_slang_def: 指的是第三人称视角，能够以无所不知的方式描写任何事物。在网络文学中，这种视角用来指代在第一人称写作中不该出现的对他人心理活动的了解。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A third-person perspective that depicts events with omniscient knowledge, often referring to unauthorized insight into others' thoughts in first-person writing.
distractor_2_slang_def: 形容那些认知水平落后、用过时手段宣扬他国优越的公知，实际上是不切实际的盲目吹捧他国并贬低中国的人。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A term describing public intellectuals with outdated views who unrealistically praise foreign countries while belittling China.
distractor_3_slang_def: 它的内容通常是一些普通但搞笑的小事。因其诙谐逗趣的文字风格而受到大众喜爱，并在网络上迅速走红。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A popular online diary featuring humorous and ordinary daily anecdotes.

conv_def_en: A person who enjoys fun and entertainment.
slang_definition: 指的是以观看和享受事件演变为目的的人，他们主要是在网络上围观各类事件，寻找娱乐和话题。他们有时会参与讨论，但主要是以旁观者的态度，不对事件结果或影响负责。乐子人可以分为不同类型，从单纯的“吃瓜群众”到主动制造话题的角色。
slang_definition_en: A person who primarily observes and enjoys events online for entertainment without taking responsibility for the outcomes.
sentence_with_blank: 每当微博上有新的热搜，一群<BLANK>就会立即涌入评论区，准备欣赏最新的网络戏剧。
sentence_with_blank_en: Whenever there is a new trending topic on Weibo, a group of <BLANK> immediately floods the comment section, ready to enjoy the latest online drama.
example_sentence: 每当微博上有新的热搜，一群乐子人就会立即涌入评论区，准备欣赏最新的网络戏剧。
distractor_1_slang_def: 指的是在氪金抽卡游戏中，稀有度较低但战斗力极高的角色。这类角色非常普及，甚至通过简单的登录或活动条件即可获得，成为玩家，尤其是运气不佳的“非洲人”的得力助手。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A low-rarity but highly powerful character in gacha games, commonly accessible through simple login or event conditions, often favored by players with poor luck.
distractor_2_slang_def: 这个梗寓意着对新一年暴富的期盼和对富贵生活的向往。换上金钱豹的头像象征着希望能够带来金钱和好运。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A slang term symbolizing the hope for sudden wealth and a prosperous life in the new year, often represented by using a golden leopard avatar to attract money and good luck.
distractor_3_slang_def: 意思是指某件事情或某个人实际上是有问题、有毛病的，通常用来形容那些让人无言以对、啼笑皆非的情况。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Used ironically to describe a situation or person that is clearly problematic or absurd.

conv_def_en: A person shaped like or resembling a mouse.
conv_def: 老鼠形状的人或像老鼠的人
slang_definition: 又称“老鼠人”，通常用于自嘲，指代社会底层的人群，带有黑色幽默的色彩。
slang_definition_en: A self-deprecating term for people at the bottom of society, often used with dark humor.
sentence_with_blank: 每个月月底都得精打细算，感觉自己真是个<BLANK>。
sentence_with_blank_en: At the end of every month, I have to budget carefully and feel like a real <BLANK>.
example_sentence: 每个月月底都得精打细算，感觉自己真是个鼠人。
distractor_1_slang_def: 方便居民做核酸检测。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Residential buildings designed for convenient nucleic acid testing.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指的是那些在聚会时不聊八卦，而是专注于讨论如何赚钱的女生。总体上泛指专注于赚钱的女性。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A woman who focuses on discussing ways to make money rather than gossiping, generally referring to women dedicated to earning income.
distractor_3_slang_def: 是表达叹服、拜服或无奈的网络用语。用于表明对某事或某人感到无奈、崇拜或调侃，带有自嘲和幽默意味。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: An internet slang expression used to show admiration, helplessness, or playful self-mockery.

conv_def_en: A diminutive term for a mouse.
slang_definition: 指代社会底层或自认为渺小的人，通常用作形容自己在社会中不重要和微不足道的身份。这一表达起到自我调侃和自我安慰的作用。
slang_definition_en: A term used to describe oneself as insignificant or low-status in society, often for self-mockery or consolation.
sentence_with_blank: 每天加班到深夜回到出租屋，我常感慨自己不过是个<BLANK>。
sentence_with_blank_en: Working overtime until late at night and returning to my rented room every day, I often feel that I am nothing more than a <BLANK>.
example_sentence: 每天加班到深夜回到出租屋，我常感慨自己不过是个鼠鼠。
distractor_1_slang_def: 指的是反派角色或具有负面历史的角色通过剧情发展或揭示正面形象而改变为正面角色。这种变化通常涉及故事情节的显著转折，以及观众对角色的重新认识。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: The process of redeeming a villain or negatively perceived character by revealing positive traits or changing their role to a protagonist through the storyline.
distractor_2_slang_def: 通常用于描述一对情侣角色之间秀恩爱的情景，类似于现实中在婚礼上发喜糖的习俗。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Typically used to describe a couple showing affection publicly, similar to the tradition of distributing wedding candies.
distractor_3_slang_def: 原意是“通过技术手段对通话进行加密，防止被窃听”。在网络上，指的是听不懂的对话。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A conversation that is difficult to understand or incomprehensible.

conv_def_en: Mouse me ah (an expression involving "mouse" and a personal exclamation).
slang_definition: 用“鼠鼠”指代处于社会底层、卑微且微不足道的小人物，表达一种自我调侃的丧文化情绪。
slang_definition_en: Using "鼠鼠" to refer to insignificant, humble individuals at the bottom of society, expressing a self-mocking, defeatist attitude.
sentence_with_blank: “每天上班挤地铁，回家吃泡面，<BLANK>，也想过上体面的生活。”

slang_definition: 带有喜感和反差萌，通常用于称呼自己的女朋友或女生自称，体现出一种接地气和可爱的感觉。
slang_definition_en: A playful and endearing term used by someone to refer to their girlfriend or by a girl herself, conveying a down-to-earth and cute vibe.
sentence_with_blank: "我给<BLANK>买了个新手机，她开心得不得了。"
sentence_with_blank_en: I bought a new phone for <BLANK>, and she was extremely happy.
example_sentence: "我给铁锤妹妹买了个新手机，她开心得不得了。"
distractor_1_slang_def: 用来形容某段描述或情境非常尴尬无趣，没有任何效果。这句话常用于找台阶、找梗，或对困境的调侃。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Used to describe a passage or situation that is extremely awkward and uninteresting, having no impact.
distractor_2_slang_def: 是一句调侃的话，用来表达对不想看到内容的自我逃避和无所谓的态度，最初用于面对秀恩爱。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A humorous phrase expressing self-avoidance and indifference toward unwanted content, originally used when witnessing public displays of affection.
distractor_3_slang_def: 形容某事特别好笑，同时自嘲经济状况不好，只能给别人留下蚂蚁花呗的负债。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Describes something very funny while self-mockingly implying poor financial status, leaving others with debt on Ant Credit Pay.

conv_def_en: Leaving by urinating.
slang_definition: 从而暂时逃避责任或避免面对棘手的情况的人，或者用来缓解尴尬局面。
slang_definition_en: A temporary escape from responsibility or avoidance of a difficult situation, often used to ease an awkward moment.
sentence_with_blank: 在会议上，我看到老板脸色不对，赶紧<BLANK>去洗手间，想避过一劫。
sentence_with_blank_en: At the meeting, I saw that the boss looked upset, so I quickly <BLANK> to the restroom, hoping to avoid trouble.
example_sentence: 在会议上，我看到老板脸色不对，赶紧尿遁去洗手间，想避过一劫。
distractor_1_slang_def: 指发言或行为不切实际，像喝醉了一样，不着调甚至有些愚蠢。用于劝人清醒且别再继续说胡话。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Used to tell someone to sober up and stop speaking nonsense, implying their words or actions are unrealistic, incoherent, or foolish like being drunk.
distractor_2_slang_def: 实则讽刺、调侃某人或某事的技巧，相比直接抨击更优雅且不易引起反感。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A subtle and elegant way to mock or criticize someone or something without causing offense.
distractor_3_slang_def: 用于调侃或缓解尴尬，通常在看到或听到不合适或唐突行为时，用来指出对方失礼或无理。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Used to tease or ease awkwardness by pointing out someone's rudeness or inappropriate behavior.

conv_def_en: I am already fine.
slang_definition: 用于表示已经解决了生理需求。反面是“我还没好”，表示内容不够刺激或自嘲持久力。
slang_definition_en: Used to indicate that a physiological need has been satisfied; the opposite phrase "I'm not done yet" implies insufficient stimulation or self-mockery of endurance.
sentence_with_blank: 看到那组写真，我直接就评论了一句“<BLANK>”。
sentence_with_blank_en: Seeing that set of photos, I immediately commented "<BLANK>".
example_sentence: 看到那组写真，我直接就评论了一句“我好了”。
distractor_1_slang_def: 意思是指同一件事成功地做到两次。在不同语境中，它有不同的用法：在足球中，指同一球员在一场比赛中进了两球；在视频中，指同一个镜头或情节出现两次。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Achieving the same success twice in the same context, such as scoring two goals in one soccer match or a scene appearing twice in a video.
distractor_2_slang_def: 以至于颠覆了大多数人对世界的基本看法或理解，包括他们的世界观、人生观和价值观。这可以涉及传统认识的各个方面，例如物质守恒等科学理论。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: To the extent of overturning most people's fundamental views or understanding of the world, including their worldview, outlook on life, and values.
distractor_3_slang_def: 是用于调侃警察或相关人员以虚假借口诱捕或接触嫌疑人的行为。这一用语也讽刺和调侃互联网或社会对政治敏感信息的监控和封禁。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A slang term mocking police or authorities who use false pretenses to detain or contact suspects, also satirizing internet or social monitoring and censorship of politically sensitive information.

conv_def_en: Many zombies are biting people.
slang_definition: 这个梗用“丧尸啃人”生动形象地讽刺那些在公共场合进行亲热行为的情侣，尤其是热吻，表达了单身人士对这种现象的调侃或无奈。
slang_definition_en: A humorous or resigned expression by singles mocking couples publicly displaying affection, especially kissing, likened to zombies biting people.
sentence_with_blank: 今天去电影院的时候，<BLANK>，场面一度非常壮观。
sentence_with_blank_en: When I went to the cinema today, <BLANK>, the scene was once very spectacular.
example_sentence: 今天去电影院的时候，好多丧尸在啃人，场面一度非常壮观。
distractor_1_slang_def: 原本是褒义词，指某事物很受大众欢迎，大家乐意看到并且喜欢听到。但在网络中，它常被用作讽刺和调侃，意味着幸灾乐祸。其含义已经与本义相去甚远，常用于表达一种调侃或嘲讽的意思。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Originally a positive term meaning something widely welcomed and enjoyed by the public, it is now often used online sarcastically to express schadenfreude.
distractor_2_slang_def: 用于形容一种言者无心、听者过度解读的情形。说话者本无深意，却被听者强行解释得极其复杂。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A situation where the speaker has no hidden meaning, but the listener overinterprets it in an overly complex way.
distractor_3_slang_def: 非常懒惰的人被称为“得了懒癌”，形容这种懒散的状态如同不治之症。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: An extremely lazy person, described as having a laziness so severe it is like an incurable disease.

conv_def_en: A person who knows a lot; a master of knowledge.
slang_definition: 这个梗用来嘲讽那些对某事物理解不够全面却自认为非常了解的人，带有贬义和讽刺。
slang_definition_en: A derogatory term mocking someone who overestimates their understanding of a subject despite lacking comprehensive knowledge.
sentence_with_blank: 他每次讲话总是那副“没有人比我更懂篮球”的样子，大家都忍不住笑了。
sentence_with_blank_en: Every time he speaks, he always has that "no one knows basketball better than me" attitude, and everyone can't help but laugh.
example_sentence: 他每次讲话总是那副“没有人比我更懂篮球”的样子，大家都忍不住笑了。
distractor_1_slang_def: 表示对某人意见或观点的高度认可。这句话一般用于评论区表达对视频内容或评论的赞同，或者认为某个评论者的发言非常准确。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Used to express strong agreement with someone's opinion or viewpoint.
distractor_2_slang_def: 类似于“亲亲”，通常用于恋爱中的情侣之间，表示对对方的钟情与喜爱。现在被用于关系较亲密的朋友之间表达暧昧或友好。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A term expressing affection or fondness, commonly used between romantic partners or close friends.
distractor_3: 干啥啥不行吃饭第一名
distractor_3_slang_def: “干啥啥不行，吃饭第一名”用来自嘲一个人除了吃饭擅长外，其余事情都不擅长。通常表示一种无奈和自嘲的幽默。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Used humorously to describe someone who is bad at everything except eating.

conv_def_en: Literature featuring delicate or pampered wives.
conv_def: 娇嫩的妻子相关的文学作品
slang_definition: 是指一些女生在网上分享的自以为是被宠爱的经历。这些文字常常带有矫情的语气和文笔，展示一种自己是被霸道总裁般宠爱的“小娇妻”状态。然而，外人看起来这些表达实际上常常显得可笑，与现实脱节，她们不幸而不自知。这种风格逐渐在网络上成为一种受网友调侃的文学体裁。
slang_definition_en: A style of online writing where women share self-indulgent, exaggerated accounts of being doted on like a "spoiled wife," often perceived as pretentious and disconnected from reality.
sentence_with_blank: 她发了一篇长长的微信朋友圈，满是<BLANK>的内容，说男友给她买早餐，但读下来却发现男友只是在楼下给她带了一份煎饼果子。
sentence_with_blank_en: She posted a long WeChat Moments full of <BLANK> content, saying her boyfriend bought her breakfast, but upon reading it, it turned out he only brought her a jianbing guozi from downstairs.
example_sentence: 她发了一篇长长的微信朋友圈，满是娇妻文学的内容，说男友给她买早餐，但读下来却发现男友只是在楼下给她带了一份煎饼果子。
distractor_1_slang_def: 常用于讽刺一些人在某些事情上过度自信。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Used to sarcastically describe someone who is overly confident about something despite being ordinary.
distractor_2_slang_def: 表示无法承受某种情况，形容感到非常吃力或很难熬。它可以表达一种达到忍耐极限的状态。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Unable to endure a situation; feeling extremely difficult or hard to bear.
distractor_3: 人间的青草地需要浇水
distractor_3_slang_def: 用来委婉地表达某人被背叛或欺骗的情况。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A euphemistic expression for someone being betrayed or deceived.

conv_def_en: An older sixth child.
slang_definition: 指那些在游戏中不按常规策略行事，专门埋伏或偷袭敌人的玩家，后来泛指行为不按套路出牌的人。
slang_definition_en: A person who disregards conventional strategies, often ambushing or surprising others, later broadly referring to someone who acts unpredictably.
sentence_with_blank: 这局游戏他们队里的<BLANK>位置太刁钻，抓了我好几次。
sentence_with_blank_en: In this game, the <BLANK> position on their team was too tricky and caught me several times.
example_sentence: 这局游戏他们队里的老六位置太刁钻，抓了我好几次。
distractor_1_slang_def: 在网络语境中主要指男生的手臂特别粗壮有力，象征一种无法控制的冲动。这个词可以用来形容男生因某种刺激而想要发泄愤怒的冲动，或指男生看到色情图片产生的生理反应，想进行自我安慰的冲动。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: In online contexts, refers to a man's exceptionally muscular arms symbolizing an uncontrollable urge, often linked to anger or sexual arousal prompting self-relief.
distractor_2_slang_def: （缩写为lsp）指的是有老色狼或好色倾向的人。这个词常用来调侃那些对性感或吸引人的内容表现出浓厚兴趣的人。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A person, often older, who shows a strong sexual interest or lecherous tendencies.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指的是在ACGN领域中，那些通过化妆和打扮，把自己外貌变得与女性无异的男性，特别是在伪娘圈中。这些人往往表现出非常可爱的女性特征，但实际上是男性。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: In the ACGN community, males who use makeup and styling to appear indistinguishable from cute females, especially within the femboy subculture.

conv_def_en: Butcher of the desolate desert
slang_definition: 这个梗指的是一位在抖音上走红的小姐姐，她以快速、熟练的宰羊技能而闻名。由于她在短时间内能熟练地完成羊的宰杀并且展示整齐的羊肉，她被网友戏称为"荒漠屠夫"。
slang_definition_en: A popular TikTok woman known for her fast and skilled sheep slaughtering, earning the nickname "Desert Butcher."
sentence_with_blank: 这位<BLANK>小姐姐真的是手起刀落毫不含糊，八分钟就完成了一整套操作。
sentence_with_blank_en: This <BLANK> young lady really acts decisively and completed the entire procedure in just eight minutes.
example_sentence: 这位荒漠屠夫小姐姐真的是手起刀落毫不含糊，八分钟就完成了一整套操作。
distractor_1_slang_def: 意在让人离远点。它在网络上流行起来作为一种不带脏字的方式来说脏话。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A playful phrase used online to tell someone to go away without using profanity.
distractor_2_slang_def: 带有文艺色彩，表达一种与月亮一起度过漫漫长夜的浪漫情愫。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A poetic expression of spending a long night awake together with the moon.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指在创作或表演中通过加入独特的行为或元素，使作品或表现更加出色和生动，起到画龙点睛的作用。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: To enhance a creation or performance by adding unique elements that make it more vivid and outstanding.

conv_def_en: An iron box on the peninsula
slang_definition: 这是一个对话梗，用于测试对方是否知道周杰伦的歌曲《半岛铁盒》，以及是否能接住梗，类似于对暗号。
slang_definition_en: A conversational code used to test if someone knows Jay Chou's song "Peninsula Iron Box" and can respond appropriately.
sentence_with_blank: 两人在聊天时，甲突然问：“请问你们这里有卖<BLANK>吗？”结果乙立刻答道：“有啊，你从前面右转的第二排架子上就有了。”
sentence_with_blank_en: While chatting, A suddenly asked, "Excuse me, do you sell <BLANK> here?" to which B immediately replied, "Yes, you can find it on the second shelf on the right after the front."
example_sentence: 两人在聊天时，甲突然问：“请问你们这里有卖半岛铁盒吗？”结果乙立刻答道：“有啊，你从前面右转的第二排架子上就有了。”
distractor_1_slang_def: 故意夸大或制造人们对某些事情的担忧，从而获取关注度、流量或直接的经济利益。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Deliberately exaggerating or creating worries about certain issues to gain attention, traffic, or direct economic benefits.
distractor_2_slang_def: 用来吐槽或调侃男生的行为，表示男生不解风情、善变或不可靠。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A term used to mock or tease men for being insensitive, fickle, or unreliable.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指在收益较低或没有收益的情况下，仅出于热情和爱好而继续进行某项活动或工作。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Continuing an activity or work solely out of passion and love despite low or no financial gain.

conv_def_en: A Ziwei star descending from the sky.
slang_definition: 凭借一部作品突然爆红的明星，或在体育圈中指成绩卓越、改变圈子现状的运动员。
slang_definition_en: A celebrity who suddenly becomes famous due to a single work, or an athlete who achieves outstanding results and changes the status quo in their sport.
sentence_with_blank: 那位新人演员凭借这部电影一夜成名，真是<BLANK>。
sentence_with_blank_en: That new actor became famous overnight because of this movie, truly <BLANK>.
example_sentence: 那位新人演员凭借这部电影一夜成名，真是天降紫微星。
distractor_1_slang_def: 在这个梗中指的是周杰伦的一首歌，该歌曲被用作健身背景音乐，因其节奏强烈，被广泛用于刘畊宏的直播毽子操健身课程，成为一种令人闻风丧胆的“神曲”，反映出健身的艰辛。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A Jay Chou song known for its intense rhythm, widely used as background music in Liu Genghong's fitness livestreams, symbolizing the toughness of workouts.
distractor_2_slang_def: 表示“道理我都懂”/“我理解你说的道理”，通常用来表达一种无奈、吐槽或讽刺的情感。意思是虽然道理大家都明白，但现实中往往行不通或无法解决问题。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Used to express reluctant acknowledgment of an obvious truth that is impractical or ineffective in reality.
distractor_3_slang_def: 源自她在《乘风破浪的姐姐》第三季中的初舞台表现。尽管她已经40岁，但仍旧用一首《爱你》等表演让90后粉丝感到怀旧和激动。这个称呼体现了粉丝对她甜美形象和活力的喜爱。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A term expressing fans' affection for a 40-year-old performer's sweet image and energetic stage presence that evokes nostalgia among post-90s fans.

conv_def_en: A huge, solid company
slang_definition: 调侃微软公司，将“微软”对调为“巨硬”。
slang_definition_en: A humorous nickname for Microsoft, reversing the characters in its Chinese name.
sentence_with_blank: 最近<BLANK>的新操作系统发布了，你觉得怎么样？
sentence_with_blank_en: The new operating system of <BLANK> was recently released; what do you think about it?
example_sentence: 最近巨硬公司的新操作系统发布了，你觉得怎么样？
distractor_1_slang_def: 不偏袒任何一方的人。这个梗用来形容那些努力做到“一碗水端平”的人，特别是在复杂或容易引发争议的环境中。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A person who remains impartial and treats all sides fairly, especially in complex or contentious situations.
distractor_2_slang_def: 是形容某些小说、漫画或动画中不合理强大的主角。这类角色通常没有逻辑、缺乏实力，但通过主角光环总能轻松战胜敌人，成功达到人生巅峰。他们的成功完全依赖于剧情的偏爱，没有任何人格魅力或吸引力。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A term describing unrealistically overpowered protagonists in novels, comics, or animations who easily defeat enemies due to plot favoritism despite lacking logic, strength, or personal appeal.
distractor_3_slang_def: 原本是褒义词，指某事物很受大众欢迎，大家乐意看到并且喜欢听到。但在网络中，它常被用作讽刺和调侃，意味着幸灾乐祸。其含义已经与本义相去甚远，常用于表达一种调侃或嘲讽的意思。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Originally a positive term meaning something widely welcomed and enjoyed by the public, it is now often used online sarcastically to express schadenfreude.

conv_def_en: A type of electronic component that allows current to flow in only one direction.
conv_def: 一种电子元件，允许电流单向流动
slang_definition: 形容那些只能看到问题的两个极端，认为事物非黑即白，不具备辩证思考能力的人。这个词通常带有贬义，指代那些思维单一、缺乏换位思考、极端自私的人。
slang_definition_en: A derogatory term for someone who sees only two extremes of an issue, thinks in black-and-white terms, and lacks dialectical thinking or empathy.
sentence_with_blank: 网上讨论某明星的负面新闻时，他总是像个<BLANK>，只能理解为支持或反对，没有中立讨论的空间。
sentence_with_blank_en: When discussing negative news about a certain celebrity online, he always acts like a <BLANK>, only able to understand support or opposition, with no room for neutral discussion.
example_sentence: 网上讨论某明星的负面新闻时，他总是像个二极管，只能理解为支持或反对，没有中立讨论的空间。
distractor_1_slang_def: 指的是在网络上，尤其是论坛中，网民之间进行的激烈争吵或骂战，常涉及谩骂和揭露隐私。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: An intense online argument or verbal fight between netizens, often involving insults and personal attacks.
distractor_2_slang_def: 在网络用语中，“闪光弹”引申为一种炫耀行为，特别是在感情或物质生活中表现得令人羡慕或炫目的行为。单身网友常用这个词来形容那些在公开场合亲昵互动的情侣或展示奢华生活的人，感到这是一种刺激、炫目到让人“致盲”的行为。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: In online slang, a flashy display intended to evoke envy, especially through public affection or showcasing a luxurious lifestyle.
distractor_3: 满朝文武为何支支吾吾
distractor_3_slang_def: 这个梗用来调侃那些在内涵视频评论区吞吞吐吐、不敢直接发表意见的人。大家看懂了内容但不好意思明说，因此表现得欲言又止。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A phrase used to mock people who hesitate and avoid expressing their opinions directly in comment sections despite understanding the content.

conv_def_en: Sage of the valley
slang_definition: 是对奥运冠军谷爱凌的戏谑性称呼。它源于她在奥运会后的高曝光率、富裕生活和精英形象，引发部分网友的讽刺和调侃，认为她如同被神化的人物。
slang_definition_en: A sarcastic nickname for Olympic champion Eileen Gu, implying she is idolized like a deity due to her high exposure, affluent lifestyle, and elite image.
sentence_with_blank: 在网上冲浪时，看到有人又把谷爱凌称作"<BLANK>"，看来她的人生真的太不接地气了。
sentence_with_blank_en: While surfing the internet, I saw someone call Eileen Gu "<BLANK>" again, it seems her life is really out of touch with reality.

distractor_1_slang_def: 源自她在《乘风破浪的姐姐》第三季中的初舞台表现。尽管她已经40岁，但仍旧用一首《爱你》等表演让90后粉丝感到怀旧和激动。这个称呼体现了粉丝对她甜美形象和活力的喜爱。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A term expressing fans' affection for a 40-year-old performer's sweet image and energetic stage presence that evokes nostalgia among post-90s fans.
distractor_2_slang_def: 通常一方寿命短暂，另一方寿命长久，最终导致一方注视着另一方先死去。这种情节引发对角色未来命运的思考，表达出岁月无情对深厚感情的冲击。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A scenario where one character outlives another, prompting reflection on the impact of time and mortality on deep relationships.
distractor_3_slang_def: 用来形容那些做事总是落后、拖后腿，或能力相对较差的人。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Used to describe someone who is always lagging behind, holding others back, or relatively less capable.

conv_def_en: If the moon doesn't sleep, I won't sleep either.
slang_definition: 带有文艺色彩，表达一种与月亮一起度过漫漫长夜的浪漫情愫。
slang_definition_en: A poetic expression of spending a long night awake together with the moon.
sentence_with_blank: 昨晚为了赶作业，<BLANK>，就这样硬撑到天亮。
sentence_with_blank_en: Last night, in order to finish my homework, <BLANK>, I just pushed through until dawn.
example_sentence: 昨晚为了赶作业，月亮不睡我不睡，就这样硬撑到天亮。
