distractor_1_slang_def_en: The act of blurring specific areas to obscure details, commonly used to conceal nudity, blood, violence, or private information for privacy protection or legal compliance.
distractor_2_slang_def: 形象地描述了不切实际且夸张的战斗场景。起源于网友的调侃，讲述了一种通过滑铲动作抵挡并击败老虎的不可思议操作，常用来讽刺或幽默地描述虚构或夸大其词的情况。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A humorous or sarcastic term describing an unrealistic and exaggerated combat scenario where sliding tackles are used to fend off and defeat a tiger.
distractor_3_slang_def: 表示两个人之间的感情比朋友更深厚，但尚未达到恋人的程度。这种关系包含着比普通朋友更加亲密和暧昧的互动，但由于欠缺明确的恋人承诺，所以显得异常美好而脆弱。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A relationship deeper and more intimate than friendship but not yet reaching the level of romantic partners.

conv_def_en: Stacked multiple books about murder.
conv_def: 叠加多本关于杀人的书籍
slang_definition: 这个梗是指在反复分享和传播过程中，表情包上的水印层层叠加，使水印变得很厚、很密集，如同一种累加效果。
slang_definition_en: A meme describing the accumulation of multiple overlapping watermarks on an image through repeated sharing.
sentence_with_blank: 我看了一下你发的表情包，这水印都快看不清了，真是<BLANK>啊！
sentence_with_blank_en: I took a look at the emoji pack you sent, and the watermark is almost unreadable, it's really <BLANK>!
example_sentence: 我看了一下你发的表情包，这水印都快看不清了，真是叠杀人书啊！
distractor_1_slang_def: 指的是一种竞争过程中，无意义的资源消耗和无效的努力。即所有参与者都在不断提高付出和成本，但结果却没有实质性地改善或提升。通常是某种过度竞争现象，导致大家都捞不到好处，只有极少数人获益。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A phenomenon of excessive competition causing meaningless resource consumption and ineffective efforts without substantial improvement, benefiting only a few.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指发言或行为不切实际，像喝醉了一样，不着调甚至有些愚蠢。用于劝人清醒且别再继续说胡话。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Used to tell someone to sober up and stop speaking nonsense, implying their words or actions are unrealistic, incoherent, or foolish like being drunk.
distractor_3_slang_def: 网络流行语，用来赞美女性，形容她们像迪士尼公主一样美丽，但她们并不在迪士尼乐园表演，而是像公主们那样“逃离”了某种场合或情境。这个梗源于迪士尼动画中的公主形象，因为许多迪士尼公主在故事中都有过“逃跑”的经历，因此当有人临时需要“逃离”某个场合时，这个梗就被用来形容她们。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A popular internet term praising women by comparing them to Disney princesses who are beautiful and have "escaped" from certain situations.

conv_def_en: All members are villains.
slang_definition: 被网友戏称为土味社会人穿搭。
slang_definition_en: A humorous term used by netizens to describe outdated or unfashionable work attire.
sentence_with_blank: 这次聚会的主题是“<BLANK>”，大家都穿上了印有这个字样的T恤。
sentence_with_blank_en: The theme of this gathering is "<BLANK>", and everyone wore T-shirts printed with this phrase.
example_sentence: 这次聚会的主题是“全员恶人”，大家都穿上了印有这个字样的T恤。
distractor_1_slang_def: 针对那些热爱奶茶的人。它反映了现代人在饮用高糖分饮料后容易出现体重增加的现象。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A term describing the tendency for people who love milk tea to gain weight due to consuming high-sugar drinks.
distractor_2_slang_def: 用来形容团队中那些几乎没有上场机会、被边缘化的正式成员，他们只能在团队中打杂或做后勤工作。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A formal team member who is marginalized and rarely participates, only handling miscellaneous or logistical tasks.
distractor_3_slang_def: 原指理发店提供的洗头、剪头、吹风等服务，但作为网络梗，它用来调侃那些造型奇特、风格独特，类似杀马特风格的人。这个梗也衍生出形容词的用法，专门描述另类和夸张的时尚风格。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Originally referring to hair salon services of washing, cutting, and blow-drying, it is used online to mock distinctive, unconventional hairstyles, especially those resembling the "shamate" style.

conv_def_en: A princess who escaped from Disneyland.
conv_def: 迪士尼乐园中逃跑的公主
slang_definition: 网络流行语，用来赞美女性，形容她们像迪士尼公主一样美丽，但她们并不在迪士尼乐园表演，而是像公主们那样“逃离”了某种场合或情境。这个梗源于迪士尼动画中的公主形象，因为许多迪士尼公主在故事中都有过“逃跑”的经历，因此当有人临时需要“逃离”某个场合时，这个梗就被用来形容她们。
slang_definition_en: A popular internet term praising women by comparing them to Disney princesses who are beautiful and have "escaped" from certain situations.
sentence_with_blank: 看到朋友打扮得特别漂亮，却匆忙赶着离开聚会，大家都笑着说：“你这是<BLANK>啊！”
sentence_with_blank_en: Seeing a friend dressed especially beautifully but hurriedly leaving the party, everyone laughed and said, "Are you <BLANK>?"
example_sentence: 看到朋友打扮得特别漂亮，却匆忙赶着离开聚会，大家都笑着说：“你这是迪士尼在逃公主啊！”
distractor_1_slang_def: 用来形容某个组合中的成员非常厉害、优秀且在某一领域中顶尖。这个词汇体现了一种对组合中成员实力的高度赞扬和喜爱。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A term used to describe a group whose members are exceptionally talented, outstanding, and top-tier in a particular field.
distractor_2_slang_def: 表示无法承受某种情况，形容感到非常吃力或很难熬。它可以表达一种达到忍耐极限的状态。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Unable to endure a situation; feeling extremely difficult or hard to bear.
distractor_3_slang_def: 最初指的是在玩游戏时键盘敲击速度极快的人，类似弹钢琴的速度。最早是游戏选手厂长的外号，因为他在直播时常放钢琴曲，后来也引申为网络上打字速度飞快的人，尤其是在网上争论或喷人的情境下。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A person who types or presses keyboard keys extremely fast, originally referring to a gamer known for rapid keystrokes like piano playing.

conv_def_en: Computer components or accessories
conv_def: 计算机的组成部分或附件
slang_definition: 在动漫中，特指角色对白中用“电脑配件”作为掩饰的物品，实际上指代某些不被允许或者不便公开的补品或物品。渐渐地，这个词开始被用作弹幕，以调侃和幽默的方式来评论此类情境。
slang_definition_en: In anime, a euphemism for prohibited or sensitive items, later used humorously in comments to reference such situations.
sentence_with_blank: 看这部动画的时候，每次看到角色递出一箱神秘物品时，我都忍不住想起“<BLANK>”这个梗。
sentence_with_blank_en: Whenever I watch this animation and see a character handing over a box of mysterious items, I can't help but think of the meme "<BLANK>".
example_sentence: 看这部动画的时候，每次看到角色递出一箱神秘物品时，我都忍不住想起“电脑配件”这个梗。
distractor_1_slang_def: 表示一种羡慕或嫉妒的情感，通常用在看到别人拥有甜美爱情或幸福生活的时候。酸在这种语境中代表了嫉妒，与柠檬的意象相似。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Expressing envy or jealousy, typically when seeing others in sweet relationships or happy lives.
distractor_2_slang_def: 通过快速眨眼跳过不流畅画面，使视觉上感觉顺畅的调侃方式。这只是一种玩笑，没有实际作用于改善性能。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A humorous way of saying that quickly blinking skips choppy frames to make visuals appear smoother, without actually improving performance.
distractor_3_slang_def: 用来表达对某个人或某样事物的强烈喜欢。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Used to express strong liking for someone or something.

conv_def_en: A deep blue pigment or color name.
conv_def: 一种深蓝色的颜料或颜色名称
slang_definition: 在网络文化中，“群青”成为一种鬼畜视频梗，通常当视频中某个角色发出长音时，制作者会将这一长音与YOASOBI的歌曲《群青》中的高音部分“啊”进行结合，同时将画面调成一种类似群青色的效果，形成一种戏谑和幽默的效果。
slang_definition_en: In online culture, "群青" refers to a meme where a character's sustained note in a video is combined with the high-pitched "ah" from YOASOBI's song "群青," accompanied by a blue-toned visual effect for humorous impact.
sentence_with_blank: 有人发了一段朋友在卡拉OK高歌的搞笑视频，瞬间就给他配上《<BLANK>》的“啊”变成了鬼畜版。
sentence_with_blank_en: Someone posted a funny video of a friend singing loudly at karaoke, instantly adding the "ah" from "<BLANK>" to turn it into a remix version.
example_sentence: 有人发了一段朋友在卡拉OK高歌的搞笑视频，瞬间就给他配上《群青》的“啊”变成了鬼畜版。
distractor_1_slang_def: 形容身高较矮。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Describes someone who is relatively short in height.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指那些过去做过的、现在回想起来会觉得羞耻或者不愿意提及的事情，类似“污点”。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Past actions or events that are embarrassing or shameful to recall.
distractor_3_slang_def: 弹幕中的常见吐槽语，通常用于当观众觉得某角色对事情的分析或推测过于复杂、敏感时进行调侃。观众作为上帝视角，拥有完整的情报，因此，当看到作品中的角色基于有限的信息做出错误判断或过于细致的推测时，观众会用“想多了”来吐槽角色的“过度解读”。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A common comment used to mock characters for overanalyzing or making overly complex or sensitive assumptions beyond available information.

conv_def_en: Heart area
slang_definition: 通过仿造上巴（上唇的意思）来幽默地指代心脏。此词调侃性地将身体各部位以“x巴”的格式重新命名，以增加趣味性。
slang_definition_en: A humorous slang term for the heart, modeled after the word for upper lip, used to playfully rename body parts in the format "x-ba."
sentence_with_blank: 在表白现场，他满脸紧张地说：“你已经住进了我的<BLANK>。”
sentence_with_blank_en: At the confession scene, he nervously said, "You have already moved into my <BLANK>."
example_sentence: 在表白现场，他满脸紧张地说：“你已经住进了我的心巴。”
distractor_1_slang_def: 内心受到创伤，并以面积大小来幽默地表达心理受伤程度。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Experiencing emotional trauma humorously expressed by the extent of the affected mental area.
distractor_2_slang_def: 用来夸大和赞美某些场景或事物，表示其具有显著的优势或与竞争者之间存在较大差距。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Used to exaggerate and praise a situation or thing, indicating a significant advantage or a large gap compared to competitors.
distractor_3_slang_def: 在互联网上通常指拍摄土味视频的人。此外，它也可以指各种群体，包括黑道人士、社会青年、与学生相对的职场人士。在不同的语境中，社会人可以表现出对社会经验、利益关系的理解和驾驭。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: On the internet, a person who creates rustic or unsophisticated videos; more broadly, individuals involved in underworld activities, youth subcultures, or working professionals, often implying an understanding of social experience and interests.

conv_def_en: Ice cream with hidden spikes (figuratively: unexpectedly expensive ice cream).
slang_definition: 指的是那些看似普通但价格高昂的雪糕，购买时让人感到意外和“被刺”的疼痛感。这个表达反映了雪糕价格上涨和意外负担感。
slang_definition_en: A term for seemingly ordinary ice creams with unexpectedly high prices that cause a surprising sense of financial pain.
sentence_with_blank: 我在超市随便拿了个雪糕，结果结账的时候发现自己被<BLANK>击倒了，竟然花了三十块。
sentence_with_blank_en: I casually grabbed an ice cream at the supermarket, but when I checked out, I found myself <BLANK> knocked down, and it actually cost thirty yuan.
example_sentence: 我在超市随便拿了个雪糕，结果结账的时候发现自己被雪糕刺客击倒了，竟然花了三十块。
distractor_1_slang_def: 这个梗用于形容即将开始或已进入讨论一些露骨或不雅话题时的状态，表示听众无处可逃，必须继续听下去。在开玩笑意义上，也用来表达信息的重要性，要求听众关注并接受。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A phrase describing a situation where listeners are trapped and must continue listening to explicit or uncomfortable topics, often used humorously to emphasize the importance of the information.
distractor_2_slang_def: 在ACGN作品中指男主角的主要情感对象，通常指女主角，也是出镜率和与男主匹配度最高的角色。该角色通常是故事的核心，与剧情和世界观关系紧密。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: In ACGN works, the main romantic partner of the male protagonist, usually the female lead, who appears most frequently and is most compatible with him, serving as the story's core character closely tied to the plot and world.
distractor_3_slang_def: 是用来形容特别忙碌或被过度使用的状态。这个短语来源于一句俗语“生产队的驴都没有你忙”，用来对比一个人或物处于高强度的使用状态。虽然用“驴”来形容听上去可能不那么高尚，但在这个语境下并不是用来骂人的，而是一种轻松幽默的表达。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Used to describe someone or something that is extremely busy or overworked.

conv_def_en: Hand-ground coffee: coffee powder ground manually.
slang_definition: 形容一个人喜欢没事找事或自我炫耀。
slang_definition_en: Describes someone who likes to create trouble or show off without reason.
sentence_with_blank: 你今天不是刚喝过咖啡吗？怎么又想喝<BLANK>了？
sentence_with_blank_en: Didn't you just have coffee today? Why do you want to drink <BLANK> again?
example_sentence: 你今天不是刚喝过咖啡吗？怎么又想喝手磨咖啡了？
distractor_1_slang_def: 是指为了完成某项任务或作品（如绘画、动画、作业等）而熬夜耗费大量时间和精力的行为。"肝"作为动词，意味着投入大量时间和精力。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Working intensively and staying up late to complete a task or project.
distractor_2_slang_def: 但因某事情而成为其粉丝。这个词可以用在各种场合，不仅限于对明星的喜爱，也可能是对某产品或事件的兴趣增加。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Becoming a fan of someone or something due to a specific event or reason.
distractor_3_slang_def: 用于表示已经解决了生理需求。反面是“我还没好”，表示内容不够刺激或自嘲持久力。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Used to indicate that a physiological need has been satisfied; the opposite phrase "I'm not done yet" implies insufficient stimulation or self-mockery of endurance.

conv_def_en: Drink tea first.
slang_definition: 的意思是提醒人们放下手头的工作，去休息，享受一杯茶。这个短语表达了一种对忙碌工作的抵抗，强调生活中应该有片刻的放松。
slang_definition_en: A reminder to pause work and enjoy a moment of relaxation with tea.
sentence_with_blank: "每天下午三点我就自动提醒自己：<BLANK>，休息一下再继续努力！"
sentence_with_blank_en: Every day at 3 PM, I automatically remind myself: <BLANK>, take a break before continuing to work hard!
example_sentence: "每天下午三点我就自动提醒自己：饮茶先啊，休息一下再继续努力！"
distractor_1_slang_def: 指责一些玩家技术不好却经常质疑他人的行为，但从作弊玩家口中说出显得荒诞。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Criticizing unskilled players who often question others, especially absurd when said by cheaters.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指的是能够证明某事件真实发生的可靠证据，通常具备较强的说服力。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Reliable evidence that conclusively proves an event actually occurred.
distractor_3_slang_def: 是用来调侃那些在网上发表低级或无聊内容的人。这个说法讽刺他们因为生活条件优越、吃饱没事干，所以在网上胡闹。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Used to mock people who post low-quality or boring content online, implying they have nothing better to do due to a comfortable life.

conv_def_en: Arriving late three times but eventually showing up.
slang_definition: 指的是尽管张三出现得比较晚，但最终他一定会被提到，调侃罗翔老师在讲课时总会例举的虚拟人物张三。
slang_definition_en: Refers to someone who arrives late but is inevitably mentioned, humorously alluding to the fictional character Zhang San frequently cited by teacher Luo Xiang in lectures.
sentence_with_blank: 看罗翔老师的视频，我就知道张三肯定会<BLANK>。
sentence_with_blank_en: Watching Teacher Luo Xiang's videos, I just know that Zhang San will definitely <BLANK>.
example_sentence: 看罗翔老师的视频，我就知道张三肯定会三迟但到。
distractor_1_slang_def: 指的是在感情生活中与很多人保持暧昧关系的人，通常是男性。与“中央空调”有着相似的含义，即对所有人都暖，所谓的“渣男”行为，是通过“广撒网”的方式接触许多异性。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A person, typically male, who maintains ambiguous romantic relationships with many people simultaneously.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指的是已约定的事情或约会但未按时赴约，使对方白白等候。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Failing to show up for a scheduled appointment, leaving the other party waiting.
distractor_3_slang_def: 形容上班族身上常见的疲惫气质，表现出一种无法掩饰的疲劳和改变。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A visible aura of fatigue commonly seen in office workers.

conv_def_en: Carefully selected products or services from the East.
conv_def: 东方精选的产品或服务
slang_definition: 指的是新东方教育集团旗下的一种创新式直播带货方式。因其由新东方教师转型而来，以中英双语直播和独特的教学风格，将学术知识与商品推销相结合，吸引了大量观众。网友认为这种高质量的直播带货犹如一股清泉，为传统的带货模式带来了新意。
slang_definition_en: An innovative livestream sales method by New Oriental Education Group combining bilingual teaching and product promotion.
sentence_with_blank: 自从<BLANK>开始直播带货后，观众不但买到了好产品，还增长了知识，一举两得。
sentence_with_blank_en: Since <BLANK> started live streaming sales, viewers have not only bought good products but also gained knowledge, achieving two benefits at once.
example_sentence: 自从东方甄选开始直播带货后，观众不但买到了好产品，还增长了知识，一举两得。
distractor_1: 奥斯卡欠你一座小金人
distractor_1_slang_def: 用于调侃某人表现夸张、戏多，好像他们的演技应该获得奥斯卡奖。可以是赞美演技高超，也可能是讽刺他们爱博眼球。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Used to mock someone for exaggerated or overly dramatic behavior, implying their acting deserves an Oscar, either as praise for skill or sarcasm for attention-seeking.
distractor_2_slang_def: 代表即将面临死亡或悲惨结局的预兆。在现代网络语境中，当人们调侃或预感到某种灾难即将降临时，常引用这个梗。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A sign or omen indicating imminent death or a tragic outcome.
distractor_3_slang_def: 出人意料地拥有超常运气的现象。这个说法通常带有戏谑性，暗指新手在涉及概率性活动（如游戏）时，因系统设置或纯粹运气使然，表现得异常幸运，从而引发其他参与者的羡慕和不满。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: An ironic term describing the unexpectedly exceptional luck often attributed to beginners in probabilistic activities, causing envy and frustration among others.

conv_def_en: Special effect of red-colored eyes
slang_definition: 经常用于动漫和鬼畜二创作品，使得人物的眼睛看起来像能发出犀利的红光。这种特效通常用于展现人物的酷炫、专注或带有危险的气息，常伴随夸张的表情或文本，具有强烈反差的喜剧效果，也用于营造装逼时刻。
slang_definition_en: A visual effect commonly used in anime and remix works that makes characters' eyes appear to emit sharp red light, conveying coolness, focus, danger, or exaggerated comedic contrast.
sentence_with_blank: 在最新的视频里，博主用<BLANK>搭配了一段经典动漫场景，制造出一种搞笑的反差效果。
sentence_with_blank_en: In the latest video, the blogger paired <BLANK> with a classic anime scene to create a humorous contrast effect.
example_sentence: 在最新的视频里，博主用红眼特效搭配了一段经典动漫场景，制造出一种搞笑的反差效果。
distractor_1_slang_def: 表示看中某物并自信地“想要”或“值得拥有”。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Expressing desire for something confidently, implying it is worth having.
distractor_2_slang_def: 用以表达对这种表面关心的调侃和不满。通常由女生用来讽刺那些认为自己在关心女生，但实际上只是在说空话的男生。也可以被用作男生对被称为“直男”这种评价的不满反驳。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A sarcastic expression used to mock insincere or superficial concern, often by women toward men who pretend to care but only speak empty words, and sometimes by men to rebut being labeled as unimaginative or insensitive.
distractor_3: 本以为是青铜没想到是王者
distractor_3_slang_def: “本以为是青铜，没想到是王者”用于形容一个人或者事情出乎意料地优秀或出色。最初认为其能力或水平较低，但经过接触或观察后发现其实极为厉害，是深藏不露的高手。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Used to describe someone or something unexpectedly excellent or outstanding, initially thought to be mediocre but later revealed to be highly skilled.

conv_def_en: Integrated graphics card used for tactical purposes
conv_def: 用于战术用途的核显卡
slang_definition: 指的是NVIDIA GeForce GTX 690显卡，由于功耗大、温度高，被调侃为“战术核显卡”。
slang_definition_en: Refers to the NVIDIA GeForce GTX 690 graphics card, humorously nicknamed for its high power consumption and heat output.
sentence_with_blank: 我的电脑温度太高了，是不是装了个<BLANK>？
sentence_with_blank_en: My computer temperature is too high; did I install a <BLANK>?
example_sentence: 我的电脑温度太高了，是不是装了个战术核显卡？
distractor_1_slang_def: 因其在剧中将自己的名字误说成“谢飞机”，且具有搞怪的演技和夸张的舞技，逐渐走红网络。这个角色的有趣特质以及尴尬时刻被广泛制作成表情包，受到网友热捧。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A humorous nickname originating from a character who mistakenly says their name as "Xie Feiji," known for quirky acting and exaggerated dance moves, widely popularized online through memes.
distractor_2_slang_def: 表达惊讶、不满或作为口头禅的一句广东俚语。在广东话中，也可作为骂人的话。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A Cantonese slang phrase expressing surprise, dissatisfaction, or used as a verbal filler, sometimes also as an insult.
distractor_3_slang_def: 网络用语“感人”是用来讽刺或吐槽某物或某人在某方面表现得非常差、低、弱、矬、烂等，以至于让人感到无奈或无语。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Internet slang used sarcastically to describe something or someone performing very poorly or badly, evoking helplessness or speechlessness.

slang: 你已经是个成熟的软件了
conv_def_en: You have already become a fully developed software program.
conv_def: 你已经成为一个功能完善的软件程序了
slang_definition: 这个梗用以调侃和吐槽软件，讽刺软件虽“成熟”却未达到用户期望的自动化程度，希望软件能自主完成用户的需求。
slang_definition_en: A sarcastic phrase used to mock software that is called "mature" but still fails to meet user expectations for automation and independence.
sentence_with_blank: 支付宝，<BLANK>，该学会自己还花呗了。
sentence_with_blank_en: Alipay, <BLANK>, you should learn to repay Huabei on your own.
example_sentence: 支付宝，你已经是个成熟的软件了，该学会自己还花呗了。
distractor_1_slang_def: 表面上是呼吁球赛观众文明观看比赛，实际上用于表达对视频或动画中女性胸部等类似球状物的赞叹，常用于网络直播或视频中。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Ostensibly a call for spectators to watch sports matches civilly, actually used to admire female breasts or similar round objects in videos or animations, commonly in live streams or videos.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指让人难以选择或回答的问题，回答不当可能引发麻烦或尴尬。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A question that is difficult to answer or choose, where a wrong response may cause trouble or embarrassment.
distractor_3_slang_def: 形象地将时间比喻为无情的“杀猪刀”。这一比喻用来感叹岁月的残酷无情，它不仅在容颜上留下皱纹，也让曾经美好的事物和过去的情感变得物是人非。这句话表达了对光阴飞逝和岁月流逝的感慨，告诫人们要珍惜当下。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A metaphor describing time as a ruthless force that ages appearance and changes cherished things and past emotions, expressing the harshness of passing years and urging people to cherish the present.

conv_def_en: Burn incense as an offering or worship.
slang_definition: 用于形容某事物或人物“凉凉了”，即事业或影响力衰退。常在评论中带有嘲讽或惋惜的意味。
slang_definition_en: Used to describe something or someone as having declined or lost influence, often with a tone of sarcasm or regret.
sentence_with_blank: 当某位知名主播被封禁，观众在其旧视频下纷纷留言“<BLANK>”。
sentence_with_blank_en: When a well-known streamer is banned, viewers flood the comments under their old videos with "<BLANK>".
example_sentence: 当某位知名主播被封禁，观众在其旧视频下纷纷留言“上香”。
distractor_1_slang_def: 是一个对南方游客在东北冰雪旅游期间的亲切称呼。这个昵称带有一种幽默和温馨的色彩，形象地描述了南方游客因穿着厚重的羽绒服而显得圆乎乎的样子。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A humorous and affectionate nickname for southern tourists in Northeast China during winter, referring to their round appearance caused by wearing bulky down jackets.
distractor_2_slang_def: 意指在关键时刻掉链子或表现不佳。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: To fail or perform poorly at a critical moment.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指玩家通过语音等便利方式，组队进行对战类游戏的行为，通常能提升团队协作效率。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: The act of teaming up via voice communication to play competitive games, usually enhancing team coordination.

conv_def_en: Start a group activity.
slang_definition: 最初指游戏中与队友一起进行战斗，现指一群人聚集起来共同攻击或嘲讽某个人。
slang_definition_en: Originally referred to fighting alongside teammates in a game; now means a group gathering to collectively attack or mock someone.
sentence_with_blank: 最近那个明星在网上被“<BLANK>”，评论区都是恶搞图片。
sentence_with_blank_en: Recently, that celebrity was "<BLANK>" online, and the comment section is full of parody images.
example_sentence: 最近那个明星在网上被“开团”，评论区都是恶搞图片。
distractor_1_slang_def: 源自微博上的一个段子，讲述一位朋友被富婆包养，一个月6万，但一个星期就逃了，因为富婆用刷碗的钢丝球刷他的私处。这个荒诞的情节让“钢丝球”迅速走红，成为调侃“富婆包养”以及少奋斗几十年的代名词。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A slang term originating from a viral story, used to mock wealthy women who financially support younger partners and the idea of gaining wealth with little effort.
distractor_2_slang_def: 在网络用语中通常用来形容容忍无节操事物的最低标准或底线。有时是用于形容一个人或事物在道德、行为上的最低限度，通常带有贬义，特别是在形容那些毫无节操、几乎无法更加低俗的状况或行为时。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: In online slang, the minimum acceptable standard or moral bottom line, often used derogatorily to describe shameless or extremely vulgar behavior.
distractor_3_slang_def: 形容某物长时间闲置不用，积累灰尘。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: To describe something left unused for a long time, accumulating dust.

conv_def_en: No internal spy or traitor.
conv_def: 没有内部的间谍或叛徒
slang_definition: 用于表示“环境安全，可以开始分享图片”，通常指尺度较大的图片。
slang_definition_en: Indicates a safe environment to start sharing sensitive or explicit images.
sentence_with_blank: <BLANK>，我要开始分享一些收藏的图片了。
sentence_with_blank_en: <BLANK>, I am going to start sharing some collected pictures.
example_sentence: 无内鬼，我要开始分享一些收藏的图片了。
distractor_1_slang_def: 形容人因愤怒或其他情绪而睁大眼睛，并因此与哈士奇犬的表情相似。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Describes a person widening their eyes due to anger or other emotions, resembling the expression of a husky dog.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指那些无法控制自己购物欲望的人，尤其是在网购时往往沉迷于疯狂购物，最后购买了许多不需要的东西，造成金钱和时间的浪费。即便意识到了问题，仍然无法克制购物冲动。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Refers to people who cannot control their shopping urges, especially online, often buying many unnecessary items and wasting money and time despite realizing the problem.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指的是女主角在怀孕的情况下，选择离开男主角，独自抚养孩子。这里的“球”指的是怀孕的大肚子。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Refers to a pregnant woman leaving the man to raise the child alone.

conv_def_en: The northern half of the Earth.
slang_definition: 指的是胸部的上半部分露出。它常用于二次元文化中，与“南半球”相对。
slang_definition_en: The upper half of the chest exposed, commonly used in anime and manga culture, opposite of "southern hemisphere."
sentence_with_blank: 小明收藏的动漫角色手办，很多都以展示<BLANK>的造型为主，展现了独特的美感。
sentence_with_blank_en: Xiaoming's collection of anime character figures mainly features poses displaying <BLANK>, showcasing a unique aesthetic.
example_sentence: 小明收藏的动漫角色手办，很多都以展示北半球的造型为主，展现了独特的美感。
distractor_1_slang_def: 指绿色，与“绿帽子”相关，象征着出轨后的宽容和原谅。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A shade of green symbolizing forgiveness and tolerance after infidelity, related to the concept of a "green hat."
distractor_2_slang_def: 被粉丝称为世界第一中单的LOL职业选手Chovy。粉丝在抖音上常常夸赞Chovy对线技术卓越，认为他是目前最强的中单选手，因此得名。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A nickname for the professional LOL mid-laner Chovy, praised by fans on Douyin as the world's best mid-laner due to his exceptional laning skills.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指在MOBA类游戏中，玩家故意让对手击杀自己，为对方提供金币和经验。这种行为通常出于消极心态，导致游戏体验受损。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: In MOBA games, deliberately allowing opponents to kill oneself to provide them with gold and experience, usually due to a negative attitude.

conv_def_en: Deoxyribose is a sugar molecule that forms part of DNA and RNA.
conv_def: 脱氧核糖是一种构成DNA和RNA的糖类分子。
slang_definition: 在这个梗中指的是精子。因为在生物学中，DNA是由脱氧核糖构成的一部分，而精子是携带DNA的重要载体，因此用脱氧核糖来暗指精子。
slang_definition_en: A slang term for sperm, referencing deoxyribose as a component of DNA carried by sperm.
sentence_with_blank: 小明开玩笑说，"我昨天晚上吃了好多‘<BLANK>’，你知道我什么意思吧？"
sentence_with_blank_en: Xiaoming joked, "I ate a lot of '<BLANK>' last night, you know what I mean, right?"
example_sentence: 小明开玩笑说，"我昨天晚上吃了好多‘脱氧核糖’，你知道我什么意思吧？"
distractor_1_slang_def: 形容特别感动到想哭，是“眼睛里进沙子了”的夸张版本，用来委婉表示对某事物的深切感动。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: An exaggerated way to express being deeply moved to the point of tears.
distractor_2_slang_def: 形容一个人的笑声粗犷、豪爽、自然不做作，也用来表示事情非常好笑，令人笑得夸张和不可自持。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A loud, hearty, and natural laugh that is unrestrained and expresses great amusement.
distractor_3_slang_def: 用来形容那些以道德和善良的名义来绑架和限制他人的人。他们通常通过展示自己道德上的高尚来要求他人牺牲，实质上可能通过这种方式对他人造成伤害。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A person who uses moral superiority and kindness as a pretext to manipulate and restrict others, often causing harm under the guise of virtue.

conv_def_en: A clear-headed state in the human world.
slang_definition: 指在纷繁复杂的世界中保持清醒，不迷失自我，明确自我定位，理智且踏实地生活和工作。
slang_definition_en: Someone who stays clear-headed and self-aware amid a complex world, living and working with rationality and groundedness.
sentence_with_blank: 张雨剑的表现被称作<BLANK>，他在快速走红后依然保持低调和理智。
sentence_with_blank_en: Zhang Yujian's performance was called <BLANK>, and he remained low-key and rational even after quickly rising to fame.
example_sentence: 张雨剑的表现被称作人间清醒，他在快速走红后依然保持低调和理智。
distractor_1_slang_def: 指一个演员通过出色的演技改变了观众对其外貌或角色不适合性的最初看法，使观众全然沉浸在角色所带来的魅力中，仿佛演员自身发生了惊人的蜕变。这是一种对演员演技的高度赞美，表示其能通过角色诠释忽略长相。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: An actor's outstanding performance that completely changes the audience's initial perception of their appearance or suitability for a role, immersing viewers in the character's charm as if the actor has undergone a remarkable transformation.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指那些在微信朋友圈里通过转发祈福图片为父母祈福保平安的年轻人，暗示这些人可能在现实中并未真正尽孝。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Young people who publicly express filial piety online by sharing blessing images but may not genuinely care for their parents in real life.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指用说英语的方式来说中文，使得普通话带上一种英语发音的独特效果。这是一种娱乐性的语言游戏，不具备实际的语言功能。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A playful way of speaking Chinese with an English accent, used for entertainment without practical language function.

conv_def_en: Me too.
slang_definition: 用来表达一种强烈的认同感、激动或感慨，尤其是在遇到志同道合的人时。
slang_definition_en: Used to express strong agreement, excitement, or emotion, especially when meeting like-minded people.
sentence_with_blank: 朋友兴奋地说：“周末我们去吃火锅吧！”我立刻回复：“<BLANK>！”
sentence_with_blank_en: My friend excitedly said, "Let's go eat hotpot this weekend!" I immediately replied, "<BLANK>!"
example_sentence: 朋友兴奋地说：“周末我们去吃火锅吧！”我立刻回复：“俺也一样！”
distractor_1_slang_def: 用来讽刺那些只顾刷野和吃线，全场经济最高但什么贡献也不做的打野玩家。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A jungler who focuses solely on farming and lane minions, has the highest gold but makes no meaningful contribution.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指人或事物表面光鲜亮丽，但实际上没有内涵，徒有其表，常用来形容虚伪或注重外表但忽略内在的情况。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Describes someone or something that appears shiny and attractive on the surface but lacks substance, often used to denote superficiality or hypocrisy.
distractor_3_slang_def: 表现出的目瞪口呆、茫然不知所措的表情。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: An expression showing stunned confusion and helplessness.

conv_def_en: The password of my bank card.
slang_definition: 这个梗用来形容一个人所有的行动和意图都被他人彻底看透，就像对方已经知道了你的银行卡密码一样。通常用于调侃在游戏中完全被对手预判、看穿的一方。
slang_definition_en: A phrase used to describe someone whose actions and intentions are completely seen through by others, as if their bank card password is known, often used to tease a player who is fully anticipated and outplayed in a game.
sentence_with_blank: 在《英雄联盟》比赛中，选手的所有闪躲和技能释放都被对方预判到，弹幕刷起了“某选手：<BLANK>是”。
sentence_with_blank_en: In the League of Legends match, all of the player's dodges and skill casts were anticipated by the opponent, and the chat was flooded with "Player X: <BLANK> is".
example_sentence: 在《英雄联盟》比赛中，选手的所有闪躲和技能释放都被对方预判到，弹幕刷起了“某选手：我的银行卡密码是”。
distractor_1_slang_def: 表示看中某物并自信地“想要”或“值得拥有”。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Expressing desire for something confidently, implying it is worth having.
distractor_2_slang_def: 在并不需要吃苦的情况下，主动去承受不必要的艰难，从而导致适得其反的行为。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Unnecessarily enduring hardship when it is not required, resulting in counterproductive outcomes.
distractor_3_slang_def: 用于形容一种言者无心、听者过度解读的情形。说话者本无深意，却被听者强行解释得极其复杂。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A situation where the speaker has no hidden meaning, but the listener overinterprets it in an overly complex way.

conv_def_en: Meticulously detailed anger.
slang_definition: 当他们看到古罗马相关的信息时表现出的强烈反应。
slang_definition_en: A strong reaction displayed when encountering information related to ancient Rome.
sentence_with_blank: 看到电影中的罗马士兵穿错了盔甲，<BLANK>。
sentence_with_blank_en: Seeing the Roman soldiers in the movie wearing the wrong armor, <BLANK>.
example_sentence: 看到电影中的罗马士兵穿错了盔甲，精罗震怒。
distractor_1_slang_def: 是用来形容那些在网络小说中常见的霸道总裁、黑道少主或商界精英等角色的一种气质。这个词强调他们具备强大的潜在能力和魅力，能够超然地处理事务，并常常无视法律与社会常规。同样，他们的举止既豪放又自律，对待规矩有选择性地遵守。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A term describing characters with a powerful, charismatic, and rebellious aura who handle matters with detached confidence and selectively follow rules.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指的是工作时不专心工作，而是与同事一起闲聊、打发时间的伙伴。这种伙伴关系在工作时可以互相聊天，从八卦到时事，降低工作的枯燥性，但在下班后就不再联系。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A coworker with whom one chats and passes time during work to reduce boredom but does not socialize after hours.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指在网络上，特别是论坛和贴吧中，那些只会索取资源而不愿自行查找或付出努力的人。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Someone who only asks for resources online without making any effort to search or contribute.

conv_def_en: Sweet and adorable grandmother
slang_definition: 源自她在《乘风破浪的姐姐》第三季中的初舞台表现。尽管她已经40岁，但仍旧用一首《爱你》等表演让90后粉丝感到怀旧和激动。这个称呼体现了粉丝对她甜美形象和活力的喜爱。
slang_definition_en: A term expressing fans' affection for a 40-year-old performer's sweet image and energetic stage presence that evokes nostalgia among post-90s fans.
sentence_with_blank: "王心凌的舞台表现真的太棒了，<BLANK>一如既往给人惊喜！"
sentence_with_blank_en: Wang Xinling's stage performance was truly amazing, and <BLANK> as always brought surprises!
example_sentence: "王心凌的舞台表现真的太棒了，甜心奶奶一如既往给人惊喜！"
distractor_1_slang_def: 指的是同一个圈子或世界，表达对某个话题或文化的共同理解和共鸣。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Refers to sharing the same circle or world, expressing mutual understanding and resonance on a topic or culture.
distractor_2_slang_def: 原指泄愤或感叹。在网络上，它被引申为“胡说”或“随意说说”的意思。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Originally expressing venting or exclamation; online, it means to talk nonsense or speak casually.
distractor_3_slang_def: 在网络语境中通常指“强烈推荐”某物或某事。它表达了一种出于个人喜好而热切分享和推荐的态度。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: In online contexts, it means to enthusiastically recommend something based on personal preference.

conv_def_en: To send mail or items.
slang_definition: 原为电子竞技中的礼貌用语，代表Goodgame的缩写。最初用来表示对一局游戏的满意和结束，表示技不如人的甘拜下风。而在网络文化中，常用于形容“完蛋了”或处于劣势、一种摆烂的心态。
slang_definition_en: Originally a polite term in e-sports meaning "Good game," now commonly used online to indicate defeat, disadvantage, or a resigned attitude.
sentence_with_blank: “这把游戏明显要<BLANK>，我还是提前打字GG好跑路。”
sentence_with_blank_en: This game is obviously going to <BLANK>, so I'd better type GG early and run away.
example_sentence: “这把游戏明显要寄，我还是提前打字GG好跑路。”
distractor_1_slang_def: 用来形容一个人在某一领域拥有令人难以企及的天赋或与生俱来的条件。这些条件是后天努力无法改变的，使得他们在该领域中能够轻松取得成功。如果拥有这些天赋的人还特别努力，就更让人望尘莫及。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Describes someone with innate, exceptional talent in a field that cannot be matched by effort alone, enabling effortless success.
distractor_2_slang_def: 表示“如果不服气就来辩论”，表明说话者希望通过辩论展示自身优势，通常用于引战帖或钓鱼帖中，追求通过争论占据理性的制高点。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Used to challenge others to debate if they disagree, often to assert superiority or provoke argument.
distractor_3_slang_def: 主要用于讽刺利己主义者。它起源于一个网络投票事件，当时大多数人选择了免费的小布丁而不是科比复活。后来，这个词被用来攻击科比的粉丝和揭别人的伤疤，也可以用作无明确含义的底线梗。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A term used to mock selfish individuals, originating from an online poll where most chose a free pudding over Kobe Bryant's resurrection, later used to criticize Kobe fans, highlight others' vulnerabilities, or as a nonspecific punchline.

conv_def_en: Duola (female given name)
slang_definition: 这个梗用来形容“蘑菇头”和“眼瞎”，指的是动画角色朵拉的标志性蘑菇头发型和她在观察物品时的“战略性”视而不见。
slang_definition_en: A slang term referring to a mushroom-shaped hairstyle and willful blindness, inspired by the animated character Dora's signature look and her strategic overlooking of objects.
sentence_with_blank: 当我看到全班女生都剪了齐刘海短发时，感觉像是进入了《爱冒险的<BLANK>》的世界，全是<BLANK>。
sentence_with_blank_en: When I saw that all the girls in the class had cut their hair into short bangs, it felt like entering the world of "The Adventurous <BLANK>", full of <BLANK>.
example_sentence: 当我看到全班女生都剪了齐刘海短发时，感觉像是进入了《爱冒险的朵拉》的世界，全是朵拉。
distractor_1_slang_def: 用于亲切地称呼温柔、美丽的年轻女性，常在ACG界和网络中使用。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A friendly term for a gentle and beautiful young woman, commonly used in ACG communities and online.
distractor_2_slang_def: 用来形容团队中那些几乎没有上场机会、被边缘化的正式成员，他们只能在团队中打杂或做后勤工作。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A formal team member who is marginalized and rarely participates, only handling miscellaneous or logistical tasks.
distractor_3_slang_def: 用于调侃韩国籍英雄联盟职业选手Doinb，这名选手在中国职业战队工作并表现出对中国的喜爱，类似于俄罗斯网红伏拉夫，以显示他在中国通过表现对中国的热爱来获取人气和收入。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A nickname mocking Korean League of Legends player Doinb for expressing exaggerated affection for China to gain popularity and income, similar to Russian influencer Volaf.

conv_def_en: The first year of the Lu and Lei surnames.
slang_definition: 用来形容2022年，因为电子科技大学的两名学生卢XX和雷XX在毕业设计中舞弊被曝光，导致全国高校加强了对毕业设计的要求。
slang_definition_en: A term referring to the year 2022, marked by increased national university scrutiny on graduation projects following a cheating scandal involving two students from the University of Electronic Science and Technology.
sentence_with_blank: “今年的毕业设计要求太严格了，真是名副其实的<BLANK>。”
sentence_with_blank_en: This year's graduation project requirements are too strict; it is truly a well-deserved <BLANK>.
example_sentence: “今年的毕业设计要求太严格了，真是名副其实的卢雷元年。”
distractor_1_slang_def: 是一个用来调侃某人一时反应迟钝或思维停滞的网络用语。通常用于描述一个人遇到困难而无法迅速找到解决方案，从而显得憨态可掬的状态。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A slang term used to humorously describe someone momentarily slow to react or mentally stuck when facing difficulties.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指代热血、激昂的背景音乐（BGM）的开始，特别是在动漫或影视作品中。当剧情达到高潮或即将开始战斗时，这类音乐会播放，迅速提高观众的情绪，增添紧张感。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Refers to the start of intense, energetic background music, especially in anime or films, signaling a climax or impending battle to heighten excitement and tension.
distractor_3_slang_def: 现在常用于形容性格敏感纤细、胆小容易惊慌不安的人，尤其是社交恐惧症患者。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A person who is sensitive, delicate, timid, and easily panicked, especially someone with social anxiety.

conv_def_en: Step back, step back, step back.
slang_definition: 包含跺脚、手势如击剑，同时大喊"退退退"，仿佛在驱逐恶灵。
slang_definition_en: Stomping feet and making fencing-like gestures while shouting "retreat" as if expelling evil spirits.
sentence_with_blank: 看见评论区吵得不可开交，我都想发个"<BLANK>"来个大招了。
sentence_with_blank_en: Seeing the comment section in such a heated argument, I almost want to post a "<BLANK>" to make a big move.
example_sentence: 看见评论区吵得不可开交，我都想发个"退退退"来个大招了。
distractor_1_slang_def: 用来形容那些因为愤怒或焦虑而突然把桌上的物品全部推翻甚至掀桌的人。尽管这样做会导致一片混乱，但桌面却瞬间变得空无一物，就像被快速清理了一样。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A person who, out of anger or anxiety, suddenly overturns all items on a desk, creating chaos but leaving the surface instantly cleared.
distractor_2_slang_def: 通常用于表示之前的陈述或评论是故意曲解或以开玩笑的态度发表的。它也可以表示上一句话具有深刻或不可捉摸的含义，是“大误”和“大污”的变形。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Used to indicate that a previous statement was intentionally distorted, made in jest, or carries a profound or elusive meaning; a variation of "big mistake" and "big dirty."
distractor_3_slang_def: 类似于对BL题材感兴趣的腐女/腐男。他们对自身性取向没有特定要求。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Fans interested in yuri content who have no specific sexual orientation preferences.

conv_def_en: Thankful for Zhen Huan's help or kindness.
conv_def: 感谢甄嬛的帮助或恩惠
slang_definition: 表达对该角色逆风翻盘、苦尽甘来的励志生活态度的欣赏和向往。这一事件在网上引发了大家对美好生活的期盼，希望通过这种祝福获得好运和福气。
slang_definition_en: Expressing admiration and aspiration for the character's inspiring comeback and hopeful attitude toward a better life.
sentence_with_blank: “今天是甄嬛的生日，大家都在说‘<BLANK>’，希望能接到好福气！”
sentence_with_blank_en: Today is Zhen Huan's birthday, and everyone is saying "<BLANK>", hoping to receive good fortune!
example_sentence: “今天是甄嬛的生日，大家都在说‘谢谢甄嬛’，希望能接到好福气！”
distractor_1_slang_def: 通常由制作方特意添加，供玩家或观众发现。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: An intentional hidden feature or message added by creators for players or viewers to discover.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指代那些无故妨碍他人，损人不利己，不懂团队合作的人。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Someone who obstructs others without reason, harms others without benefiting themselves, and lacks teamwork skills.
distractor_3_slang_def: 可以表示心理上的悲伤或生理上的疼痛。在网络文化中，它常被用于调侃或营造中二氛围。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Expresses emotional sadness or physical pain, often used humorously or to create a dramatic atmosphere online.

conv_def_en: A person named Zhou Dan with the surname Pan.
slang_definition: 这个梗指的是一位名叫潘周聃的学霸，他在节目《最强大脑》中的出场方式给人留下了深刻的印象。由于场地的狭窄，他起身时的扭头和侧身动作显得非常拽酷，给人一种气势不凡的感觉，因此被网友们用来玩梗和模仿。
slang_definition_en: A reference to Pan Zhoudan, a top student whose cool and confident entrance on the show "The Brain" became a popular meme for imitation.
sentence_with_blank: 在班级聚会上，小明模仿<BLANK>的学霸式起身，引得全场爆笑。
sentence_with_blank_en: At the class reunion, Xiaoming imitated <BLANK>'s top student-style standing up, causing the whole audience to burst into laughter.
example_sentence: 在班级聚会上，小明模仿潘周聃的学霸式起身，引得全场爆笑。
distractor_1_slang_def: 被网友戏称为土味社会人穿搭。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A humorous term used by netizens to describe outdated or unfashionable work attire.
distractor_2_slang_def: 通常指因某种刺激或影响而产生的亢奋状态，或是在冲动下不理智地行动。可以是因酒精或其他物理刺激引发的头晕状态，也可以是被某个想法、音乐、视频等内容吸引并重复在脑海中引起兴奋或模仿的状态。目前多指第二种。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A state of excitement or impulsive behavior caused by stimulation, often from alcohol or captivating ideas, music, or videos.
distractor_3_slang_def: 用于在论坛或贴吧中回击那些通过发无实质内容的帖子骗取经验值的用户。此表达表示对这种行为的不满，提醒发帖者不要为了攒经验而发无意义的内容。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A phrase used in forums or message boards to criticize users who post meaningless content solely to gain experience points, expressing disapproval and warning against such behavior.

conv_def_en: Extremely painful
slang_definition: 可以表示心理上的悲伤或生理上的疼痛。在网络文化中，它常被用于调侃或营造中二氛围。
slang_definition_en: Expresses emotional sadness or physical pain, often used humorously or to create a dramatic atmosphere online.
sentence_with_blank: 在看了一部感人的电影后，小明感慨道：“痛，太痛了，我的心被剧情狠狠揪住了！”
sentence_with_blank_en: After watching a touching movie, Xiaoming sighed, "It hurts, it hurts so much, my heart was painfully gripped by the plot!"
example_sentence: 在看了一部感人的电影后，小明感慨道：“痛，太痛了，我的心被剧情狠狠揪住了！”
distractor_1_slang_def: 通常用于反问或讽刺，表示某个情况不应该怪罪到自己头上。它可以用于轻松地化解尴尬或结束讨论。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Used rhetorically or sarcastically to deny responsibility and deflect blame.
distractor_2_slang_def: 带有文艺色彩，表达一种与月亮一起度过漫漫长夜的浪漫情愫。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A poetic expression of spending a long night awake together with the moon.
distractor_3_slang_def: 用于赞赏在动画、影视或现实中展现出勇气和自我牺牲精神的人物。在一些情况下，这句话也带有调侃和讽刺的意味，特别是当角色平时表现懦弱而突然做出壮举时。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Used to praise someone who shows courage and self-sacrifice in animation, film, or real life, sometimes with a teasing or ironic tone when the person is usually timid but suddenly acts bravely.

conv_def_en: Politely declined.
slang_definition: 是一种委婉拒绝别人的表达方式。在直接拒绝可能会带来尴尬或伤感情的情况下，用这种说法既达到了拒绝的目的，又通过“了哈”这种轻松的语气缓和了气氛，让对方更容易接受。
slang_definition_en: A polite and casual way to decline an offer or invitation to avoid awkwardness or hurt feelings.
sentence_with_blank: 朋友邀请他出去吃饭，他想留在家里休息，于是回复对方：“今天累了，<BLANK>，下次一定去！”
sentence_with_blank_en: A friend invited him out to eat, but he wanted to stay home and rest, so he replied to them: "I'm tired today, <BLANK>, I'll definitely go next time!"
example_sentence: 朋友邀请他出去吃饭，他想留在家里休息，于是回复对方：“今天累了，婉拒了哈，下次一定去！”
distractor_1_slang_def: 用来形容某个组合中的成员非常厉害、优秀且在某一领域中顶尖。这个词汇体现了一种对组合中成员实力的高度赞扬和喜爱。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A term used to describe a group whose members are exceptionally talented, outstanding, and top-tier in a particular field.
distractor_2_slang_def: 通常是因为不满意工作环境或生活条件。这个说法突出了工人们在工厂中不稳定的就业状态，也带有一定的调侃意味。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: Leaving a factory job due to dissatisfaction with work or living conditions, highlighting workers' unstable employment status with a humorous tone.
distractor_3_slang_def: 这个梗最初来自于游戏英雄联盟的职业选手Xx对IG队员的嘲讽，意指原本战队的正式队员。但随着Xx在比赛中表现不佳，网友反倒用这个词来调侃他，使得“正版打野”带有讽刺和自嘲的意味。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Originally a term mocking official team members in League of Legends, later used sarcastically to tease a player for poor performance.

conv_def_en: A bass fish lying on its back.
slang_definition: 形容刚刚死去，肚皮朝上的鲈鱼，以区别于新鲜活鱼。这种死去的鱼通常价格较低，“仰泳鲈鱼”这个称呼实际上是商家以幽默和高情商的方式来描述便宜出售的死鱼，以吸引顾客注意。
slang_definition_en: A humorous term for dead sea bass floating belly-up, used by sellers to describe cheap, unsold fish.
sentence_with_blank: 昨天去超市，本以为会买到新鲜的鲈鱼，结果看到的都是促销的<BLANK>。
sentence_with_blank_en: Yesterday I went to the supermarket, expecting to buy fresh bass, but all I saw were promotional <BLANK>.
example_sentence: 昨天去超市，本以为会买到新鲜的鲈鱼，结果看到的都是促销的仰泳鲈鱼。
distractor_1_slang_def: 伴随劲爆电子音乐，风靡网络。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A popular dance style accompanied by energetic electronic music.
distractor_2_slang_def: 弹幕中的常见吐槽语，通常用于当观众觉得某角色对事情的分析或推测过于复杂、敏感时进行调侃。观众作为上帝视角，拥有完整的情报，因此，当看到作品中的角色基于有限的信息做出错误判断或过于细致的推测时，观众会用“想多了”来吐槽角色的“过度解读”。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A common comment used to mock characters for overanalyzing or making overly complex or sensitive assumptions beyond available information.
distractor_3_slang_def: 用于嘲讽某人消息落后，意指某人对当前的信息或事件知之甚少或反应迟钝。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Used to mock someone for being out of touch or slow to react to current information or events.

conv_def_en: The slap on the upper side.
slang_definition: 指人中，与“下巴”相对应。
slang_definition_en: The philtrum, corresponding to the chin.
sentence_with_blank: 昨天做核酸的时候，那棉签直接戳到了我“里巴”。
sentence_with_blank_en: When I did the nucleic acid test yesterday, the swab directly poked my "liba".
example_sentence: 昨天做核酸的时候，那棉签直接戳到了我“里巴”。
distractor_1_slang_def: 源自“这是人干的事吗”的缩写，主要用来吐槽不合理或者让人无法接受的事物，多用于表达对某视频内容的不满或出入预期的情况。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A phrase used to criticize unreasonable or unacceptable situations, often expressing dissatisfaction with unexpected or disappointing video content.
distractor_2_slang_def: 对他人极为不满的情况下，用以形容别人像牛马一样的畜生。也比喻被生活所迫，给他人做牛做马的底层打工人，具有讽刺之意。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A derogatory term describing someone as a beast of burden like an ox or horse, used to express extreme dissatisfaction or to ironically depict a low-level worker oppressed by life.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指的是在多人在线游戏中，尤其是MOBA、MMORPG、FPS类型游戏中，某个玩家在别人快要击杀敌人时，抢先攻击并获得最后击杀，从而获得更多的奖励和成就感。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: In multiplayer online games, especially MOBA, MMORPG, and FPS, the act of attacking an enemy just before another player kills them to secure the final hit and gain extra rewards and satisfaction.

conv_def_en: A donkey raised by the production team.
slang_definition: 是用来形容特别忙碌或被过度使用的状态。这个短语来源于一句俗语“生产队的驴都没有你忙”，用来对比一个人或物处于高强度的使用状态。虽然用“驴”来形容听上去可能不那么高尚，但在这个语境下并不是用来骂人的，而是一种轻松幽默的表达。
slang_definition_en: Used to describe someone or something that is extremely busy or overworked.
sentence_with_blank: 最近加班太多了，我都快成“<BLANK>”了。
sentence_with_blank_en: I've been working overtime so much lately that I'm almost becoming a "<BLANK>".
example_sentence: 最近加班太多了，我都快成“生产队的驴”了。
distractor_1_slang_def: 指的是以观看和享受事件演变为目的的人，他们主要是在网络上围观各类事件，寻找娱乐和话题。他们有时会参与讨论，但主要是以旁观者的态度，不对事件结果或影响负责。乐子人可以分为不同类型，从单纯的“吃瓜群众”到主动制造话题的角色。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: A person who primarily observes and enjoys events online for entertainment without taking responsibility for the outcomes.
distractor_2_slang_def: 是用来吐槽恐怖游戏或解谜游戏中道具打火机的不科学设定。在游戏中，打火机常作为唯一的光源，能在长时间的游戏过程中始终保持亮度，燃料似乎用之不竭，像是由核能驱动一样。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: A term used to criticize the unrealistic design of lighters in horror or puzzle games that serve as a constant, inexhaustible light source, as if powered by nuclear energy.
distractor_3_slang_def: 用来表达一种强烈的认同感、激动或感慨，尤其是在遇到志同道合的人时。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: Used to express strong agreement, excitement, or emotion, especially when meeting like-minded people.

conv_def_en: Expert at organizing desktops
slang_definition: 用来形容那些因为愤怒或焦虑而突然把桌上的物品全部推翻甚至掀桌的人。尽管这样做会导致一片混乱，但桌面却瞬间变得空无一物，就像被快速清理了一样。
slang_definition_en: A person who, out of anger or anxiety, suddenly overturns all items on a desk, creating chaos but leaving the surface instantly cleared.
sentence_with_blank: 看到那位领导一怒之下把所有文件推到地上，大家都戏称他是办公室里的<BLANK>。

example_sentence: 看到那位领导一怒之下把所有文件推到地上，大家都戏称他是办公室里的桌面清理大师。
distractor_1_slang_def: 通常在2-6分钟，类似于泡面泡好的时间。
distractor_1_slang_def_en: Typically 2-6 minutes long, similar to the time it takes to cook instant noodles.
distractor_2_slang_def: 指人中，与“下巴”相对应。
distractor_2_slang_def_en: The philtrum, corresponding to the chin.
distractor_3_slang_def: 指虽然技术不好，但特别热衷于玩游戏的玩家。
distractor_3_slang_def_en: A player who is not skilled but is very enthusiastic about gaming.

conv_def_en: A toad sleeping with a frog.
slang_definition: 这个梗用来形容一个人外貌不佳但又非常花心。
slang_definition_en: A phrase describing someone unattractive but very flirtatious.
